crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits a glob of acidic bile at a target within 20 feet.

On a Critical Hit, this attack causes the @Condition[corroding] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}向 20 英尺内的一个目标吐出一团酸液。

在暴击时，此次攻击会造成 @状态[corroding] 状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The creature expels a spray of acidic bile in a 10 foot fan.

On a Critical Hit, this attack causes the @Condition[corroding] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该生物喷出一股酸液，形成一个10尺扇形范围。

在暴击时，此攻击会造成 @状态[corroding] 状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It gains a bonus to Dodge equal to half its Toughness score and is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}可以穿过直径仅为1英寸的狭窄空间，且其跨步不会受到任何惩罚。它获得等同于其坚韧属性值一半的闪避加值，并免疫@状态[受缚]状态。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: While fully submerged in water or liquids, @ref[actor.name]{this creature} has @Advantage[2] on Stealth checks.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 当完全浸没在水元素或液体中时，@ref[actor.name]{该生物}进行潜行检定时获得 @优势[2]。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can precisely sense any blooded creature within 20 feet which does not have all its hit points. Any weapon or skill attack against a wounded creature does not suffer Banes that would normally apply if the creature were @Condition[blinded].
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}能够精确感知20尺内任何未处于满生命值状态的有血生物。对负伤生物进行的任何武器或技能攻击，不会承受若该生物处于@状态[blinded]时通常会适用的祸骰。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} emerges from a subterranean position with surprising and sudden force. This action may only be activated immediately the creature leaves the @Condition[burrowing] state.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} erupts to Strike against all enemies within its weapon range with an Empowered attack.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
@ref[actor.name]{生物}以惊人而突然的力量从地下位置现身。该动作只能在该生物离开@状态[burrowing]状态后立即发动。

@ref[actor.name]{生物}破土而出，对其武器射程内的所有敌人进行一次强化的打击。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can drop from overhead to Strike a creature below it. The target creature suffers an Empowered attack which, if successful, knocks them @Condition[prone] in addition to dealing damage.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} can suffer falling damage from this attack only if it misses its target.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
@ref[actor.name]{生物}可以从上方坠下，对下方的一个生物进行打击。目标生物承受一次强化攻击；若攻击成功，除造成伤害外，还会使其 @状态[prone]。

@ref[actor.name]{生物}只有在未命中目标时，才会因这次攻击承受坠落伤害。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
After achieving a Critical Hit with a melee attack, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks the target's Willpower defense, leaving a Grave Mark upon a success that inflicts the @Condition[exhausted] condition that persists until the target completes a Rest.

If a humanoid creature bearing a Grave Mark dies while under the effects of the mark, it rises from death on its subsequent Turn as a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.taxonomy.Item.ghoul00000000000]{Ghoul}.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
在以一次近战攻击取得暴击后，@ref[actor.name]{生物}会攻击目标的意志防御；若成功，则会施加一个墓之印记，并使目标陷入@状态[exhausted]状态，且该状态会持续，直到目标完成一次休息。

如果一个带有墓之印记的人型生物在印记效果持续期间死亡，它会在其后的下一个回合自死亡中复起，成为一只@UUID[Compendium.crucible.taxonomy.Item.ghoul00000000000]{食尸鬼}。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} achieves a Critical Hit using a melee attack it may exaggerate the blow in a way that evokes fear within those who behold the strike.

All the enemies within 30 feet who can see the creature face a Harmless attack against their Willpower or become @Condition[frightened] for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
当 @ref[actor.name]{生物} 使用一次近战攻击造成一次暴击时，它可以夸大这一击的声势，以一种会在目睹这次打击者心中引发恐惧的方式挥出这一击。

30尺内所有能够看见该生物的敌人，都必须承受一次针对其意志的无害攻击，否则将陷入 @状态[frightened]，持续3 回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits a small bolt of lightning at a target creature within 20 feet, attacking its Reflex and dealing Electricity damage.

On a Critical Hit the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}向20尺内的一个目标生物吐出一道小型闪电箭，攻击其反射，并造成电击伤害。

在重击时，此次攻击会施加@状态[shocked]状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} expels a bolt of lighting in a 30 foot ray that is 4 feet wide, attacking the Reflex of each target along that path and dealing Electricity damage.

On a Critical Hit the attack causes the @Condition[shocked] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}喷吐出一道30英尺长、4英尺宽的闪电射线，攻击沿途每个目标的反射，并造成闪电伤害。

若暴击，此次攻击会施加@状态[shocked]状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This effect remains active for 10 minutes or until any non-Movement action is taken.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 你变为@状态[隐形]，且无法通过基于视觉的察觉被发现。你不能成为任何行动的直接目标。该效果持续10分钟，或直到你采取任何非移动行动为止。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks with a pestilent bite that is Empowered and deals Corruption damage.

On a Critical Success the attack causes the @Condition[decaying] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}用带有疫病之咬的攻击发动攻击，该攻击被强化并造成腐化伤害。

在大成功时，此次攻击会造成@状态[decaying]状态，持续3 回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} spits globule of toxin at a target creature within 20 feet, attacking its Reflex and dealing Poison damage.

On a Critical Hit the attack causes the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}向20英尺内的一个目标生物吐出一团毒素，攻击其反射并造成毒药伤害。

在暴击时，此攻击会施加@状态[poisoned]状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} expels toxic discharge in a 30 foot ray that is 4 feet wide, attacking the Reflex of each target along that path and dealing Poison damage.

On a Critical Hit the attack causes the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 3 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
@ref[actor.name]{生物}喷射出一股有毒排放物，形成一道30英尺长、4英尺宽的射线，攻击该路径上每个目标的反射，并造成毒药伤害。

在暴击时，此次攻击会造成@状态[poisoned]状态，持续3回合。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The ooze's cells rapidly divide and the creature splits in two! The original creature and its clone equally divide its remaining Health. The Size of each resulting creature is decreased by 1.

If in combat, the new creature acts as a Summon and joins at Initiative 1. This Action may only be used if the creature has Size larger than 2. The created ooze never has rank superior to Normal.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
软泥怪的细胞迅速分裂，这个生物一分为二！原本的生物与其复制体平分其剩余的生命值。每个结果生物的体型减少 1。

如果处于战斗中，新生物作为一个召唤物行动，并以先攻 1 加入。此动作仅可在该生物的体型大于 2 时使用。被创造出的软泥怪的等级绝不会高于普通。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
此次攻击可在一次移动后使用，前提是该生物因这次移动而至少接近其目标10英尺。若该生物原本位于目标上方，则此次攻击在该次移动中每下降10英尺高度，便获得+1 恩惠骰。

若此次攻击为暴击，则该攻击的目标会立即陷入@状态[prone]。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} becomes @Condition[dead], it explodes in a pulse of Radiant energy which attacks the Fortitude defense of all nearby creatures that fail to resist the effect.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 当 @ref[actor.name]{生物}陷入@状态[dead]时，它会爆炸，释放出一阵光能量，对所有未能抵抗该效果的附近生物的坚韧防御发动攻击。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks swiftly with both talons.

If at least one attack results in a Critical Success, it inflicts the @Condition[bleeding] condition for 2 Rounds.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}迅速地用双爪发起攻击。

如果至少有一次攻击获得严重成功，则其会施加@状态[bleeding]状态，持续2 轮。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
When the @ref[actor.name]{creature} is hit by a Strike, it may partially burst to release a spray of sickening fluid that deals Corruption damage. This action scales with Toughness and targets the Reflex defense of any creature within 3 feet.

On a Critical Success, the affected target becomes temporarily @Condition[diseased] for 3 Rounds.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
当@ref[actor.name]{生物}被一次打击命中时，它可以部分爆裂，释放出一阵令人作呕的液体喷雾，造成腐化伤害。该动作随坚韧而成长，并以3英尺内任意生物的反射防御为目标。

在大成功时，受影响的目标会暂时处于@状态[diseased]状态，持续3轮。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature}'s life is sustained by necromantic magic or otherworldly forces. When it would be considered @Condition[dead] it is instead @Condition[incapacitated].

After the conclusion of combat, the @ref[actor.name]{creature} may begin to perform the Recover action, regaining consciousness after the recovery is complete. Recovery in this fashion may be prevented in one of the following ways:

  • The creature was incapacitated by a type of damage for which it is Vulnerable.

  • The magical forces which caused it to rise as undead are disrupted, countered, or otherwise dispelled.

  • The creature's body is destroyed to a degree that it can no longer maintain its physical form.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
@ref[actor.name]{该生物}的生命由死灵魔法或异界力量维系。当其本应被视为@状态[dead]时，改为视为@状态[incapacitated]。

在战斗结束后，@ref[actor.name]{该生物}可以开始执行“恢复”动作，并在恢复完成后重新获得意识。以这种方式进行的恢复可通过以下任一方式被阻止：

  • 该生物因其处于易伤的某种伤害类型而失能。

  • 使其作为不死生物复起的魔法力量被干扰、反制，或以其他方式驱散。

  • 该生物的身体被摧毁到无法再维持其物理形态的程度。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
The @ref[actor.name]{creature} reacts, performing a Movement up to their Stride to interpose itself between a nearby ally and some source of harm which it can perceive.

The @ref[actor.name]{creature} becomes @Condition[dead], destroyed in their sacrifice, but the triggering action causes no effects to its original target.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
该@ref[actor.name]{生物}作出反应，进行一次不超过其步幅 的移动，使自己介入附近一名盟友与其能够察觉的某个伤害来源之间。

该@ref[actor.name]{生物}变为@状态[dead]，并在牺牲中被摧毁，但触发该反应的动作不会对其原本的目标造成任何效果。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
You swallow a target enemy, effectively removing that foe from combat. The swallowed target is @Condition[blinded] and @Condition[restrained] until released.

If you take Severe damage, are Wounded, or are rendered @Condition[incapacitated] you regurgitate the swallowed creature.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
你吞下一个敌方目标，实际上将该敌人移出战斗。被吞下的目标处于 @状态[blinded] 和 @状态[受缚] 状态，直到被释放。

如果你受到致命伤害、处于负伤状态，或陷入 @状态[incapacitated]，你会将吞下的生物反刍出来。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en:
This attack may be used after a Move which descended at least 10 feet towards the target. The attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn:
此次攻击可在一次朝向目标下降了至少10英尺的移动后使用。该攻击在此次移动中每下降10英尺高度，便获得+1 恩惠。

如果此次攻击为暴击，则该攻击的目标立即被击倒至@状态[prone]。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} sweeps its heavy tail in a circular arc, striking all creatures within range. On a Critical Hit, affected targets become @Condition[staggered] for until the end of their next turn.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: @ref[actor.name]{生物}用其沉重的尾巴横扫出一道圆弧，击中范围内的所有生物。若造成暴击，受影响的目标会陷入 @状态[staggered] 状态，直到其下个回合结束。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{Creature} perceives the world through differences in temperature with precision, allowing it to locate creatures which are warm-blooded or otherwise emit heat up to 60 feet away as long as they are not behind total cover and you are not Blinded or Incapacitated. A creature detected using this Thermal Vision is treated as visible for the purposes of actions which require you to see your target.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}通过温度差异精确感知世界，使其能够定位60英尺内的温血生物或其他会散发热量的生物，只要它们未处于完全掩蔽之后，且你未目盲或失能。使用此热视觉探测到的生物，在需要你看见目标的动作中，视为可见。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} moves forward up to twice its Stride, attacking the Reflex defense of all creatures in its path. Targets who are half the creature's size or smaller are @Condition[stunned] until the end of their next turn as they are slammed aside.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}向前移动，距离最多为其跨步的两倍，并攻击其路径上所有生物的反射防御。体型为该生物一半或更小的目标会被猛然撞开，并陷入@状态[震慑]，直到其下个回合结束。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} has otherworldly sight that makes it especially aware of dangers or opportunities. It gains +2 Boons to any Awareness check and can see @Condition[invisible] creatures.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}拥有异界视觉，使其对危险或机遇格外察觉。它在任何察觉检定上获得+2恩惠骰，并且能够看见@状态[invisible]的生物。

crucible.adversary-talents.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} attacks, injects toxin which, if successful, inflicts the @Condition[poisoned] condition for 6 Turns.
crucible.adversary-talents.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}进行攻击，并注入毒素；若成功，则会施加@状态[poisoned]状态，持续6回合。

crucible.affixes.json.en:
Add Acid damage to strikes made with this weapon. The bonus damage is equal to 2 for each Tier of this suffix.

Playtest Notes

This bonus currently applies as flat additional damage of the weapon's existing damage type. In a future update, this will deal damage as Acid, checked against the target's Acid resistance separately.
crucible.affixes.json.cn:
为使用此武器进行的打击附加强酸伤害。额外伤害等于该后缀每阶 2点。

试玩测试说明

该加值当前以此武器现有伤害类型的平直额外伤害形式生效。在未来的更新中，这将改为造成强酸伤害，并单独检定目标的强酸抗性。

crucible.affixes.json.en: Increase the Enchantment Bonus for Arcana skill checks by 1 for each Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 此前缀的每个阶级都会使奥术技能检定的附魔加值提高1。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This item is imbued with the essence of Aspect spellcraft. While equipped, the bearer instinctively gains knowledge of the Aspect gesture, allowing them to compose spells using it even without having learned the gesture through a talent.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 该物品被注入了化相施法的精髓。持用时，持有者会本能地获得化相手势的知识，使其即使未通过天赋习得该手势，也能使用它来构筑法术。

crucible.affixes.json.en: Increase the Enchantment Bonus for Awareness skill checks by 1 for each Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 此前缀的每个阶都会使察觉技能检定的附魔加值提高 1。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This item is imbued with the essence of Blast spellcraft. While equipped, the bearer instinctively gains knowledge of the Blast gesture, allowing them to compose spells using it even without having learned the gesture through a talent.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 此物品被注入了爆破施法的精髓。装备时，持有者会本能地获得关于爆破手势的知识，使其即使未通过天赋习得该手势，也能使用它来构筑法术。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This weapon is especially effective against Celestial creatures. When making a Strike against a target of that creature type, the attacker gains bonus Boons equal to the Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 这种武器对天界生物尤其有效。对该生物类型的目标进行打击时，攻击者获得等同于此前缀阶级的额外恩惠骰。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This weapon is especially effective against Construct creatures. When making a Strike against a target of that creature type, the attacker gains bonus Boons equal to the Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 这把武器对构装体生物尤为有效。对该生物类型的目标进行打击时，攻击者获得等同于此前缀阶级的额外恩惠骰。

crucible.affixes.json.en:
Add Corruption damage to strikes made with this weapon. The bonus damage is equal to 2 for each Tier of this suffix.

Playtest Notes

This bonus currently applies as flat additional damage of the weapon's existing damage type. In a future update, this will deal damage as Corruption, checked against the target's Corruption resistance separately.
crucible.affixes.json.cn:
使用此武器进行的打击会附加腐化伤害。该额外伤害等于此后缀每阶2点。

试玩测试说明

此加值目前以该武器现有伤害类型的平额额外伤害形式生效。在未来的更新中，该伤害将作为腐化伤害结算，并单独对照目标的腐化抗性进行判定。

crucible.affixes.json.en: Increase the Enchantment Bonus for Deception skill checks by 1 for each Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 使欺瞒技能检定的附魔加值每有该前缀的一个阶位便提高1。

crucible.affixes.json.en: Increase Parry defense by 1 for each Tier of this suffix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 此后缀每有1阶，招架防御便提高1点。

crucible.affixes.json.en: Increase the Enchantment Bonus for Diplomacy skill checks by 1 for each Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 此前缀的每个阶都会使外交技能检定的附魔加值提高1。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This weapon is especially effective against Dragon creatures. When making a Strike against a target of that creature type, the attacker gains bonus Boons equal to the Tier of this prefix.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 这种武器对巨龙生物尤其有效。对该生物类型的目标进行打击时，攻击者获得等同于此前缀阶级的额外恩惠骰。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This item is imbued with the essence of Earth spellcraft. While equipped, the bearer instinctively gains knowledge of the Earth rune, allowing them to compose spells using it even without having learned the rune through a talent.
crucible.affixes.json.cn: 该物品被灌注了大地施法的精华。处于已装备状态时，持有者会本能地获得关于大地符文的知识，使其即使未通过天赋习得该符文，也能使用它来构筑法术。

crucible.affixes.json.en: This weapon is especially effective against Earth Elemental creatures. When making a Strike against a target of that creature type, the attacker gains bonus Boons equal to the Tier of this prefix.

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.journals.Playtest One: The Ring of Valor.pages.Day Two - Hammer and Anvil.text
crucible.playtest.json.en:
In the Day Two challenge, 4 Level 2 heroes face off against the gladiatorial duo of Hammer and Anvil (Challenge 9).

  • @UUID[Actor.XA9W38PGmAs3ZLDa]{Hammer} (Level 3 Elite)

  • @UUID[Actor.KSoJR8uwT5Qzka7p]{Anvil} (Level 3 Elite)

Protagonist Threat: 2 × 4 = 8

Adversary Threat: 4 × 2 = 8

Encounter Difficulty: Deadly

Introduction

"It's a beautiful day in the Ring of Valor, and it's looking like we're in for a treat. Today's match marks the return of that deadly duo, the giants of the game, the terrible two: Hammer and Anvil."

The announcer pauses as the crowd roars before continuing: "What a welcome! You can just hear how eager the fans are to see these two in action again. Let's see if our new contenders can stand up to the challenge!"

The party is instructed to gather in front of the tunnel on the west side of the arena. Once the party is in position, Hammer and Anvil emerge from the tunnel on the opposite east side and the battle begins!

Tactics

Hammer and Anvil are a pair of adversaries which fight as a coordinated team.

Anvil's tactics primarily focus on trying to get close and grapple an enemy in order to create opportunities for Hammer to attack. Anvil will use Hammer Toss to get Hammer quickly into the fray and then use Wrestler to restrain enemies and Heavy Strike to deliver punishing blows.

Hammer is a skirmisher, moving in and out of combat to capture opportunities to unleash a devastating sequence of dual-wield attacks using Flurry or using a Strike + Offhand Strike combo. Any enemies that attempt to disengage, Hammer will subdue using Hamstring.

Advancement

The fight ends when both Hammer and Anvil have been defeated. The crowd is pleased with the party's performance, and the Commentator announces that the party will be returning tomorrow for another match.

The party is given a chance to rest, use the Recover action, and gain a level advancing to Level 3 to face @UUID[.v5EIDeTtHdQ7Wb5J]{Day Three - The Skeletal Army}.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
在第2天的挑战中，4名2级英雄将对决角斗双人组——@UUID[Actor.XA9W38PGmAs3ZLDa]{锤}与@UUID[Actor.KSoJR8uwT5Qzka7p]{铁砧}（挑战等级9）。

  • @UUID[Actor.XA9W38PGmAs3ZLDa]{锤}（3级精英）

  • @UUID[Actor.KSoJR8uwT5Qzka7p]{铁砧}（3级精英）

主角威胁：2 × 4 = 8

对手威胁：4 × 2 = 8

遭遇难度：致命

引言

“今天的英勇之戒天气正好，看来我们将迎来一场精彩对决。今天的比赛标志着那对致命双人组的回归——赛场上的巨人，可怕的二人组：锤和铁砧。”

播报员在观众的欢呼声中停顿片刻，随后继续说道：“多么热烈的欢迎！你们完全能听出粉丝们有多么渴望再次看到这两位登场。让我们看看新的挑战者们能否顶住这场考验！”

队伍被指示在竞技场西侧的通道前集结。等队伍就位后，锤和铁砧会从对面东侧的通道现身，战斗随即开始！

战术

锤和铁砧是一对以协调配合作战的对手。

铁砧的战术主要集中在设法贴近并擒抱一名敌人，从而为锤创造攻击机会。铁砧会使用锤 Toss将锤迅速送入战局，然后使用Wrestler来压制敌人，并以强力打击施加沉重一击。

锤是一名散兵，会在战斗中进进出出，寻找机会，以连击施展一连串毁灭性的双持攻击，或使用打击 + 副手攻击的组合。任何试图脱离接战的敌人，锤都会用断筋打击将其制伏。

晋升

当锤和铁砧都被击败时，战斗结束。观众对队伍的表现十分满意，解说员宣布队伍将在明天回归，参加另一场比赛。

队伍将获得一次休息机会，可以使用恢复动作，并提升1级，晋升至3级，以迎战@UUID[.v5EIDeTtHdQ7Wb5J]{第3天 - 骷髅军团}。

crucible.playtest.json.en:
In this challenge, 4 Level 5 heroes face off against a trio of Void Harbingers:

  • @UUID[Actor.YVvIKp7fUIduZchE]{Harbinger of Fear} (L4 Elite)

  • @UUID[Actor.TZT7ybsmI8yV5hWg]{Harbinger of Disease} (L4 Elite)

  • @UUID[Actor.CTpEm0WlmFAAosBD]{Harbinger of Madness} (L4 Elite)

Protagonist Threat: 4 × 5 = 20

Adversary Threat: 3 × 6 = 18

Encounter Difficulty: Deadly

Introduction

"Tonight we're in for some true excitement as the summoners have conjured a new challenge from realms beyond the umbral veil! Ladies and gentlemen, from the darkest recesses and liminal spaces beyond the edge of reality, welcome to the Ring of Valor: the Void Harbingers!"

Tactics

The Harbinger of Fear is a mobile predator that feasts on fearful thoughts. It will use Ethereal Warp to move freely about the battlefield and Eldritch Emanataion to inflict fear on groups of enemies. Once it has isolated a frightened enemy it will Strike with it's Psychic Maw.

The Harbinger of Disease is a bearer of pestilence that inflicts the Diseased condition using it's Pestilent Lash ability. This Harbinger also has spellcasting ability which it will use to further sap life and morale, targeting groups of enemies with the Pulse gesture or individual targets using Influence.

The Harbinger of Madness is a psychological predator which will close to melee range before using the Mind Flay ability against groups of enemies or Devour Thoughts against a single foe.

Advancement

The fight ends when all three Harbingers are defeated. The crowd is pleased with the party's performance, and the Commentator announces that the party will be returning tomorrow for another match.

The party is given a chance to rest, use the Recover action, and gain a level; advancing to Level 6. All heroes may also increase the quality of their equipped Armor to Fine. The party returns the next day to face @UUID[.UxIXSvvJCdqx2Tar]{Day Six - Mirror Match}.
