  • @UUID[Actor.CTpEm0WlmFAAosBD]{疯狂先驱}（L4 精英）

主角威胁：4 × 5 = 20

对手威胁：3 × 6 = 18

遭遇难度：致命

引言

“今晚我们将迎来真正令人热血沸腾的场面，因为召唤师们从暗影帷幕彼端的领域中 conjured 出了一项全新的挑战！女士们、先生们，从现实边缘之外最黑暗的幽深角落与阈限空间而来，欢迎来到英勇之戒：虚空先驱者！”

战术

恐惧先驱是一名以恐惧思绪为食的机动型掠食者。它会使用以太扭曲在战场上自由穿梭，并以Eldritch Emanataion对成群敌人施加恐惧。一旦它孤立出一名处于恐慌中的敌人，便会用它的灵能巨口进行打击。

疫病先驱是瘟疫的传播者，会利用它的疫病鞭笞能力施加染病状态。这名先驱者也具有施法能力，会借此进一步吸取生命与士气，对成群敌人使用脉冲手势，或以影响针对单个目标。

疯狂先驱是一名精神层面的掠食者，它会先逼近到近战距离，再对成群敌人使用精神鞭笞能力，或对单个敌人施展Devour Thoughts。

晋升

当三名先驱者全部被击败时，战斗结束。观众对队伍的表演感到满意，解说员宣布队伍将于明天返回参加另一场比赛。

队伍获得一次休息、使用恢复动作并提升等级的机会；晋升至6级。所有英雄还可以将其已装备护甲的品质提升至精良。队伍将在次日返回，面对 @UUID[.UxIXSvvJCdqx2Tar]{第六天 - 镜像对决}。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.journals.Playtest One: The Ring of Valor.pages.Day Six - Mirror Match.text
crucible.playtest.json.en:
In this final challenge, 4 Level 6 heroes come head-to-head with a rival adventuring party comprised of 4 Level 6 heroes.

  • @UUID[Actor.iLUfMcYjAbZFY4CJ]{Duurath} (Level 6)

  • @UUID[Actor.0crVYYsPvV9KDEJ2]{Belladonna} (Level 6)

  • @UUID[Actor.2lvTCCOj4dnBI774]{Eliorwen} (Level 6)

  • @UUID[Actor.Il4NDaNBdHNcjJ9d]{Kagura} (Level 6)

Protagonist Threat: 4 × 6 = 24

Adversary Threat: 4 × 6 = 24

Encounter Difficulty: Deadly

Introduction

"Well, well… your champions have proven themselves against all of the formidable adversaries which this arena had to offer, so it's time to pit them against the storied veterans and champions of a past competition. Prepare yourselves for a battle of champions!"

This is an especially difficult challenge because all four opposing heroes are individually optimized and work well as a team.

Tactics

Each of the opponents in this challenge functions as a heroic protagonist with their own array of talents, actions, and equipment.

Duurath

Duurath is a dangerous melee combatant with high Engagement, strong physical defense, and the Dread Lord signature talent which demoralizes and frightens foes. Duurath will close on enemy combatants using Shield Charge and lock them down using Cadence to deliver high damage or Counter Strike to retaliate when blocking incoming blows. Defensively, Duurath can use Kinetic Ward to protect himself from a chosen type of physical damage.

Belladonna

Belladonna is a cunning and elusive melee combatant with the Poisoner talent. At the beginning of the battle she will activate Poison Blades. She will use Distract against enemy spellcasters to sap their Focus, and Combat Medicine to restore the health of her allies. Belladonna will seek out more vulnerable enemy combatants, closing to melee range using Tumble if necessary and Flurry to apply rapid damage and poisoned conditions.

Eliorwen

Eliorwen is a deadly archer, infusing shots from her Longbow with lightning spells using her Arcane Archer talent. Eliorwen will identify a dangerous enemy and target them with Mark Prey to reduce their defenses for herself and her allies. She will use Precision Shot coupled with reduced cost Voltaic Arrow to deliver reliable sustained damage from a distance.

Kagura

Kagura is a versatile support character able to heal both mind and body of her allies. She will cast the Life rune using either the Influence, Pulse, or Ray gestures to trigger additional healing from her Mender talent. Kagura can sustain healing nearly indefinitely through thoughtful use of the Compose inflection as well as Conserve Effort. Kagura avoids direct confrontation and instead will disengage from combat and seek protection from her allies.

Advancement

The fight ends when all four adversaries are defeated. The crowd is thrilled with the party's performance and celebrates them as eternal champions of the Ring of Valor. There are not any more planned events in the Ring of Valor at this time, but please see @UUID[.aNlzMnfUkwpLrSox]{Further Challenges} if you wish to continue testing by improvising new challenges for the party to face.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
在这场最终挑战中，4名6级英雄将与一支由4名6级英雄组成的敌对冒险队伍正面对决。

  • @UUID[Actor.iLUfMcYjAbZFY4CJ]{Duurath}（6级）

  • @UUID[Actor.0crVYYsPvV9KDEJ2]{Belladonna}（6级）

  • @UUID[Actor.2lvTCCOj4dnBI774]{艾利奥文}（6级）

  • @UUID[Actor.Il4NDaNBdHNcjJ9d]{Kagura}（6级）

主角威胁：4 × 6 = 24

对手威胁：4 × 6 = 24

遭遇难度：致命

引言

“好，好……你们的勇士已经证明了自己，击败了这座竞技场所能提供的所有强大对手，所以现在，是时候让他们与往届赛事中那些声名显赫的老将与冠军一较高下了。准备迎接一场冠军之战吧！”

这是一项尤其困难的挑战，因为对方的四名英雄都经过了单独优化，并且作为团队配合得极好。

战术

本挑战中的每个对手都作为一名英雄式主角运作，拥有各自的一系列天赋、动作和装备。

Duurath

Duurath 是一名危险的近战战斗者，拥有很高的交战、强大的物理防御，以及能够打击敌人士气并令其恐惧的恐惧领主签名天赋。Duurath会使用盾牌冲锋逼近敌方战斗者，并利用节奏打出高额伤害，或在格挡来袭攻击时使用反击进行报复。防御方面，Duurath可以使用Kinetic Ward来保护自己，免受所选类型的物理伤害。

Belladonna

Belladonna是一名狡猾而难以捉摸的近战战斗者，拥有下毒者天赋。战斗开始时，她会启动毒刃。她会对敌方法术施放者使用分散注意力来消耗其专注，并使用战斗医疗恢复盟友的生命值。Belladonna会寻找更脆弱的敌方战斗者，必要时使用翻滚接近至近战范围，并以连击迅速施加伤害和中毒状态。

艾利奥文

艾利奥文是一名致命的弓箭手，凭借她的奥术弓手天赋，将闪电法术灌注到她的长弓射击之中。艾利奥文会识别出一个危险的敌人，并以标记猎物锁定对方，降低其对她自己及其盟友的防御。她会使用精准射击配合降低消耗的Voltaic 箭头，从远距离稳定地持续输出伤害。

Kagura

Kagura是一名多用的支援角色，能够治疗盟友的身心。她会使用生命符文，并通过影响、脉冲或射线手势之一来触发其修补匠天赋带来的额外治疗。Kagura还可以通过谨慎运用Compose屈折以及节省精力，几乎无限期地维持治疗。Kagura会避免直接对抗，而是脱离战斗并寻求盟友的保护。

晋升

当四名对手全部被击败时，这场战斗即告结束。观众会为队伍的表演激动不已，并将他们欢庆为英勇之戒的永恒冠军。目前英勇之戒暂无更多预定活动，但如果你希望继续测试，为队伍即兴设计新的挑战，请参见 @UUID[.aNlzMnfUkwpLrSox]{Further Challenges}。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Anvil.items.Heavy Weapon Training.actions.heavyStrike.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用主手武器发动一次强力打击。这次攻击施展起来较为缓慢，但经过强化，可造成额外伤害。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Anvil.items.Unarmed Combat Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical Strength. You are Trained with weapons in the Unarmed category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你熟悉基础武术和徒手战斗。你知道如何运用自身的体魄力量来制服或压制对手。你在徒手武器的使用上达到受训等级。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Anvil.items.Unarmed Combat Training.actions.grapple.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你试图以身体方式限制或制服一个对手。对一个相邻目标进行一次运动技能攻击。若成功，你和你的目标都陷入 @状态[受缚] 状态，持续 1 轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Hammer.items.Flurry.actions.flurry.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You Strike twice with each weapon, but each strike is Difficult.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用每把武器各打击两次，但每次打击都很困难。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Orivech.items.Talisman Weapon Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你理解如何运用护符、法珠、法器或其他类似法器来引导魔法或强化施法中的奥术用法。你对护符类别中的武器拥有受训熟练。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Orivech.items.Rune: Soul.actions.evoke.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你对灵魂符文的掌控使你能够促成基础形式的灵性影响，产生以下效果之一：

  • 使你自己或另一名自愿的人重温其过去某一时刻的一段核心记忆，持续时间最长为一分钟，仿佛那是最近发生的一样。

  • 鉴定影响某人的一种负面灵性状态，例如 @状态[broken]、@状态[frightened]、@状态[confused] 或 @状态[insane]。

  • 与另一名自愿的生物建立短暂的灵性连接，使其能够识别一个可以用单个词表达的想法。

引发的用途只能影响你自己或另一名你能够以身体接触到的生物。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Skeletal Archer.items.Projectile Weapon Training.actions.quickDraw.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is Difficult, but has a reduced Action cost.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你可以在压力下勉强开出一枪，尽管准确性会降低。你进行一次打击，该次打击为困难，但其动作成本会降低。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Skeletal Spearman.items.Leg Sweep.actions.legSweep.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make a Strike attack with your mainhand weapon. This technique is Difficult to execute and deals reduced damage, but if successful renders your target Prone.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用你的主手武器进行一次打击攻击。此技巧执行起来困难，且造成的伤害会降低，但如果成功，则会使目标倒地。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Skeletal Spearman.items.Light Weapon Training.actions.lunge.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你灵巧地向前突进，以突如其来的迅捷发动一次打击，对单个目标使用一把以敏捷进行加值成长的武器进行一次打击 ，且射程增加+2 feet。

此次攻击为困难，但你不会从当前位置移动，且此次攻击不会引发脱离接战。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Koy Rent.items.Ferocious Howl.actions.ferociousHowl.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make an Intimidation skill attack against the Willpower defense of all enemies within 30 feet, dealing Void damage to Morale and causing the Frightened condition for 3 Rounds.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你对30英尺内所有敌人的意志防御进行一次威吓技能攻击，对其士气造成虚空伤害，并使其陷入恐慌状态，持续3轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Koy Rent.items.Natural Weapon Proficiency.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You have a fluent familiarity with the use of natural bodily weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Natural category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你熟练掌握了天生武器的使用。你在天生类别的武器上获得熟练工训练等级以及+1 技能加值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Koy Rent.items.Pouncing Strike.actions.pouncingStrike.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
This attack may be used after a Move that brings the @ref[actor.name]{creature} at least 10 feet closer to its target. If the creature was above the target, this attack gains +1 Boon per 10 feet of elevation decrease in that movement.

If this attack is a Critical Hit, the target of the attack is immediately knocked @Condition[prone].
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
此次攻击可在一次移动后使用，前提是该次移动使 @ref[actor.name]{生物} 至少接近其目标 10 英尺。若该生物原本位于目标上方，则此次攻击每因该次移动下降 10 英尺高度，便获得 +1 恩惠骰。

如果此次攻击为暴击，则攻击目标会立即击至 @状态[prone]。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Harbinger of Disease.items.Gesture: Pulse.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
将符文中的奥术力量以你为中心向外扩散，形成一个随你一同移动的半径区域。

脉冲手势按Presence进行成长，并产生一个10英尺半径的散发区域，对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。该手势施放需要2只手，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Harbinger of Disease.items.Rune: Oblivion.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Void damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
一种混乱的力量，代表对存在的毁灭与彻底抹消。湮灭符文掌管物质的消解或精神的涣散。

湮灭符文基于智力进行成长，目标为意志，并对士气造成虚空伤害。它与秩序的灵魂符文相对立。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Zarajah.items.Inspire Heroism.actions.inspireHeroism.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: Each ally, excluding yourself, within 10 Feet gains +1 Boon to actions performed until the end of their next Turn.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 每位盟友（不包括你自己）在10 格内，在其下个回合结束前进行的动作获得+1 恩惠骰。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Zarajah.items.Gesture: Influence.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You intensify the arcane power of a Rune into a concentrated direct contact which is generally a more powerful evolution of the basic Touch gesture.

The Influence gesture scales using Presence and targets a single adjacent creature. It deals 10 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量强化为一种集中的直接接触，这通常是基础触碰的更强力进阶形式。

手势：影响手势以气场进行成长，并以一个相邻的单个生物为目标。它对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成10 基础伤害。该手势施放时需要1 只手，其基础消耗为3 动作和1 专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Zarajah.items.Light Weapon Training.actions.lunge.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你敏捷地向前突进，以突然而出其不意的迅捷发动一次打击，对单一目标使用一件以敏捷作为加值成长属性的武器进行一次打击 ，且射程增加+2 feet。

此次攻击为困难，但你不会从当前位置移动，且此次攻击不会引发脱离接战。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Zarajah.items.Rune: Oblivion.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
A chaotic force of destruction and annihilation of existence. The Oblivion rune governs unmaking of matter or decoherence of spirit.

The Oblivion rune scales using Intellect, targets Willpower, and deals Void damage to Morale. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Soul.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
一种混乱的毁灭力量，能够歼灭存在本身。湮灭符文支配着对物质的消解，或对精神的解离。

湮灭符文以智力进行成长，目标为意志，并对士气造成虚空伤害。它与秩序井然的灵魂符文相对立。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Cadence.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You are drilled in performing sequences of melee attacks with rhythmic precision. When you Strike multiple times in sequence using a one-handed melee weapon you gain a stacking +1 Boon for each successive attack.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你经过训练，能够以富有节奏的精准度连续发动近战攻击。当你使用单手近战武器连续多次进行打击时，每一次后续攻击都会使你获得可叠加的+1 恩惠骰。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Spellblade.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你是一名奥术战士，能够在战斗中结合打击与法术，同时依靠武艺与奥术技巧。你武器装备造成的物理打击可部分替代传统施法所需的姿势手势。

当你以近战武器作为主手武器持用时，使用手势：打击施放的法术可获得该武器的伤害加值。

在你使用近战武器进行一次打击后，你可以立即施放一个其动作消耗减少 1 的法术。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Counter Riposte.actions.counterRiposte.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: When you defend against a melee attack with a Parry, you may react and expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike which benefits from the Exposed condition.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 当你以招架来防御一次近战攻击时，你可以进行反应并消耗专注，以较低代价进行一次打击反击，并从暴露状态中获益。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Lesser Regeneration.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: Your prodigious hardiness conveys a supernatural capability to recover from wounds quickly. At the start of your turn if you are not Weakened you gain +1 Health.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你非凡的坚韧赋予你一种超自然的能力，使你能迅速从创伤中恢复。在你的回合开始时，若你未处于虚弱状态，你获得 +1 生命值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Intimidation Novice.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You understand the fundamentals of how threats and coercion can achieve desired outcomes. You gain the Novice rank in the Intimidation skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to use simple displays of violence or overt threats to get others to follow your lead, but you aren't very subtle.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你理解威胁与胁迫如何能够达成期望结果的基本原理。你在威吓技能上获得新手等级，且不再被视为该技能的未受训状态。

你知道如何通过简单的暴力展示或公开威胁来让他人听从你的引导，但你并不擅长隐晦行事。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Athletics Journeyman.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Athletics skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你的运动技能获得熟练工等级，并获得+1 技能加值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Sundering Strike.actions.sunderingStrike.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make a Strike with your mainhand weapon which, if successful, applies the Exposed condition to your target for 3 rounds. This attack is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用你的主手武器进行一次打击；若成功，则会使目标陷入暴露状态，持续 3 轮。此次攻击困难，且造成的伤害降低。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Pyromancer.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[burning] on Critical Hits.

The Burning effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Intellect score as Fire damage to both Health and Morale.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织火焰符文。使用该符文的法术在暴击时会造成 @状态[burning]。

燃烧效果持续 1 轮，并对生命值和士气造成等同于你的智力数值的火元素伤害。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Agnath.items.Gesture: Blast.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with 6 feet radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量猛掷到附近一个你能看见的点上，引发一场强烈的能量爆破。

爆破手势随智力而成长，并在施法者60英尺内的一个点上制造一次半径6英尺的爆破。若目标未能抵抗该法术，爆破会造成8基础伤害。此手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋当前位于一个第4阶节点上。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Diversionist.actions.distract.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你对 30 尺内一个能看见或听见你的目标发动一次基于欺瞒的技能攻击，对抗其意志防御。成功时，该目标失去1 专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Counter Evade.actions.counterEvade.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: When you defend against a melee attack with a Dodge, you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 当你以闪避来防御一次近战攻击时，你可以消耗专注，用你的主手武器进行一次减耗的打击作为反击。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Light Weapon Training.actions.lunge.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你敏捷地向前窜出，以突然而出其不意的迅捷发动一次打击，使用一件以敏捷为加值属性的武器，对单个目标进行一次打击，其射程增加+2 feet。

此次攻击为困难，但你不会从当前位置移动，且此次攻击不会引发脱离接战。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Antitoxin.actions.antitoxin.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Consuming this @ref[name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
服用此@ref[name]能够中和影响目标的任何@状态[中毒]状态。更强的毒药需要更强的抗毒剂才能中和。

此@ref[name]可抵消的毒药类别取决于其品质：

  • 粗制滥造 - 每轮造成 3 点伤害或更少的毒药

  • 标准 - 每轮造成 5 点伤害或更少的毒药

  • 精制 - 每轮造成 7 点伤害或更少的毒药

  • 优异 - 每轮造成 9 点伤害或更少的毒药

  • 大师工艺 - 每轮造成 11 点伤害或更少的毒药

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Poison Vial.actions.poisonIngest.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[poisoned].

The amount of poison damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 4 rounds

  • Standard - 4 damage for 6 rounds

  • Fine - 6 damage for 8 rounds

  • Superior - 8 damage for 10 rounds

  • Masterwork - 10 damage for 12 rounds

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
当这种毒素被摄入或以其他方式进入某个生物的血液时，它起初是无害的，但目标必须针对其坚韧进行一次攻击防御，否则便会成为 @状态[poisoned]。

毒素造成的伤害量及其持续时间取决于 @ref[name] 的品质：

  • 粗劣 - 4轮内造成2伤害

  • 标准 - 6轮内造成4伤害

  • 精良 - 8轮内造成6伤害

  • 优异 - 10轮内造成8伤害

  • 大师级 - 12轮内造成10伤害

应在毒药被摄入时使用此动作，而不是在首次涂抹时使用。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Flash of Steel.actions.flashOfSteel.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make a Thrown weapon attack, targeting a weak point in your enemy's defences. If the attack hits, the target becomes Exposed until the start of their next Turn.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你进行一次投掷武器攻击，瞄准敌人防御中的弱点。若攻击命中，目标将变为暴露，直到其下个回合开始时。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Assassin.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You specialize in bringing death the the unwary. Any Strike or Spell attack against an Unaware target becomes Deadly.

An Unaware creature hit by your attack may not alert its allies until its own turn in Combat.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你专精于为毫无防备者带来死亡。任何针对未察觉目标的打击或法术攻击都会变为致命。

被你攻击命中的未察觉生物，在战斗中直到其自己的回合之前，都无法提醒其盟友。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Assassin.actions.markForDeath.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你花费1分钟研究一个生物。对你的目标进行一次知识检定。若成功，你会知晓目标易伤的所有伤害类型。在战斗第一轮中，你的最低先攻变为比你已标记目标的先攻高1。

You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a 知识检定 about your 目标. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the 目标 is Vulnerable. Your minimum 先攻 during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the 先攻 of your marked 目标.

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Belladonna.items.Backstab.actions.backstab.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You Strike with your mainhand weapon against a Flanked target, dealing Deadly damage.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用主手武器对一个处于夹击状态的目标进行打击，造成致命伤害。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Rallying Cry.actions.rallyingCry.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You emit a courageous bellow that inspires Allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of danger. You perform an Intimidation skill test against the Madness threshold of your allies. On a success, affected allies become @Condition[resolute] for one Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你发出一声充满勇气的怒吼，激励你12英尺内的盟友在危险面前保持坚强。你对盟友的疯狂阈值进行一次威吓技能检定。成功时，受影响的盟友获得 @状态[resolute] ，持续一轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Intimidation Novice.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You understand the fundamentals of how threats and coercion can achieve desired outcomes. You gain the Novice rank in the Intimidation skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to use simple displays of violence or overt threats to get others to follow your lead, but you aren't very subtle.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你理解威胁与胁迫如何达成预期结果的基本原理。你在威吓技能上获得新手等级，并且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。

你知道如何利用简单的暴力展示或公开威胁来让他人听从你的引导，但你并不十分巧妙。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Unarmed Combat Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical Strength. You are Trained with weapons in the Unarmed category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你熟悉基础武术与徒手战斗。你知道如何运用自身的体魄力量制服或压制对手。你在徒手武器类别上处于受训等级。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Unarmed Combat Training.actions.grapple.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你试图以肢体动作束缚或制服一名对手。对一个邻近目标进行一次运动技能攻击。若成功，你和目标双方都将陷入 @状态[受缚] 状态，持续 1 轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Athletics Novice.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You have received training in basic athletics. You gain the Novice rank in the Athletics skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know whether a surface can support your weight or not, how to find handholds while climbing, and how to distribute your weight for buoyancy when swimming. You know how to run for distance, and how to pace yourself to avoid exhaustion.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你已接受基础运动训练。你在训练运动技能中获得新手等级，并且不再被视为该技能的未受训。

你知道某个地表是否能够承受你的重量，知道攀爬时如何寻找抓手点，以及游泳时如何分配体重以获得浮你知道如何进行长跑，也知道如何调整节奏以避免力竭。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Shield Combat Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You are practiced at fighting with shield, using it to slam into and imbalance your foes. You are Trained with weapons in the Shield category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你擅长持盾作战，能用它猛撞敌人并使其失衡。你在盾牌类别的武器方面达到受训训练等级。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Shield Combat Training.actions.shieldBash.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: Following a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for one Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 在用你的主手武器进行一次基础打击后，你用你的盾牌打击，使目标陷入 @状态[staggered] 状态，持续一轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Shield Combat Proficiency.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of shields in combat. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Shield category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你在战斗中使用盾牌方面受过流利的教育。你获得熟练工训练等级，以及在盾牌类别武器上的+1技能加值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Healing Elixir.actions.healingElixir.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Immediately recover an amount of Health dependant on the quality of the elixir.

  • Shoddy - Immediately heals 6 Health.

  • Standard - Immediately heals 12 Health.

  • Fine - Immediately heals 24 Health.

  • Superior - Immediately heals 48 Health.

  • Masterwork - Immediately heals 96 Health.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
立即恢复相当于该灵药品质的生命值。

  • 粗制 - 立即恢复 6 点生命值。

  • 标准 - 立即恢复 12 点生命值。

  • 精良 - 立即恢复 24 点生命值。

  • 卓越 - 立即恢复 48 点生命值。

  • 大师级 - 立即恢复 96 点生命值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Duurath.items.Rune: Kinesis.actions.propel.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你对念动力符文的掌控使你能够对重力施加局部控制，以执行基础的念动操作，产生以下效果之一：

  • 将15英尺内一个未固定且重量不大于1的物体拉向你并接住它。由生物已装备或持有的物体，除非该生物自愿松手，否则绝不会被视为未固定。

  • 将一个你手持且重量不大于1的物体弹向一个最远30英尺外的目标。该物体会以中等速度笔直且准确无误地飞向该目标。物体飞行路径上的任何生物都可以作出反应来接住它，只要他们有一只空着的手即可。

  • 使一个你接触到、重量小于或等于你Presence10倍的物体或自愿生物悬浮在半空中，并将其位置从原本所在处向任意方向改变最多20英尺。只要你不再进行进一步的动作且未处于@状态[incapacitated]，你就可以无限期维持这种悬浮。

除非另有说明，推进只能影响你能够以身体实际接触到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人裁定。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Pinning Shot.actions.pinningShot.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你从远处进行打击。这次攻击是困难的，不过如果你的目标被其命中，则其会处于受拘束状态，直到其下个回合结束时。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Weak Points.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is @Condition[unaware], @Condition[flanked], or @Condition[exposed] using a weapon which scales with Dexterity, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你能识别出攻击敌人弱点的时机。当你使用一件以敏捷为成长属性的武器攻击处于@状态[未察觉]、@状态[夹击]或@状态[暴露]状态的目标时，你的任何打击都会获得 +2 伤害。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Projectile Weapon Proficiency.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of projectile weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Projectile category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你在使用投射武器方面受过熟练的训练。你获得熟练工训练等级，并在投射类别的武器上获得+1技能加值。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Diversionist.actions.distract.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你对30英尺内一个能够看见或听见你的目标的意志防御进行一次基于欺瞒的技能攻击。成功时，目标失去1专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Surgeweaver.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Lightning. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[shocked] condition on Critical Hits.

The Shocked effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Lightning damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织闪电符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[shocked] 状态。

电击效果持续1 轮，对士气造成你智力属性一半的闪电伤害，并施加 @状态[staggered] 状态。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Focused Anticipation.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: Anticipation leads to decisive action. When you have the highest Initiative score for a Round of combat, you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 预判带来果断行动。当你在一轮战斗中拥有最高的先攻值时，你获得+1 专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Eliorwen.items.Blast Flask.description.private
crucible.playtest.json.en: Primarily used to break apart large pieces of ore, these alchemical flasks pack a concentrated punch. If combined in a large enough quantity, they can also be used to create a chain reaction that results in larger explosions.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 这些炼金瓶子主要用于击碎大块矿石，威力十足。如果组合的数量足够多，它们也可用于引发锁链反应，从而造成更大的爆炸。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Rimecaller.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Frost. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[freezing] condition on Critical Hits.

The Freezing effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Wisdom score as Frost damage to Health, and applies the @Condition[slowed] condition.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织霜冻符文。使用此符文的法术在暴击时会造成@状态[freezing]状态。

冰冻效果持续1轮，对生命值造成相当于你感知属性一半的霜冻伤害，并施加@状态[slowed]状态。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Counterspell.actions.counterspell.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你将奥术能量塑造成一道对抗性的施法，目标为你在30尺内可见的一名施法者。

指定一个你已知的符文和手势，以尝试反制该法术。若你选择的符文与该法术所使用的某个符文相对立，则你的此次尝试获得+2恩惠。若你选择的手势与正在施放的手势完全相同，你的此次尝试也获得+2恩惠。

对你的目标的意志防御进行一次无害的法术攻击。若你的掷骰结果超过其防御，则该法术被反制，其魔法被消除，不产生任何效果。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Surgeweaver.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Lightning. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[shocked] condition on Critical Hits.

The Shocked effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Lightning damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织闪电符文。使用此符文的法术在暴击时会造成 @状态[shocked] 状态。

电击效果持续1 轮，对士气造成你智力值一半的闪电伤害，并施加 @状态[staggered] 状态。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Mesmer.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illusion. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[confused] on Critical Hits.

The Confused effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Psychic damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[disoriented] condition.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织幻象符文。使用该符文的法术在暴击时会造成@状态[confused]。

混乱效果持续1 轮，对士气造成你智力数值一半的灵能伤害，并施加@状态[disoriented]状态。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Rune: Kinesis.actions.propel.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你对念动力符文的掌控使你能够对重力施加局部控制，以执行基础的念动操纵，产生以下效果之一：

  • 将15尺内一个未固定且重量不大于1的物体拉向你并接住它。由生物已装备或持有的物体，除非该生物自愿放手，否则绝不视为未固定。

  • 将你手中一个重量不大于1的物体弹向一个最远30尺外的目标。该物体会以适中的速度沿直线准确无误地飞向该目标。物体路径上的任何生物都可以作出反应来接住它，只要他们有一只空闲的手即可。

  • 使你所触碰的一个物体或自愿生物悬浮于半空中，其重量小于或等于你Presence的10倍，并将其位置从原本所在处向任意方向改变最多20尺。只要你不再执行进一步的动作且未处于@状态[incapacitated]，你就可以无限期维持这种悬浮。

除非另有说明，推进只能影响你能够以身体实际接触到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试与上述类似的其他用途，其效果由游戏主持人裁定。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Rune: Frost.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
The orderly force of water and cold. The Frost rune governs the creation of water or other fluids and their transfer between liquid and frozen states.

The Frost rune scales using Wisdom, targets Fortitude, and deals Cold damage to Health. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Flame.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
水与寒冷的秩序之力。霜冻符文掌管水或其他流体的创造，以及它们在液态与冻结状态之间的转变。

霜冻符文以感知进行成长，目标为坚韧，造成寒冷伤害至生命值。它与混沌的火焰符文相对立。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Talisman Weapon Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你理解将护符、法珠、法器或其他类似器具用于引导魔法或强化施法的奥术用法。你对护符类别中的武器具有受训熟练等级。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Unshakeable Poise.actions.unshakeablePoise.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You expend Heroism to instantly recover your Wisdom in Focus. You may perform this action outside of your turn in Combat before making a Reaction.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你消耗英雄气概，立即在专注中恢复你的智慧。你可以在战斗中于自己回合之外、进行反应之前执行此动作。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Fizzit.items.Gesture: Conjure.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a Flame Visitor.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你将奥术力量凝聚为一种更高阶的形态，显现出一个访客，其会出现在30尺内，并以先攻 1加入战斗。你的访客是一个与你自身等级相同的仆从。

召唤手势随感知成长，且该访客会存续12轮。你同时只能拥有一个生效中的访客。施放另一个使用召唤手势的法术会替代你先前的访客。该手势需要2只手来施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

这个天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。当前为了测试，它被“提前”开放。

并非所有符文都已定义访客角色。尚未定义召唤物的符文目前都会显现为一个火焰访客。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Gesture: Ray.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You funnel the arcane power of a Rune into a point and project it outwards in a beam.

The Ray gesture scales using Wisdom and produces a line that is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 4 Action and 1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你将符文中的奥术力量汇聚于一点，并将其向外投射成一道光束。

射线手势以感知进行缩放，产生一条由施法者发出、宽1英尺且长30英尺的直线，对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成6基础伤害。该手势需要1只手来施放，基础消耗为4动作和1专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Conserve Effort.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your Turn with un-spent Action you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你会在战斗中节省精力的过程中找到平静与专注。当你在自己的回合结束时仍有未消耗的动作，你获得+1专注。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Healer.actions.fontOfLife.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You bring forth an aura of life-giving magic. Immediately upon activation and at the start of your turn for 3 Rounds every ally within 20 feet heals for an amount equal to your Wisdom score.

WIP: This action is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within the initial range. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this action will match the description.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你唤出一道赋予生命的魔法灵气。激活时立即生效，并且在3轮内每到你的回合开始时，20英尺内的每名盟友都会恢复等同于你感知属性值的生命值。

开发中：该动作目前被视为范围效果，会为初始范围内的对象赋予持续治疗效果。当灵气在 Foundry VTT 版本 14 中由系统自动化后，该动作的机制实现将与描述一致。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Dustbinder.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Earth. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[corroding] condition on Critical Hits.

The Corroding effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Wisdom score as Acid damage to Health each Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你非常擅长编织大地符文。使用该符文的法术在暴击时会造成 @状态[corroding] 状态。

腐蚀效果会持续3轮，并且每轮对生命造成等同于你的感知属性值的酸液伤害。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Talisman Weapon Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你理解如何运用护符、法珠、法器或其他类似器具来引导魔法或强化施法中的奥术用法。你对护符类别中的武器拥有受训熟练度。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Talisman Weapon Training.actions.refocus.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你使用已装备的护符，尝试重新获得一些专注。你对自己的振奋阈值进行一次无害的打击。

成功时，若使用的是单手护符，则恢复 +1 专注；若使用的是双手持用护符，则恢复 +2 专注。若大成功，恢复的专注量额外增加 +1。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Gesture: Pulse.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
将一个符文的奥术力量驱逐出去，形成以你为中心、随你向外扩散的半径效果。

脉冲手势按灵势进行缩放，产生一个半径10英尺的散发范围，对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。该手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Inspirator.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[inspired] condition on Critical Hits.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as additional Restoration to Morale.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织灵魂符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[inspired] 状态。

鼓舞效果持续1 轮，并额外对士气造成等同于你Presence数值的恢复。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Mender.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[mending] condition on Critical Hits.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom score as additional Restoration to Health.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织生命符文。使用此符文的法术在暴击时会施加 @状态[mending] 状态。

修补效果持续 1 轮，并将你的感知属性值作为额外的恢复施加到生命值上。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Rune: Soul.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
一种有序的创造与精神本质之力。灵魂符文支配着灵魂在生命与死亡之间的根本流转，并与智能、人格和心理健康等事务相关。

灵魂符文以 Presence 进行成长，能够提供士气的恢复，或造成由意志对抗的灵能伤害。它与混沌的湮灭符文相对。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Rune: Soul.actions.evoke.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你对灵魂符文的掌握使你能够促成基础形式的灵性影响，产生以下效果之一：

  • 使你自己或另一位自愿者重温其过去某一时刻的一段核心记忆，持续时间最长为一分钟，仿佛那是最近才发生的事。

  • 鉴定影响某人的一种负面灵性状态，例如 @状态[broken]、@状态[frightened]、@状态[confused] 或 @状态[insane]。

  • 与另一名自愿生物建立短暂的灵性连接，使其能够识别一个可由单个词语表达的概念。

引发的用途只能影响你自己或你能够以身体接触到的另一生物。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Kagura.items.Rune: Life.actions.bloom.description
crucible.playtest.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.playtest.json.cn:
你对生命符文的掌控使你能够刺激生物材料的生长并滋养身体的生命值，从而产生以下效果之一：

  • 培育 1 立方英尺的现有植物或真菌，使其迅速生长到健康、开花或可收获的状态。

  • 鉴定术影响某个生物的负面身体状况，例如 @状态[diseased]、@状态[poisoned]、@状态[bleeding] 或 @状态[weakened]。

  • 检验一份食物或饮品是否未受细菌、寄生虫或毒物污染。

绽放只能影响你能够以身体接触到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Ulfen.items.Unarmed Combat Training.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You are familiar with basic martial arts and hand-to-hand combat. You know how to subdue or restrain opponents using your physical Strength. You are Trained with weapons in the Unarmed category.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你熟悉基础武术和徒手战斗。你知道如何运用自身的身体力量制服或压制对手。你在徒手类别的武器上达到受训等级。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Ulfen.items.Unarmed Combat Training.actions.grapple.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你试图以身体力量限制或制服对手。对一个相邻目标进行一次运动技能攻击。若成功，你和你的目标都将陷入 @状态[受缚] 状态，持续 1 轮。

crucible.playtest.json.path: entries.Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor.actors.Ulfen.items.Heavy Weapon Training.actions.heavyStrike.description
crucible.playtest.json.en: You unleash a powerful Strike with your mainhand weapon. The attack is slower to execute, but is Empowered to deliver additional damage.
crucible.playtest.json.cn: 你用主手武器发动一次强力打击。这次攻击施展起来较为缓慢，但会被强化以造成额外伤害。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
When this toxin is ingested or otherwise enters the bloodstream of a creature, it is initially Harmless, but the target must defend an attack against its Fortitude or become @Condition[poisoned].

The amount of poison damage and its duration is dependent on the quality of the @ref[name]:

  • Shoddy - 2 damage for 4 rounds

  • Standard - 4 damage for 6 rounds

  • Fine - 6 damage for 8 rounds

  • Superior - 8 damage for 10 rounds

  • Masterwork - 10 damage for 12 rounds

This action should be used when the poison is ingested rather than when it is first applied.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
当这种毒素被摄入或以其他方式进入某个生物的血液时，它最初是无害的，但目标必须针对其坚韧进行一次攻击防御，否则会变为@状态[poisoned]。

毒素造成的伤害量及其持续时间取决于@ref[name]的品质：

  • 粗劣 - 4轮内受到2点伤害

  • 标准 - 6轮内受到4点伤害

  • 精良 - 8轮内受到6点伤害

  • 优异 - 10轮内受到8点伤害

  • 大师级 - 12轮内受到10点伤害

应在毒药被摄入时使用此动作，而非在其首次被涂抹时使用。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You specialize in bringing death the the unwary. Any Strike or Spell attack against an Unaware target becomes Deadly.

An Unaware creature hit by your attack may not alert its allies until its own turn in Combat.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你擅长为毫无防备者带去死亡。任何针对未察觉目标的打击或法术攻击都会变为致命。

被你攻击命中的未察觉生物，在战斗中直到其自己的回合前，都无法向其盟友发出警报。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你花费 1 分钟研究一个生物。对你的目标进行一次知识检定。若成功，你会得知该目标易受哪些伤害类型影响。在战斗第一轮中，你的最低先攻变为比你已标记目标的先攻高 1。

You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a 知识检定 about your 目标. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the 目标 is Vulnerable. Your minimum 先攻 during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the 先攻 of your marked 目标.

crucible.pregens.json.en: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你对30英尺内一个能看见或听见你的目标发动一次基于欺瞒的技能攻击，对抗其意志防御。若成功，目标失去1点专注。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You make a Thrown weapon attack, targeting a weak point in your enemy's defences. If the attack hits, the target becomes Exposed until the start of their next Turn.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你进行一次投掷武器攻击，瞄准敌人防御中的弱点。若攻击命中，目标会陷入暴露，直到其下个回合开始。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你灵巧地向前猛冲，以突然而出人意料的迅捷发动一次打击，对单个目标使用一把以敏捷进行成长的武器进行一次打击，且射程增加+2 feet。

此次攻击是困难的，但你不会从当前位置移动，且此次攻击也不会引发脱离接战。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You have a basic education in anatomy, physiology, and medicine. You gain the Novice rank in the Medicine skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You’ve learned the basics of treating common wounds and illnesses, and keep a running list of known alchemical and herbal compounds that can be used for treating particular illnesses. With a little time studying an injured, diseased, or otherwise ill individual you can perform a basic diagnosis and treat accordingly.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你接受过解剖学、生理学和医疗方面的基础教育。你在医疗技能中获得新手等级，并且不再被视为该技能的未受训。

你已经学会了治疗常见创伤和疾病的基础知识，并持续记录已知的炼金与草药化合物清单，这些化合物可用于治疗特定疾病。只要花一点时间研究一名受伤、染病或因其他原因生病的个体，你就能进行基础诊断并据此治疗。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
Consuming this @ref[name] is able to neutralize any @Condition[poisoned] conditions affecting the target. Stronger poisons require a stronger antitoxin to neutralize.

The category of poison negated by this @ref[name] depends on its quality:

  • Shoddy - Poisons dealing 3 damage or less per round

  • Standard - Poisons dealing 5 damage or less per round

  • Fine - Poisons dealing 7 damage or less per round

  • Superior - Poisons dealing 9 damage or less per round

  • Masterwork - Poisons dealing 11 damage or less per round
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
服用此@ref[name]能够中和影响目标的任何@状态[poisoned]状态。更强的毒药需要更强的抗毒剂才能中和。

此@ref[name]可抵消的毒药类别取决于其品质：

  • 粗制 - 每轮造成3点伤害或以下的毒药

  • 标准 - 每轮造成5点伤害或以下的毒药

  • 精制 - 每轮造成7点伤害或以下的毒药

  • 优质 - 每轮造成9点伤害或以下的毒药

  • 大师工艺 - 每轮造成11点伤害或以下的毒药

crucible.pregens.json.en: You are adept at entering and exiting the fray. When moving out of the Engagement radius of an enemy, that enemy has 2 Banes to any Disengagement Strike against you.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你很擅长进出战团。当你移出敌人的交战半径时，该敌人对你进行的任何脱离交战打击都会具有 2 个祸骰。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You have received training in the basics of stealth, infiltration, and subterfuge. You gain the Novice rank in the Stealth skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to use light and shadow to mask your presence, to distribute your weight when walking in order to move more quietly, and you have learned a few tricks of disguise in order to blend into a crowd. You can appear unsuspicious when surrounded by others, hide in a darkened room, and can move silently enough to avoid detection by the average person.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你已接受过潜行、渗透与诡计基础方面的训练。你在潜行技能上获得新手等级，且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。

你知道如何利用光线与阴影来掩饰自己的踪迹，如何在行走时分配自身重量以便更安静地移动，也学会了一些伪装技巧，好让自己融入人群之中。你能够在他人环绕时显得不惹人怀疑，藏身于昏暗的房间里，并且能够安静无声地移动到足以避开一般人的察觉。

crucible.pregens.json.en: Primarily used to break apart large pieces of ore, these alchemical flasks pack a concentrated punch. If combined in a large enough quantity, they can also be used to create a chain reaction that results in larger explosions.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 这些炼金瓶子主要用于击碎大块矿石，威力十足。若将足够数量的它们组合在一起，也可用来制造连锁反应，从而引发更大的爆炸。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你对30英尺内一个能够看见或听见你的目标发动一次基于欺瞒的技能攻击，对抗其意志防御。成功时，目标失去1专注。

crucible.pregens.json.en: Anticipation leads to decisive action. When you have the highest Initiative score for a Round of combat, you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 预判带来果断行动。当你在一轮战斗中拥有最高的先攻值时，你获得+1 专注。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你将符文之力注入一个移动之中，穿越物理与空间的边界。

踏步手势会随敏捷成长，并允许你沿一直线移动最多 20 英尺，其宽度等于你的体型。对该直线上的未能抵抗此法术的目标造成2 基础伤害。施放此手势不需要任何空闲的手，且其基础消耗为3 动作和1 专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋的移动部分尚未自动化，必须作为此法术的结果手动执行。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你从远处打击。然而，此次攻击是困难的；如果你的目标被它命中，则其会变为受缚，直到其下个回合结束。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of projectile weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Projectile category.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你在投射武器装备的运用方面受过娴熟的教育。你获得熟练工训练等级，并在投射类别的武器检定上获得+1技能加值。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You can loose a shot under pressure, although with decreased accuracy. You perform a Strike that is Difficult, but has a reduced Action cost.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你可以在压力下射出一击，不过精确度会降低。你进行一次打击，该次打击为困难，但其动作成本会降低。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Lightning. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[shocked] condition on Critical Hits.

The Shocked effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Lightning damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织闪电符文。使用此符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[shocked] 状态。

电击效果持续1 轮，对士气造成你智力属性一半数值的闪电伤害，并施加 @状态[staggered] 状态。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is @Condition[unaware], @Condition[flanked], or @Condition[exposed] using a weapon which scales with Dexterity, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你能识别出攻击敌人弱点的时机。当你使用依赖敏捷成长的武器攻击处于 @状态[unaware]、@状态[flanked] 或 @状态[exposed] 状态的目标时，你的任何打击获得 +2 伤害。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Athletics skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你在运动技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1技能加值。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You have received training in basic athletics. You gain the Novice rank in the Athletics skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know whether a surface can support your weight or not, how to find handholds while climbing, and how to distribute your weight for buoyancy when swimming. You know how to run for distance, and how to pace yourself to avoid exhaustion.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你已接受基础运动训练。你在运动技能中获得新手等级，并且不再被视为该技能未受训。

你知道某个地表是否能够承受你的重量，知道在攀爬时如何寻找手点，以及在游泳时如何分配你的重量以获得浮力。你知道如何进行长跑，以及如何控制自己的节奏以避免力竭。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You are drilled in performing sequences of melee attacks with rhythmic precision. When you Strike multiple times in sequence using a one-handed melee weapon you gain a stacking +1 Boon for each successive attack.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你经过严格训练，能够以富有节奏的精准度连续进行多次近战攻击。当你使用单手近战武器连续多次打击时，每一次后续攻击都会使你获得可叠加的+1 恩惠。

crucible.pregens.json.en: When you defend against a melee attack with a Parry, you may react and expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike which benefits from the Exposed condition.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 当你以招架对抗一次近战攻击进行防御时，你可以作出反应并消耗专注，以较低代价进行一次打击反击，并从暴露状态中受益。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with 6 feet radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量投掷到附近你能看见的一点，引发一场剧烈的能量爆炸。

爆裂手势会随智力成长，并在施法者60英尺内的一点为中心产生一个半径6英尺的爆炸范围。该爆炸会对未能抵抗此法术的目标造成8基础伤害。施放此手势需要2只手，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而提前开放。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[burning] on Critical Hits.

The Burning effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Intellect score as Fire damage to both Health and Morale.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织火焰符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[burning]。

燃烧效果持续1 轮，并对生命值和士气同时造成等同于你的智力值的火元素伤害。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Lightning rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Lightning rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Electrical damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
原始电能的混沌之力。闪电符文掌管电荷的积聚与释放来源。

闪电符文以 智力 进行成长，目标为 反射，造成 电击 伤害 至 生命值。它与秩序的 大地 符文相对。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你是一名奥术战士，能够在战斗中依靠武艺与奥术技巧，将打击与法术编织结合。你的武器装备所施展的物理打击，能够部分替代传统施法中的姿势手势。

当你以主手持用一把近战武器时，你使用手势：打击施放的法术可获得该武器的伤害加值。

在你以一把近战武器执行一次打击后，你可以立即施放一个其动作消耗减少 1 的法术。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You make a Strike with your mainhand weapon which, if successful, applies the Exposed condition to your target for 3 rounds. This attack is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你用你的主手武器进行一次打击；若成功，则对目标施加暴露状态，持续3轮。此次攻击困难施展，且造成的伤害降低。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your Turn with un-spent Action you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你会在战斗中节省精力时找到平静与专注。当你在回合结束时仍有未消耗的动作，你获得+1 专注。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Earth. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[corroding] condition on Critical Hits.

The Corroding effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Wisdom score as Acid damage to Health each Round.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织大地符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加@状态[corroding]状态。

腐蚀效果持续3 轮，并且每轮都会造成等同于你感知属性值的强酸伤害到生命值。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
将符文的奥术力量驱散为一个以你为中心、随你向外扩展的半径范围。

脉冲手势按Presence进行缩放，产生一个10英尺半径的散发区域，对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。该手势施放需要2只手，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前放置在一个第4阶节点上。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为测试目的而“提前”开放。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You are unparalleled at manipulating vital arcana to treat injuries. You learn Rune: Life if you do not already know it. When healing allies using the Rune of Life you gain +2 Boons to your roll.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你在操纵生命奥术以治疗伤势方面无人能及。若你尚未习得符文：生命，则你学会它。当你使用生命符文为盟友进行治疗时，你的掷骰获得+2恩惠。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You bring forth an aura of life-giving magic. Immediately upon activation and at the start of your turn for 3 Rounds every ally within 20 feet heals for an amount equal to your Wisdom score.

WIP: This action is currently treated as an Area of Effect, granting healing-over-time effects to those within the initial range. When auras are automated by the system in Foundry VTT version 14, the mechanical implementation of this action will match the description.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你释放出一道赐予生命的魔法灵气。激活时立即生效，并且在接下来的3 轮内，于你的每个回合开始时，20 尺内的每名盟友都会恢复等同于你感知属性值的生命值。

开发中：该动作目前被视为一个范围效果，为初始范围内的目标赋予持续治疗效果。当灵气在 Foundry VTT 第 14 版中由系统自动化后，该动作的机制实现将与描述一致。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[inspired] condition on Critical Hits.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as additional Restoration to Morale.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织灵魂符文。使用此符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[inspired] 状态。

鼓舞效果持续1 轮，并额外对士气造成等同于你的气场数值的恢复。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[mending] condition on Critical Hits.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom score as additional Restoration to Health.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织生命符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[mending] 状态。

修补效果持续1 轮，并额外对生命值施加等同于你的感知属性值的恢复。

crucible.pregens.json.en: Your strong will makes you exceedingly difficult to influence. You gain +1 to your Willpower defense and +5 resistance to Psychic damage.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你坚定的意志使你极难被影响。你的意志防御获得 +1，并获得对心灵伤害的 5 点抗性。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你对生命符文的命令使你能够刺激生物材料生长并滋养身体生命值，产生以下效果之一：

  • 培育 1 立方英尺的现有植物或真菌，使其快速生长到健康、开花或可收获的状态。

  • 鉴定术一种正在影响生物的负面身体状况，例如 @状态[diseased]、@状态[poisoned]、@状态[bleeding] 或 @状态[weakened]。

  • 确认一部分食物或饮品是否没有受到细菌、寄生虫或毒物的污染。

绽放只能影响你能够实际触碰到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
An orderly force of creation and spiritual essence. The Soul rune governs the fundamental procession of souls through life and death and relates to matters of sapience, personality, and mental health.

The Soul rune scales using Presence and provides Restoration of Morale or inflicts Psychic damage opposed by Willpower. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Oblivion.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
一种有序的创造与精神本质之力。灵魂符文支配着灵魂在生命与死亡间的基本流转，并与知性、人格及心理健康等事务相关。

灵魂符文以 Presence 进行成长，能够提供 恢复 以恢复士气，或造成由 意志 抵抗的 灵能 伤害。它与混沌的 湮灭 符文相对立。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.pregens.json.cn:
你对灵魂符文的掌控使你能够促成基础形式的灵性影响，产生以下效果之一：

  • 使你自己或另一名自愿者重温其过去某一时刻的核心记忆，持续时间最多为一分钟，仿佛那是最近才发生的事。

  • 鉴定影响某人的一种负面灵性状态，例如 @状态[broken]、@状态[frightened]、@状态[confused] 或 @状态[insane]。

  • 与另一名自愿的生物建立短暂的灵性连接，使其能够辨认一个可以用单个词语表达的想法。

引发的用途只能影响你自己或你能够以身体接触到的另一名生物。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人裁定。

crucible.pregens.json.en: After defeating an enemy, you may move up to your Stride and attack another foe within melee range.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 击败一个敌人后，你可以移动至多等同于你的步幅距离，并攻击另一个处于近战范围内的敌人。

crucible.pregens.json.en: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 你尝试以身体压制或制服一名对手。对一个邻近目标进行一次运动技能攻击。若成功，你和你的目标均陷入 @状态[受缚] 状态，持续 1 轮。

crucible.pregens.json.en: Following a basic Strike attack which did not critically miss, you Strike the same target again with the backswing of your weapon at reduced Action cost.
crucible.pregens.json.cn: 在一次未严重失误的基础打击之后，你以较低的动作消耗用武器的回摆再次打击同一目标。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.

你对念动力符文的掌控使你能够对重力施加局部控制，以进行基础的念动力操控，产生以下效果之一：

  • 将15英尺内一个未固定且重量不大于1的物体拉向你并接住。由生物已装备或持有的物体，除非该生物自愿放手，否则绝不会被视为未固定。

除非另有说明，推进只能影响你能够实际触碰到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人裁定。

crucible.pregens.json.en:
The chaotic force of raw electrical energy. The Lightning rune governs sources of electrical charge and discharge.

The Lightning rune scales using Intellect, targets Reflex, and deals Electrical damage to Health. It is opposed by the orderly rune of Earth.

原始电能的混沌之力。闪电符文掌管电荷的积聚与释放之源。

你已接受过情境察觉的基础训练，能够注意到环境中的重要细节。你获得察觉技能的新手等级，并且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。
