crucible.rules.json.en:
Crucible is an innovative and modern role-playing game (RPG) system built exclusively for Foundry Virtual Tabletop as a digital platform.

Crucible is designed from the ground up to leverage the unique capabilities of Foundry Virtual Tabletop to create exciting and fast-paced gameplay that allow gamemasters and players to focus on what matters most: telling a compelling story.

At the heart of Crucible is meaningful and empowering character advancement through a class-less system with multiple pillars of character progression. The system’s dice mechanics allow for crunchy and tactically rich encounters featuring combat, exploration, or social challenges.

Crucible is both a role-playing game and a software engine. The game system offers a deep level of mechanical sophistication, but its rules are entirely encoded to be applied with consistency and automation. The system is built intentionally to eliminate the cumbersome bookkeeping that is prevalent in high-crunch pen-and-paper systems.

Development Status

Crucible is currently under development and available as a playtest, providing the community with an opportunity to experience the system, its design pillars, and intended direction. The system is functional in many areas, but still a work in progress. Some areas are not yet developed at all. This playtest offers a chance for us to collect early feedback and share our work with the community. Please approach it with an open mind and an understanding that what you are seeing is not yet a finished product.

Blocks like this one in the system documentation highlight areas of the system that still require substantial development. These are intended to make you aware of areas that are intentionally unfinished at this time.

Development of Crucible is two-pronged with an equal focus on developing the system mechanics of the roleplaying game and the software implementation of those mechanics simultaneously. As the game mechanics evolve, new developments of the game system will enable those features for use in testing. The playtest process allows us to solicit and benefit from feedback that helps us iterate on the game rules and the user experience in Foundry Virtual Tabletop.

Current Playtest

The @UUID[Compendium.crucible.playtest.Adventure.F8AILycmdj2kuOVa]{Playtest 1 - The Ring of Valor} adventure is included with the Crucible game system and provides an introduction to @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{Character Creation} and @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c]{Combat Encounters}. This playtest covers character creation, dice mechanics, combat encounters, and level advancement. It begins at level 1 and advances characters through level 6, allowing them to evolve and advance between each challenge.

Please note that the rules and mechanics featured in the Crucible playtest are not final and will continue to be refined during ongoing development.

Ember

There is far more Crucible content available as part of our original setting and epic adventure Ember, a digital roleplaying game from the creators of Foundry Virtual Tabletop. Ember is available now in Early Access and features an immersive open-world campaign for Crucible spanning several years of gameplay, taking your party from character level 1 to 12 (or beyond).
crucible.rules.json.cn:
Crucible 是一个创新且现代的角色扮演游戏（RPG）系统，专为 Foundry Virtual Tabletop 这一数字平台打造。

Crucible 从零开始设计，旨在利用 Foundry Virtual Tabletop 的独特能力，创造令人兴奋且节奏明快的游戏体验，让游戏主持人和玩家能够专注于最重要的事情：讲述一个引人入胜的故事。

Crucible 的核心在于通过一个无职业系统和多个角色进阶支柱，实现有意义且能赋予玩家自主性的角色晋升。该系统的骰子机制支持扎实且富有战术深度的遭遇，涵盖战斗、探索或社交挑战。

Crucible 既是一款角色扮演游戏，也是一个软件引擎。这个游戏系统在机制层面提供了很高的深度，但其规则都已被完整编码，以便一致且自动化地应用。该系统被有意构建为消除高复杂度纸笔系统中常见的繁琐记录工作。

开发状态

Crucible 目前仍在开发中，并以试玩测试形式提供，让社区有机会体验该系统、其设计支柱以及预期方向。该系统在许多方面已经可以运行，但仍属开发中。有些部分甚至尚未开始开发。此次试玩测试让我们有机会收集早期反馈，并与社区分享我们的工作。请以开放的心态来体验，并理解你所看到的内容还不是最终成品。

系统文档中像这样的区块，用于标示系统中仍需大量开发的部分。其目的是让你了解哪些区域目前是有意保持未完成状态的。

Crucible 的开发采取双轨并行的方式，同时以同等重点推进角色扮演游戏的系统机制开发，以及这些机制的软件实现。随着游戏机制的演进，游戏系统的新开发内容将使这些功能能够用于测试。试玩测试流程让我们能够征求并受益于反馈，从而帮助我们迭代游戏规则以及 Foundry Virtual Tabletop 中的用户体验。

当前试玩测试

Crucible 游戏系统附带了 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.playtest.冒险.F8AILycmdj2kuOVa]{试玩测试 1 - 英勇之戒} 冒险，并提供对 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{角色创建} 和 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c]{战斗遭遇} 的介绍。此次试玩测试涵盖角色创建、骰子机制、战斗遭遇和升级。它从 1级 开始，并让角色一路提升至 6级，使他们能够在每次挑战之间成长并晋升。

请注意，Crucible 试玩测试中展示的规则和机制尚未最终确定，并将在持续开发过程中继续加以完善。

余烬

作为我们原创设定与史诗冒险 余烬 的一部分，还有更多 Crucible 内容可供体验。这是由 Foundry Virtual Tabletop 创作者打造的一款数字角色扮演游戏。余烬 现已推出抢先体验版本，包含一个适用于 Crucible、沉浸式的开放世界战役，跨度达数年游戏流程，可带领你的队伍从角色 1级 成长至 12级（甚至更高）。

crucible.rules.json.en:
A goblin desperately thrusts at an armored human with its damaged, dull blade. An enchanter wishes to haggle with a merchant she has magically charmed. A soldier swings his hammer at the head of a dazed, concussed ogre. When performing a check, a character may find some favorable circumstances shift the odds in their favor. Other disadvantageous circumstances will hinder a character's odds of success.

Circumstances which apply beneficial or detrimental forces upon the likelihood of a check being successful are represented as Boons and Banes, respectively. The number of boons and banes to be applied to a roll are determined before a roll is made, as they directly affect the composition of the dice pool that is used. A single dice pool roll can have no more than 6 boons and 6 banes affecting it.

Boons

Each Boon applied to the check increments the denomination of the first die in the pool by +2, to a maximum of d12. If a die is already a d12 due to other boons, the increase is applied to the next die in the pool. In practical terms, boons upgrade dice making them bigger and more effective.

Banes

Each Bane applied to the check decrements the denomination of the last die in the pool by -2, to a minimum of d4. If a die is already a d4 due to other banes, the decrease is applied to the next die in the pool. In practical terms, banes downgrade dice making them smaller and less effective.

Mitigating Circumstances

Because boons and banes start at opposite ends of the dice pool, they can both affect changes to the same roll. For example, a check made with with 2 Boons and 2 Banes would result in a dice pool of 1d12 + 1d8 + 1d4. If more than four Boons and more than four Banes are present their effects will begin to cancel each other out.

Example: Added Boons

Suppose Albert, a naval captain, has his ship boarded by pirates. By fortunate circumstance, the fierce rocking of the ship has toppled one of the invaders over on the deck of his ship. Advancing towards the sprawling pirate, Albert draws his blade and slashes down upon the unwelcome guest. Attacking a Prone creature confers 2 boons to Albert's attack roll.

These two boons upgrade the first die in the 3d8 dice pool twice, from a d8 to a d12, resulting in a dice pool of 1d12 + 1d8 + 1d8.

Boons or banes resulting from @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleConditio]{Conditions} like Prone will be handled automatically by layers of automation in the Crucible software, but additional boons may always be awarded by the Gamemaster prior to any roll as ways to reward players for creative problem solving or inspirational roleplay.

Example: Both Boons and Banes

Dariel is an intrepid outdoorswoman with the Journeyman rank in Survival with a Herbalist specialization. She wishes to identify a herb that may be used to treat poison after an arduous day of traveling. Her specialization as a Herbalist gives her 1 Boon to the roll to identify the correct herb, but her state of exhaustion gives her 2 Banes to her roll. The boon upgrades the first die in the pool to a d10, and the two banes downgrade the third die to a d4, resulting in a dice pool of 1d10 + 1d8 + 1d4.

Mathematically, each Boon increases the expected result of its die by 1 and each Bane decreases the expected result of its die by 1.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
一名地精正拼命用它那把已受损、钝掉的刀刃刺向一名身披护甲的人类。一名附魔师想与一位被她用魔法魅惑的商人讨价还价。一名士兵挥动他的锤，砸向一头昏沉且脑震荡的食人魔头部。在进行一次检定时，角色可能会发现某些有利情势会让胜算偏向自己。其他不利情势则会妨碍角色成功的几率。

会对一次检定成功可能性施加有利或不利影响的情势，分别以恩惠与祸骰表示。一次掷骰要应用多少恩惠与祸骰，必须在掷骰前决定，因为它们会直接影响所使用骰池的构图。单次骰池掷骰受到的恩惠与祸骰影响都不能超过 6 个。

恩惠

每个施加于检定的恩惠，都会使骰池中第一个骰子的面值提升 +2，最高至d12。如果某个骰子因其他恩惠已经是 d12，则这次提升会应用到骰池中的下一个骰子。实际来说，恩惠会升级骰子，使其更大也更有效。

祸骰

每个施加于检定的祸骰，都会使骰池中最后一个骰子的面值降低 -2，最低至d4。如果某个骰子因其他祸骰已经是 d4，则这次降低会应用到骰池中的下一个骰子。实际来说，祸骰会降级骰子，使其更小且更不有效。

情势抵消

由于恩惠与祸骰分别从骰池的两端开始生效，它们可以同时对同一次掷骰造成变化。例如，一次带有 2 个恩惠和 2 个祸骰的检定，将得到1d12 + 1d8 + 1d4的骰池。如果恩惠超过四个且祸骰也超过四个，它们的效果就会开始彼此抵消。

示例：增加恩惠

假设海军队长阿尔伯特的船遭到海盗登船袭击。幸运的是，船身剧烈摇晃，把其中一名入侵者掀翻在他船上的甲板上。阿尔伯特朝这名摊倒的海盗逼近，拔出刀刃，朝这位不速之客猛然劈下。攻击一个倒地的生物会给予阿尔伯特的攻击检定2 个恩惠。

这两个恩惠会将3d8骰池中的第一个骰子提升两次，从d8升到d12，最终形成1d12 + 1d8 + 1d8的骰池。

由 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleConditio]{状态}（如倒地）产生的恩惠或祸骰，将由 Crucible 软件中的自动化层自动处理；但在任何掷骰之前，游戏主持人始终都可以额外给予恩惠，以此奖励玩家富有创意的问题解决方式或富有感染力的角色扮演。

示例：同时有恩惠与祸骰

达丽尔是一位勇敢无畏的野外行家，在生存上拥有熟练工等级，并专精于草药学。经过艰辛跋涉的一天后，她想要鉴定一种可用于治疗中毒的草药。她作为草药师的专精使她在鉴定正确草药的掷骰中获得1 个恩惠，但她的力竭状态让她的掷骰承受2 个祸骰。这个恩惠会将骰池中的第一个骰子提升为d10，而这两个祸骰会将第三个骰子降为d4，最终形成1d10 + 1d8 + 1d4的骰池。

从数学上说，每个恩惠都会使其对应骰子的期望结果增加 1，而每个祸骰都会使其对应骰子的期望结果减少 1。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Initiative reflects your character's swiftness of mind and body - corresponding to how quickly you are able to act in a situation where time is of the essence. Your character's initiative during combat is determined by your Dexterity and Intellect attributes, any passive Initiative Bonus you may have, any situational bonus which allows you to react faster than usual, and an element of random chance.

Rounds and Turns

Each combat encounter is divided into Rounds and Turns. A Round refers to a single set of choices made by the characters in the encounter, where each character gets to act in an order defined by their Initiative. Each round loosely represents 10 seconds of real time, where 6 rounds of combat occur each minute of the encounter's duration. A Turn represents the actions taken by the one character whose turn it is to act in the initiative order.

Initiative Calculation

Your initiative is determined by:

Initiative

=

3d8[Boons,Banes] + ((Dexterity + Intellect) / 4)

A situational bonus to initiative could result from you getting the drop on an enemy, or benefiting from a magical spell which hastens your reactions, alternatively you could face a situational penalty to initiative if your reactions are dulled or slowed by alchemical or magical effects.

Each round of combat you have a pool of Action Points which you may elect to spend in various ways. If you are not immobilized or incapacitated, any unspent Action Points at the end of each round are defined as action reserves which each add a Boon to your Initiative roll for the following round.

Re-rolling initiative every round introduces greater tactical challenge for players who cannot rely completely upon always acting before or after the same foes each round of combat. Being able to convert unspent action points into an initiative bonus in the subsequent round can also promote creative tactical solutions to a variety of combat challenges.

Automatic Initiative

Since Initiative automatically updates every Round of combat, players do not roll for Initiative themselves. Instead this process is automated that every character's initiative roll is automatically performed in order to maintain a satisfying pace to combat encounters.

Incapacitated Combatants

Combatants who are Incapacitated or Dead are automatically placed at Initiative 0 and their turns come last in each Round.

Unaware Combatants

Combatants who are @Condition[Unaware] act at Initiative 1, last aside from Incapacitated creatures. Once a creature is no longer Unaware, it rolls Initiative and acts as normal for subsequent rounds.

Tiebreaking Procedures

Ties in initiative are resolved by applying the following tiebreaking criteria in order:

  1. Combatants with a higher passive Initiative bonus.

  2. Combatants with more maximum Action.

  3. Adversaries act before Heroes.

  4. Any remaining ties are placed in alphabetical order.

Escalation and Morale

As the tension of combat escalates - so too do the consequences on Morale for combatants. After 6 Rounds of Combat at the start of each subsequent round, the combatant with the highest Initiative result gains additional Morale equal to the numbered Round of combat. The combatant with the lowest Initiative result (excluding Incapacitated and Dead combatants) loses Morale equal to the numbered Round of combat.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
先攻反映了你的角色在心灵与身体上的敏捷程度——对应你在分秒必争的情境中能够多快采取行动。你的角色在战斗中的先攻由你的敏捷与智力属性、你可能拥有的任何被动先攻加值、任何让你比平时反应更快的情境加值，以及随机因素共同决定。

轮与回合

每场战斗遭遇都会分为轮与回合。轮指的是遭遇中角色们作出的一整组选择，其中每个角色都会按照其先攻所决定的顺序行动。每一轮大致代表现实时间中的 10 秒，也就是说在遭遇持续的每分钟中会进行 6 轮战斗。回合则表示在先攻顺序中轮到行动的那个角色所采取的动作。

先攻计算

你的先攻由以下内容决定：

先攻

=

3d8[Boons,Banes] + ((敏捷 + 智力) / 4)

先攻的情境加值可能来自你抢先敌人一步，或受益于能加快你反应的魔法法术；相对地，如果你的反应因炼金或魔法效果而变得迟钝或迟缓，你也可能承受先攻的情境减值。

在战斗的每一轮中，你都有一个可自由以各种方式花费的动作点池。如果你未被定身或失能，则每轮结束时任何未花费的动作点都被视为动作储备，并且每 1 点都会为你下一轮的先攻掷骰增加 1 个恩惠骰。

每轮重新掷先攻，会为那些无法完全依赖自己在每一轮战斗中总是先于或后于同一批敌人行动的玩家带来更大的战术挑战。能够将未花费的动作点转化为下一轮的先攻加值，也能鼓励玩家针对各种战斗挑战提出更具创造性的战术解法。

自动先攻

由于先攻会在战斗中的每轮自动更新，玩家无需自行为先攻掷骰。相反，这一流程是自动化的：系统会自动为每个角色进行先攻掷骰，以维持战斗遭遇中令人满意的节奏。

失能的战斗者

失能或死亡的战斗者会自动被置于先攻 0，并且他们的回合总是在每一轮的最后。

未察觉的战斗者

处于 @状态[未察觉] 的战斗者以先攻 1 行动，仅高于失能的生物。当一个生物不再处于 未察觉 时，它会掷先攻，并在后续轮次中如常行动。

平局裁定程序

先攻相同的情况按以下顺序应用裁定标准来解决：

  1. 被动先攻加值更高的战斗者优先。

  2. 最大动作更多的战斗者优先。

  3. 对手先于英雄行动。

  4. 若仍然平手，则按字母顺序排列。

升级与士气

随着战斗的紧张不断升级——战斗者在士气上承受的后果也会随之加剧。在战斗进行 6 轮后，从之后每一轮开始时起，先攻结果最高的战斗者获得等同于当前战斗轮数的额外士气。先攻结果最低的战斗者（不包括失能和死亡的战斗者）失去等同于当前战斗轮数的士气。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Movement is one of the most important actions that characters in Crucible will perform in combat.

Movement and positioning in Crucible uses a fine-grained 1 foot grid which provides excellent features like tactically significant movement and positioning, meaningful differences in creature sizes and weapon ranges, and intuitive areas of effect.

Distances in the Crucible system are defined in feet. The grid size of Scenes in Foundry Virtual Tabletop will be automatically adjusted to have a subgrid with distance units of 1 foot. Scenes must use a 5 foot grid size for the subgrid to display correctly.

Measurement distance is computed using the Exact √2 diagonal measurement mode.

Many combat actions a character can perform involve the Movement tag. Such actions allow you to move a certain number of feet up to or equal to your character's Stride attribute. The distance allowed by a Movement action cannot be broken up or interrupted. There is no leftover movement saved across actions if you move less than your Stride.

There are no facing mechanics in Crucible, meaning that it does not matter which direction your Token is facing on the map, your character is able to perceive and act in a full 360 degree radius unless otherwise limited by some special effect or condition.

Movement Cost Calculation

The Action cost of a given Movement is computed as follows:

  1. Distance is computed center-point to center-point, where the distance of diagonal movement is computed using the Exact √2 diagonal measurement mode.

  2. Effective Distance is compted by applying the following modifiers in order:

    1. Status Conditions are applied first, as described below.

    2. The effects of Terrain are applied second.

    3. Modifiers resulting from the Movement Type are applied.

  3. The Action cost of the movement is computed as:

Action Cost

=

ceil(Effective Distance / Stride)

  1. If a Free Move is available, the final Action Cost of the movement is reduced by 1.

Movement Conditions

The following Status Conditions affect the measurement and cost of movement.

Slowed

The Effective Distance traveled by any movement is doubled.

Hastened

The Effective Distance traveled by any movement is halved.

Restrained

Movement is impossible.

Movement Types

The following Movement Types are supported:

Walk

No change to Effective Distance.

Step

You move carefully, but your Effective Distance traveled is doubled.

Crawl

You move while Prone and your Effective Distance traveled is doubled.

Jump

Your Effective Distance traveled is doubled, but required by certain actions or to surmount certain obstacles.

Climb

Used while scaling vertical surfaces, your Effective Distance traveled is doubled.

Swim

Used while moving in waist-deep or deeper water, your Effective Distance traveled is doubled.

Fly

Used by creatures which can fly or hover. Movement while flying is faster than walking.

Blink

Magical teleportation that ignores terrain and movement cost entirely.

Free Movement

Each creature has the opportunity to perform one free Movement action per round of Combat. This means that the first Action performed each round which involves the Movement tag is discounted at -1 Action cost. This will typically make the action free to perform, but in some cases may simply reduce its overall cost.

Free Movement is not available to creatures that are @Condition[Weakened], @Condition[Prone], or @Condition[Slowed]. Creatures wearing Heavy armor also lose access to free Movement unless they have the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.armoredefficienc]{Armored Efficiency} talent.

Terrain

Difficult terrain increases the cost of movement while traversing it. Difficult terrain can be defined using Foundry VTT Scene Regions with the Modify Movement Cost behavior, which is fully integrated with Crucible movement cost computation.

Cover

Certain terrain or obstacles can be counted as Cover - providing additional protection from incoming Spell or Weapon attacks. When a direct single-target attack passes through such an obstacle, the target of the attack is in Cover. Cover is classified according to the following types:

Cover Type

Banes to Attacks

Complete Cover

Direct attacks not possible

Hard Cover

+4 Banes

Partial Hard Cover

+2 Banes

Soft Cover

+1 Banes

Area of effect attacks from abilities with target types like Cone, Blast, or Pulse ignore the effects of Cover.

Automation of cover detection and the resulting Banes is planned for a future update. For the time being, Banes added due to Cover should be applied manually when attack rolls are made.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
移动是角色在 Crucible 中于战斗里会执行的最重要动作之一。

Crucible 中的移动与站位使用精细的 1 英尺网格，这带来了许多优秀特性，例如在战术上具有重要意义的移动与站位、生物体型与武器射程之间有意义的差异，以及直观的效果区域。

Crucible 系统中的距离以英尺定义。Foundry Virtual Tabletop 中的场景网格大小将被自动调整，以拥有一个距离单位为1 英尺的子网格。场景必须使用5 英尺的网格大小，子网格才能正确显示。

测量距离使用精确 √2 对角测量模式计算。

角色可执行的许多战斗动作都带有移动标签。此类动作允许你移动一定数量的英尺，最多不超过你角色的步幅属性。一次移动动作所允许的距离不能被拆分或中断。如果你移动的距离少于你的步幅，不会有剩余移动保留到后续动作中。

Crucible 中没有朝向机制，这意味着你的棋子在地图上朝向哪个方向并不重要；除非受到某种特殊效果或状态限制，否则你的角色能够在完整的 360 度范围内感知并行动。

移动成本计算

一次给定移动的动作成本按如下方式计算：

  1. 距离按中心点到中心点计算，其中对角移动的距离使用精确 √2 对角测量模式计算。

  2. 有效距离通过按顺序应用以下修正来计算：

    1. 首先应用状态，如下所述。

    2. 其次应用地形的效果。

    3. 再应用由移动类型产生的修正。

  3. 该次移动的动作成本计算如下：

动作成本

=

ceil(有效距离 / 步幅)

  1. 如果可用免费移动，则该次移动的最终动作成本减少 1。

移动状态

以下状态会影响移动的测量与成本。

迟缓

任何移动所经过的有效距离翻倍。

加速

任何移动所经过的有效距离减半。

受缚

无法移动。

移动类型

支持以下移动类型：

行走

有效距离不变。

踏步

你谨慎地移动，但你所经过的有效距离翻倍。

匍匐前进

你在倒地时移动，且你所经过的有效距离翻倍。

跳跃

你所经过的有效距离翻倍，但某些动作或越过某些障碍时需要使用此移动类型。

攀爬

用于沿垂直表面移动时，你所经过的有效距离翻倍。

游泳

用于在齐腰深或更深的水中移动时，你所经过的有效距离翻倍。

飞行

供能够飞行或悬停的生物使用。飞行时的移动比行走更快。

闪现术

魔法传送，完全无视地形与移动成本。

免费移动

每个生物在每轮战斗中都有机会执行一次免费的移动动作。这意味着每轮中第一次执行且带有移动标签的动作，其成本会获得 -1 动作成本的减免。这通常会使该动作可以免费执行，但在某些情况下也可能只是降低其总成本。

@状态[虚弱]、@状态[倒地] 或 @状态[迟缓] 的生物无法使用免费移动。穿着重型护甲的生物同样会失去免费移动，除非其拥有 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.天赋.Item.armoredefficienc]{装甲效率} 天赋。

地形

困难地形会增加穿越其中时的移动成本。困难地形可以通过 Foundry VTT 的场景区域并使用修改移动成本行为来定义，这与 Crucible 的移动成本计算完全集成。

掩护

某些地形或障碍物可被视为掩护——为来袭的法术或武器攻击提供额外保护。当一次直接的单体攻击穿过此类障碍物时，该攻击的目标处于掩护中。掩护按以下类型分类：

掩护类型

攻击获得的祸骰

完全掩护

无法进行直接攻击

坚固掩护

+4 祸骰

部分坚固掩护

+2 祸骰

软掩护

+1 祸骰

来自目标类型如锥形、爆破或脉冲的能力的范围效果攻击会无视掩护的效果。

掩护探测及其产生的祸骰自动化计划在未来更新中实现。当前，因掩护而增加的祸骰应在进行攻击检定时手动应用。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Engagement describes the total number of opposing Combatants that you can simultaneously battle against without becoming more vulnerable. The base Engagement for Hero characters is 1, while the base Engagement for Adversary characters is equal to their Size - 2 with a minimum of 1.

When a character is adjacent to multiple enemies where the number of engaged enemies equals or exceeds their Engagement score, that character is said to be Fully Engaged. Some conditions or action prerequisites may only occur when a creature is Fully Engaged.

To help visualize how Engagement and Flanking mechanics works, there is a special toggle that can be used in the Tokens Layer of the Scene Controls UI on the left side of the screen. While enabled, the Engagement rectangles and flanked status of a creature will be visualized to help understand its current status.

Flanking

Flanking occurs when you and your allies team up to combat an opponent. When a creature is Engaged with a number of creatures greater than its Engagement score it has the Flanked condition. The Flanked condition has multiple stages, and each stage of Flanked contributes +1 Boon to attack rolls made against that creature.

Flanked Stage

=

Number of Engaged Enemies
- Engagement Score
- Engagement Bonus from Adjacent Allies

Krag, a heavily armored fighter, has an Engagement score of 3, with bonuses from his True Grit talent and from his Heater Shield with the Engaging property. Krag can engage with three opposing combatants simultaneously without them acquiring any Flanking bonus against him. However if Krag is surrounded by five Goblins, he would have the Flanked 2 condition and each Goblin's attacks would benefit from +2 Boons (5 engaged enemies - 3 Engagement).

While having more Engaged enemies increases your Flanked condition, having adjacent allies who are supporting you can nullify flanking. Allies contribute their own Engagement as a bonus to yours if you share enemies in common that you are both Engaged with.

Krag, from our previous example, is still surrounded by 5 Goblins and is Flanked 2. His ally Jinora comes to join the fray. Jinora has an Engagement score of 2. When Jinora moves next to Krag, and into a position where Jinora can engage at least 2 of the Goblins, Krag's Flanked condition is removed because Jinora's 2 Engagement adds to Krag's own Engagement score, allowing Krag to engage up to 5 enemies.

A status effect condition when a creature is Flanked is automatically computed and added whenever a character moves into or out of Engagement with other adversaries. The Flanked effect automatically applies the correct number of boons to attack rolls against the Flanked creature.

Disengagement

When an opponent attempts to disengage from you in melee combat it becomes temporarily vulnerable, allowing you to perform a Reactive Strike, a weapon attack as a Reaction. You may not make a Reactive Strike if you are @Condition[Unaware] or @Condition[Flanked] by other remaining opponents.

The Goblins in our previous example have decided that Krag is too tough and it is advisable to disengage in search of more vulnerable prey. Two of the four goblins may move away from Krag without reciprocity, because Krag is otherwise Fully Engaged and therefore cannot retaliate. When the third goblin moves away, however, Krag performs a Reactive Strike, burying his battle axe in the back of the retreating evildoer!
crucible.rules.json.cn:
交战描述的是你在不会变得更易伤的情况下，能够同时与之作战的敌对战斗者总数。英雄角色的基础交战为1，而对手角色的基础交战等于其体型 - 2，最低为1。

当一个角色与多个敌人相邻，且处于交战中的敌人数量等于或超过其交战值时，该角色被称为处于完全交战状态。某些状态或行动前置条件只有在一个生物处于完全交战时才会生效。

为了帮助直观显示交战和夹击机制的运作方式，屏幕左侧 Scene Controls 界面的 Tokens Layer中提供了一个特殊的切换选项。启用后，生物的交战矩形和被夹击状态将被可视化显示，以帮助理解其当前状态。

夹击

夹击发生在你与盟友协同对抗一名对手时。当一个生物处于交战中的生物数量大于其交战值时，它便具有夹击状态。夹击状态有多个阶段，且夹击的每个阶段都会使针对该生物进行的攻击检定获得+1恩惠骰。

夹击阶段

=

处于交战中的敌人数
- 交战值
- 来自相邻盟友的交战加值

Krag，一名身披重甲的战士，拥有3点交战值，这得益于他的真正的坚毅天赋以及带有Engaging属性的鸢形盾所提供的加成。Krag可以同时与三名敌方战斗者交战，而不会让他们获得任何对他进行夹击的加值。不过，如果Krag被五只哥布林包围，他将处于夹击 2状态，且每只哥布林的攻击都将获得+2恩惠骰（5个交战中的敌人 - 3点交战）。

虽然更多处于交战中的敌人会提高你的夹击状态，但有相邻盟友支援你时可以抵消夹击。如果你与盟友共同和相同的敌人处于交战中，那么盟友会将其自身的交战作为加值提供给你。

在我们前面的例子中，Krag仍被5只哥布林包围，并处于夹击 2状态。他的盟友Jinora加入了战斗。Jinora拥有2点交战值。当Jinora移动到Krag身旁，并进入一个能够让Jinora至少与其中2只哥布林交战的位置时，Krag的夹击状态被移除，因为Jinora的2点交战会加到Krag自身的交战值上，使Krag能够与最多5个敌人交战。

当一个角色移动进入或脱离与其他对手的交战时，生物处于夹击时的状态效果会被自动计算并添加。夹击效果会自动为针对该被夹击生物的攻击检定施加正确数量的恩惠骰。

脱离交战

当一名对手试图在近战中脱离与你的交战时，它会暂时变得易伤，从而让你能够进行一次反应打击，即以一个反应进行一次武器攻击。如果你处于@状态[未察觉]或被其他仍在场的对手@状态[夹击]，则你不能进行反应打击。

在我们前面的例子中，那些哥布林已经认定Krag过于难缠，因此建议脱离交战，去寻找更易伤的猎物。其中四只哥布林中的两只可以在不受回击的情况下远离Krag，因为Krag此时处于完全交战状态，因此无法反击。然而，当第三只哥布林撤离时，Krag发动了一次反应打击，将他的战斧劈进了那个撤退恶徒的后背！

crucible.rules.json.en:
An Attack Roll is performed by making a Standard Check tested against a certain Defense Score of the target creature. Attack Rolls are made when the effectiveness of an ability is evaluated in opposition to an opponent. Attack Rolls apply to weapon attacks, spell casts, healing abilities, and even some skill checks which are performed in combat.

The player whose character is performing the Attack is always the one to make the roll, while the effectiveness of the defending character or creature is based on their defense scores. The Attack Roll uses the same modified dice pool as a Standard Check, expressed as:

Attack Roll

=

3d8[+Boons, -Banes] + Ability Modifier + Skill Bonus + Enchantment Bonus

The 3d8 dice pool is modified by Boons and Banes. The ability modifier for the attack roll is determined by the scaling formula of the weapon type being used. The Skill Bonus for the attack roll is determined by the character's training in that particular weapon type. The Enchantment Bonus for the roll is determined by the magical properties (if any) of the weapon being used.

Determining Attack Outcomes

The attack is a hit if the result of the Attack Roll exceeds the Defense score of the target. If the result of the attack roll is less than the Defense score, the attack is ineffective. For attacks which target Physical Defense the nature of the miss (a Glance, Blocked, Dodged, or Parried) is further determined by the component Physical Defense scores of the target creature.

Overflow and Damage

The amount by which the Attack Roll exceeded the Defense score is called Overflow. This Overflow amount is multiplied by a Damage Multiplier which is usually 1, but occasionally higher or lower. Then any additive Damage Bonus is applied, and lastly any Resistance possessed by the target creature is subtracted from the result.

Overflow

=

Attack Roll - Defense Score

Damage

=

(Overflow × Damage Multiplier) + Damage Bonus - Target Resistance

While Damage Resistance is a powerful way for creatures to reduce incoming damage, such damage cannot be mitigated entirely. Abilities which deal direct (immediate) damage that surpass the target's Defense Score always deal at least 1 point of damage to their target Resource.

Abilities which deal indirect damage-over-time, however, can have the effects of that indirect damage reduced to zero by Resistance.

Critical Hits and Misses

If the Attack Roll exceeds the Defense Score by an amount greater than the attacker's Critical Hit Threshold (6 in most cases) it becomes a Critical Hit. Similarly if the Attack Roll is lower than the Defense Score by an amount greater than the attacker's Critical Miss Threshold (6 in most cases) it becomes a Critical Miss.

A Critical Hit does not directly increase the damage of an attack - although because of the way that Overflow contributes to total damage, Critical Hits always deal more damage than normal hits.

Critical Hits and Critical Misses present opportunities for other things to occur. Many talents allow your character to cause special effects when achieving a Critical Hit, or to react to an enemy if an incoming attack is a Critical Miss.

Critical Hit Effects

Zenith the Monk has both the Concussive Blows and Battle Focus talents. Zenith rolls a 29 on a Strike attack against a terrible Swamp Troll with a 19 Physical Defense. This attack results in a Critical Hit and as a result the Swamp Troll is Staggered because of the Concussive Blows talent and Zenith recovers +1 Focus because of the Battle Focus talent.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
目标攻击检定是通过进行一次针对目标生物特定防御的标准检定来完成的。当需要在与对手的对立中判定某项能力的效果时，就会进行攻击检定。攻击检定适用于武器攻击、施放法术、治疗能力，甚至一些在战斗中进行的技能检定。

进行攻击的角色其玩家始终负责掷骰，而防御方角色或生物的效果则取决于其目标防数。攻击检定使用与标准检定相同的修正骰池，表示为：

攻击检定

=

3d8[+恩惠骰, -祸骰] + 能力调整值 + 技能加值 + 附魔加值

Boons和Banes会修正3d8骰池。攻击检定的能力调整值由所使用武器类型的成长公式决定。攻击检定的技能加值由角色在该特定武器类型上的训练决定。此次掷骰的附魔加值由所使用武器的魔法属性（如果有）决定。

判定攻击结果

如果攻击检定结果高于目标的防御分数，则攻击命中。如果攻击检定结果低于防御分数，则攻击无效。对于以物理防御为目标的攻击，其未命中的具体性质（擦击、屏蔽、闪避或招架）还要根据目标生物的物理防御各组成分数进一步判定。

溢出与伤害

攻击检定超出防御分数的数值称为溢出。该溢出值会乘以一个伤害倍率，通常为1，但有时会更高或更低。然后再加上任何额外的伤害加值，最后从结果中减去目标生物拥有的任何抗性。

溢出

=

攻击检定 - 防御分数

伤害

=

(溢出 × 伤害倍率) + 伤害加值 - 目标抗性

尽管伤害抗性是生物减少所受伤害的一种强力方式，但这类伤害无法被完全减免。造成直接（立即）伤害且超过目标防御分数的能力，总会至少对目标的资源造成1点伤害。

然而，造成间接持续伤害的能力，其间接伤害的效果可以被抗性降低至0。

暴击与重失

如果攻击检定超出防御分数的数值大于攻击者的暴击阈值（多数情况下为6），则该攻击成为暴击。类似地，如果攻击检定低于防御分数的数值大于攻击者的重失误阈值（多数情况下为6），则该攻击成为重失误。

暴击不会直接提高攻击的伤害——不过，由于溢出会计入总伤害，暴击总是会比普通命中造成更多伤害。

暴击和重失误会为其他情况的发生带来机会。许多天赋允许你的角色在造成暴击时触发特殊效果，或在受到的来袭攻击为重失误时作出反应。

暴击效果

武僧Zenith同时拥有震荡重击和战斗专注天赋。Zenith对一只可怕的沼泽巨魔进行一次打击攻击时掷出了29，而这只沼泽巨魔具有19 物理防御。这次攻击造成了暴击，因此沼泽巨魔因震荡重击天赋而陷入踉跄，并且Zenith因战斗专注天赋而恢复+1 专注。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Reactions are a special type of Action which can only be taken on some other creature's turn in combat. Reactions have specific triggering conditions like you dodge a melee Strike attack or an ally you can see achieves a critical hit. Reactions require spending Action or Focus points, and therefore cannot be performed if you do not have the required resources - even if the condition for the reaction is otherwise met.

A creature is unable to perform Reactions if they are Unaware or Incapacitated.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
反应是一种特殊类型的行动，只能在战斗中其他生物的回合进行。反应具有特定的触发条件，例如你闪避一次近战打击攻击，或你能看见的一名盟友造成一次暴击。反应需要消耗动作点或专注点，因此如果你没有所需的资源，就无法执行反应——即使该反应的条件在其他方面已经满足。

如果一个生物处于未察觉或失能状态，则无法执行反应。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Crucible is designed to be a challenging combat experience which will require players to think tactically, work together, and effectively develop their characters' powers. Encounter balance in Crucible is managed using several fundamental levers.

  1. Convenient scaling of Adversary Level and Threat rating which makes adjusting difficulty for differing party levels or sizes relatively easy to do.

  2. The secondary Wounds and Madness pools that hero characters uniquely have which accumulate and absorb variance due to bad luck.

  3. The Gamemaster, who plays a pivotal role in interpreting the storytelling needs for each combat moment.

Balancing Encounters

Encounters in Crucible are typically balanced such that the cumulative Threat of all enemies is equal to the cumulative Threat of hero characters plus any allied non-player characters. The ease of adjusting the Level or Threat of an @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.v1dqTT3NI35lFNxM.JournalEntryPage.WH0YSVcYo09aHNZ2]{adversary } makes it easy to adjust an encounter to this point of balance ahead of time.

Encounters balanced in this way have an approximately 50% chance of going in the party's favor and a 50% chance of going in the enemies' favor. This does not mean that the party "loses" or "dies" half the time, but rather in 50% of balanced encounters the party will suffer some number of Wounds.

Wounds Regulate Luck 

The accumulation of these Wounds is something that the heroes must manage over the course of multiple encounters or days. Since adversaries do not have Wounds, only Health this is an intentional advantage in favor of Hero characters.

In any single balanced encounter if the heroes get lucky or play well, they will win without suffering any Wounds. If the heroes play poorly or experience bad luck, they will probably still win but suffer Wounds in the process. Wounds are a mechanism to regulate swings in luck while also requiring the party to be effective combatants most of the time.

The Role of the Gamemaster

Lastly, the Gamemaster plays a pivotal role in ensuring the fun and balance of combat. Enemies in Crucible are generally optimized such that they can be very effective at their main combat style. This is done because we assume that player characters are also designed and progressed with — to at least some extent — combat effectiveness in mind.

It is not a goal of Crucible to require that every player character be maximally optimized or that every decision in combat be one that optimizes for victory rather than advancing the story being told. It is therefore important that the Gamemaster to calibrate the optimization of their own play to match the party and the needs of the storytelling moment.

Adversaries in Crucible can and should be fallible in the decisions that they make. Enemies can, and often should, spend their Action and Focus in combat on actions that maintain tension and stakes while prioritizing the needs of the story rather than actions that specifically optimize to defeat the heroes.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
Crucible 的设计目标是提供一种具有挑战性的战斗体验，要求玩家进行战术思考、协同合作，并有效发展角色的能力。Crucible 中遭遇的平衡通过几个基本杠杆来管理。

  1. 对手的等级与威胁评级可方便地进行成长调整，从而相对容易地根据不同队伍的等级或规模来调整难度。

  2. 英雄角色独有的次级创伤与疯狂池，它们会累积，并吸收因运气不佳带来的波动。

  3. 游戏主持人，其在诠释每个战斗时刻的叙事需求方面扮演着关键角色。

平衡遭遇

Crucible 中的遭遇通常会被平衡为：所有敌人的累计威胁等于英雄角色加上所有盟友非玩家角色的累计威胁。由于可以方便地调整某个 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.v1dqTT3NI35lFNxM.JournalEntryPage.WH0YSVcYo09aHNZ2]{对手 }的等级或威胁，因此很容易预先将遭遇调整到这一平衡点。

以这种方式平衡的遭遇，大约有 50% 的概率对队伍有利，也有 50% 的概率对敌人有利。这并不意味着队伍有一半时间会“失败”或“死亡”，而是说在 50% 的平衡遭遇中，队伍会承受一定数量的创伤。

创伤用于调节运气

这些创伤的累积，是英雄们必须在多场遭遇或数日过程中管理的内容。由于对手没有创伤，只有生命值，这是刻意给予英雄角色的一项优势。

在任何一场单独的平衡遭遇中，如果英雄们运气好或发挥出色，他们将在不承受任何创伤的情况下获胜。如果英雄们表现不佳或遭遇坏运气，他们很可能仍然会获胜，但会在过程中承受创伤。创伤是一种用于调节运气波动的机制，同时也要求队伍在大多数时候都能成为高效的战斗者。

游戏主持人的角色

最后，游戏主持人在确保战斗的乐趣与平衡方面扮演着关键角色。Crucible 中的敌人通常都经过优化，使其在自身主要的战斗风格上能非常高效。这么做是因为我们假定玩家角色在设计与成长过程中，也至少在一定程度上会以战斗效能为考量。

Crucible 的目标并不是要求每个玩家角色都必须经过最大化优化，也不是要求战斗中的每个决定都必须以胜利最优化为目标，而不是推动当前讲述的故事。因此，游戏主持人应当根据队伍的情况以及当前叙事时刻的需求，校准自己操作的优化程度。

Crucible 中的对手可以，也应该在其决策上有失误。敌人在战斗中可以，而且往往也应该，将其动作和专注花在那些能够维持紧张感与利害关系、并优先服务于故事需求的行为上，而不是专门以击败英雄为最优目标的行为。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Ancestry classifies the biology and physiology of a character in Crucible. Fantasy settings may feature a spectrum of species which are playable as characters. Crucible supports defining Ancestries for each of these options which are narratively and mechanically appropriate for your own game.

Creating Ancestries

Crucible is not designed for a specific game setting. Gamemasters are encouraged to create or modify Ancestries to fit the lore of their own worlds. To configure an Ancestry in Crucible, create a new Item with the Ancestry type. Fill out the Ancestry configuration sheet to select a primary Ability score, a secondary Ability score, and optionally Resistance and Vulnerability to two different damage types. Every Ancestry may either have both a Resistance and a Vulnerability, or neither.

Each Ancestry includes:

  • A Primary Ability Score (which begins at 3)

  • A Secondary Ability Score (which begins at 2)

  • A Size value in grid spaces (typically 4)

  • A Stride value in grid spaces that determines the starting movement speed (typically 10)

  • Optional: A Damage Resistance to a certain type of damage (+3 resistance) — If a Damage Resistance is selected, a Damage Vulnerability MUST be selected.

  • Optional: A Damage Vulnerability to a certain type of damage (-3 vulnerability) — If a Damage Vulnerability is selected, a Damage Resistance MUST be selected.

  • An Ancestral Talent which grants a specific special ability or knowledge to a character of that ancestry.

Included Ancestries

Flexible Ancestry

Crucible allows use of custom ancestries by providing a way for GMs to configure their own compendium packs to use as a source during character creation. To add your compendium as a source, go to Configure Settings ➤ Crucible ➤ Configure Compendium Sources.

Role-playing games inspire and thrill us with tales of heroes who are exceptional and unique. Biological traits do not guarantee physical attributes, nor are species meant to be homogenous or monolithic (unless narratively intended). Gamemasters are empowered and encouraged to modify or customize Ancestries to suit the stories they and their players wish to tell. Consider Ancestral traits as suggestions rather than requirements.

Alex (a player) intends to roleplay as an Orc who, at the beginning of their journey, is not particularly tough but instead unusually wise. In such cases the initial Ability Scores of 3 Strength and 2 Toughness that the example Orcish Ancestry provides are at odds with the character development Alex desires. The Gamemaster can work with Alex to create a variation of the Orcish ancestry which offers different starting Ability Scores, for example by swapping the Primary Ability from Strength to Wisdom.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
血统用于界定 Crucible 中角色的生物学与生理特征。奇幻设定中可能会有各种可供玩家扮演为角色的种族。Crucible 支持为这些选项分别定义在叙事和机制上都适合你自己游戏的血统。

创造血统

Crucible 并不是为某个特定游戏设定而设计的。鼓励游戏主持人创建或修改血统，以契合自己世界的背景。要在 Crucible 中配置一种血统，请创建一个新的物品，并将其类型设为血统。填写血统配置表，选择一个主属性、一个副属性，并可选地选择两种不同伤害类型的抗性与易伤。每一种血统要么同时拥有抗性与易伤，要么两者都没有。

每种血统包括：

  • 一个主属性值（初始为 3）

  • 一个副属性值（初始为 2）

  • 一个以网格为单位的体型数值（通常为 4）

  • 一个以网格为单位的跨步数值，用于决定初始移动速度（通常为 10）

  • 可选：对某种伤害类型具有伤害抗性（+3 抗性）——如果选择了伤害抗性，则必须选择一种伤害易伤。

  • 可选：对某种伤害类型具有伤害易伤（-3 易伤）——如果选择了伤害易伤，则必须选择一种伤害抗性。

  • 一个祖裔天赋，赋予该血统角色某种特定的特殊能力或知识。

内置血统

为了试玩测试，Crucible 提供了以下这些典型奇幻角色扮演设定中常见的血统。以下表格展示了初始试玩测试中提供的一组示例血统：

Crucible 允许使用自定义血统，为此它提供了一种方式，让游戏主持人能够配置自己的资料库包，使其在角色创建期间作为来源使用。要将你的资料库添加为来源，请前往配置设置 ➤ Crucible ➤ 配置资料库来源。

角色扮演游戏通过讲述卓越而独特的英雄故事来激励并震撼我们。生物学特征并不能保证身体属性，种族也不应被视为完全同质化或单一化的存在（除非叙事上有此意图）。游戏主持人可以并且应当对血统进行修改或自定义，以适应他们与玩家想要讲述的故事。请将祖裔特征视为建议，而非要求。

Alex（一名玩家）打算扮演一名兽人，而在其旅程开始时，这名角色并不算特别强健，反而异常睿智。在这种情况下，示例兽人血统所提供的初始3 力量与2 强健属性值，就与 Alex 希望的角色发展方向不一致。游戏主持人可以与 Alex 一起创建一个兽人血统的变体，提供不同的初始属性值，例如将主属性从力量改为感知。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Background defines the cultural upbringing, professional training, career to date, and other aspects of a hero's past before the events of the game's story. These are intended to give depth to a character and some measure of explanation to the origins of their particular skillset and capabilities.

Creating a Background

Crucible is not designed for a specific game setting. Gamemasters are encouraged to create or modify Backgrounds to fit the lore of their own worlds. To configure a Background in Crucible, create a new Item with the Background type. Fill out the Background configuration sheet to select four acquired Skills which begin at Novice tier and one acquired Talent.

Each Background includes:

  • Novice Skills (typically 2)

  • Knowledge Areas (typically 2)

  • Known Languages

  • Talents (typically at least one weapon training talent and one additional talent)

Example Backgrounds

crucible.rules.json.cn:
背景定义了一位英雄在游戏故事事件发生之前，其过去所经历的文化成长环境、职业训练、迄今为止的事业，以及其他方面。这些内容旨在赋予角色更深度，并在一定程度上解释其特定技能组合与能力的来源。

创建背景

Crucible并非为某个特定游戏设定而设计。鼓励游戏主持人创建或修改背景，以契合他们各自世界的背景设定。要在Crucible中配置一个背景，请创建一个新的Item，并将其类型设为背景。填写背景配置表，选择四项习得的技能（初始为新手阶）以及一项习得的天赋。

每个背景包括：

  • 新手技能（通常为2项）

  • 知识领域（通常为2项）

  • 已知语言

  • 天赋（通常至少包括一项武器训练天赋和一项额外天赋）

crucible.rules.json.en:
Ability Scores approximate facets of a character's physical and mental capability. All dice checks in the Crucible system are modified by at least one ability score of the character performing the test. Ability Scores are also used to calculate a number of secondary attributes for your character, such as @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.Defenses00000000]{Defenses} and @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.Resources0000000]{Resource} pools.

The ability scores used in the Crucible system are described below, following a designed symmetry that is reflected both on the character sheet as well as in the talent tree. The six ability scores are further divided into physical attributes which describe bodily capabilities and mental attributes which describe cognitive or spiritual capabilities. The three ability scores within each division are classified as power, resilience, or quickness attributes.

Power Attributes

Strength (physical) and Wisdom (mental) are power attributes which describe capability to exert force.

Resilience Attributes

Toughness (physical) and Presence (mental) are resilience attributes which describe capability to withstand strain.

Quickness Attributes

Dexterity (physical) and Intellect (mental) are quickness attributes which describe capability to act swiftly.

Ability scores generally range from 1 to 12. A score of 2 or 3 would be typical for the median person inhabiting the game setting. A score of 1 indicates an area of weakness compared to the median, while a score of 12 or higher is reserved for supernatural entities or peerless heroes.

Some creatures may rarely have a score of zero in a particular ability score, denoting cases where a certain ability is not relevant for a particular creature. This alters the rules for that creature in a meaningful way, as described below.

Strength

Strength is a physical power attribute describing a creature's potency, brawn and might. Strength affects Fortitude defense, carrying Capacity, and the use of weaponry which scales with Strength. Each point of Strength increases base Health by 2.

Characters with high Strength are typically capable of feats of physical prowess. They may wield oversized or heavy weaponry, wear heavy suits of armor, or use their brawn to physically subdue their opponents.

Creatures with zero Strength are incapable of exerting physical influence on the world around them. They may not possess equipment nor can they physically interact with objects. They may not perform any Action which scales only using the physical ability scores of Strength, Toughness, and Dexterity.

Toughness

Toughness is a physical resilience attribute describing physical hardiness and tenacity. Toughness affects the Fortitude defense. Each point of Toughness increases base Health by 4.

Characters with high Toughness can typically withstand considerable physical strain, demonstrating both grit and endurance in demanding situations. They may thrive amidst the center of danger, using their tenacity to hold or break the frontlines of combat.

Creatures with zero Toughness are incorporeal or otherwise have no meaningful physical form. They have no Health pool and can become neither @Condition[weakened] nor @Condition[dead]. Any amount of Health they would have possessed contributes to their Morale pool instead. The creature becomes @Condition[incapacitated] if their Morale reaches zero.

Dexterity

Dexterity is a physical quickness attribute that reflects agility and precision of movement. Dexterity affects Initiative in taking action, the Dodge component of Physical Defense, Reflex defense, and the use of weaponry which scales with Dexterity.

Characters with high Dexterity typically act swiftly, favoring quickness and precision of movement over pure power. They may wield weapons that allow for nimble movement or offer ranged capabilities, seeking to outmaneuver their foes before they even get a chance to act.

Creatures with zero Dexterity are inherently sluggish or ponderous. Their Initiative is always zero and they may not perform any actions with the Reaction tag.

Wisdom

Wisdom is a mental power attribute describing a creature's force of conviction, depth of knowledge, and patience. Wisdom affects Willpower defense and size of Focus pool. Each point of Wisdom increases base Morale by 2.

Characters with high Wisdom typically act deliberately, demonstrating patience and judgment to intervene at the ideal moment where leverage is greatest. When they do act, they do so with conviction and commitment to their chosen path.

Creatures with zero Wisdom are non-sapient and incapable of exerting mental or spiritual influence on the world around them. They can neither obtain nor generate Heroism and they may not perform any Action which scales only using the mental ability scores of Wisdom, Presence, and Intellect.

Presence

Presence is a mental resilience attribute describing a creature's force of personality, resolve, and self-belief. Presence affects Willpower defense and the size of Focus pool. Each point of Presence increases base Morale by 4.

Characters with high Presence can inspire themselves and others to feats of great heroism, overcoming obstacles, in part, through the sheer belief that things are possible. The aura of such heroes can instill similar belief in allies or foment doubts in the minds of adversaries.

Creatures with zero Presence have no sense of self or meaningful cognitive form. They can neither influence the thoughts of others nor have their own behavior influenced. They have no Morale pool and can become neither @Condition[broken] nor @Condition[insane]. Any amount of Morale they would have possessed contributes to their Health pool instead.

Intellect

Intellect is a mental quickness attribute that reflects speed of thought and decisiveness of action. Intellect affects Initiative in taking action, the Reflex defense, and the size of Focus pool.

Characters with high Intellect are highly adaptable to various circumstances. They apply excellent problem solving and decision making skills to think on-the-fly and synthesize learned knowledge to guide decisive action. By anticipating and outwitting their opponent they can gain the upper hand in any conflict.

Creatures with zero Intellect lack the ability to concentrate or make rapid decisions. They have no Focus and cannot perform any action which requires it.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
属性值近似表示角色身体与心智能力的各个面向。在 Crucible 系统中，所有骰子检定都会受到执行该检定角色至少一项属性值的修正。属性值也用于计算角色的若干次级属性，例如 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.防御00000000]{防御} 和 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.资源0000000]{Resource} 池。

Crucible 系统中使用的属性值如下所述，它们遵循一种经过设计的对称结构，这种结构既体现在角色卡上，也体现在天赋树中。六项属性值进一步分为身体属性与精神属性，前者描述肉体能力，后者描述认知或精神能力。每个分类中的三项属性值又分别归类为力量、韧性或迅捷属性。

力量属性

力量（身体）和感知（精神）是力量属性，用于描述施加力量的能力。

韧性属性

坚韧（身体）和气场（精神）是韧性属性，用于描述承受压力的能力。

迅捷属性

敏捷（身体）和智力（精神）是迅捷属性，用于描述迅速行动的能力。

属性值通常介于 1 到 12。对于游戏设定中的普通人而言，2 或 3 的数值较为典型。1 表示该方面相较平均水平较弱，而 12 或更高则保留给超自然实体或举世无双的英雄。

某些生物在极少数情况下，某项属性值可能为 0，这表示该能力对该生物并不适用。这会以重要方式改变该生物适用的规则，具体如下所述。

力量

力量是一项身体力量属性，用于描述生物的威力、体魄与蛮力。力量影响坚韧防御、携带Capacity，以及使用那些随力量成长的武器装备。力量每提高 1 点，基础生命值提高 2 点。

高力量的角色通常能够完成体现身体优势的壮举。他们可以挥舞超大或重型武器装备，穿戴厚重护甲，或以蛮力在肉体上压制对手。

力量为 0 的生物无法对周围世界施加物理影响。它们不能拥有装备，也无法与物体进行物理互动。它们不能执行任何仅使用力量、坚韧与敏捷这些身体属性值进行成长的动作。

坚韧

坚韧是一项身体韧性属性，用于描述身体的强健与顽强。坚韧影响坚韧防御。坚韧每提高 1 点，基础生命值提高 4 点。

高坚韧的角色通常能够承受相当大的身体压力，在艰难处境中展现毅力与耐力。他们可能在危险中心依然游刃有余，以顽强意志固守或击破战斗前线。

坚韧为 0 的生物是无实体的，或以其他方式没有真正有意义的物理形态。它们没有生命值池，且既不会变为 @状态[weakened]，也不会变为 @状态[dead]。它们原本应拥有的任何生命值都会改为计入其士气池。当其士气降至 0 时，该生物变为 @状态[incapacitated]。

敏捷

敏捷是一项身体迅捷属性，反映移动的灵活性与精确性。敏捷影响采取行动时的先攻、物理防御中的闪避部分、反射防御，以及使用那些随敏捷成长的武器装备。

高敏捷的角色通常行动迅速，比起纯粹的力量更偏好移动的迅捷与精准。他们可能使用便于灵巧移动或具备远程能力的武器，力求在敌人甚至还未来得及行动前就抢先占据优势。

敏捷为 0 的生物天生迟缓或笨重。它们的先攻始终为 0，且不能执行任何带有反应标签的动作。

感知

感知是一项精神力量属性，用于描述生物信念的力量、知识的深度与耐心。感知影响意志防御和专注池的大小。感知每提高 1 点，基础士气提高 2 点。

高感知的角色通常会深思熟虑地行动，展现出耐心与判断力，在最能取得优势的理想时机介入。真正行动时，他们会以坚定信念投入自己所选择的道路。

感知为 0 的生物没有智慧，且无法对周围世界施加心灵或精神影响。它们既不能获得也不能生成英雄气概，并且不能执行任何仅使用感知、气场与智力这些精神属性值进行成长的动作。

气场

气场是一项精神韧性属性，用于描述生物人格力量、决心与自信。气场影响意志防御和专注池的大小。气场每提高 1 点，基础士气提高 4 点。

高气场的角色能够激励自己与他人成就伟大的英雄壮举，部分通过对“事情能够成功”的纯粹信念来克服障碍。这类英雄所散发的气场，能够向盟友灌输类似的信念，或在对手心中滋生怀疑。

气场为 0 的生物没有自我意识，也没有有意义的认知形态。它们既不能影响他人的思想，也不会使自身行为受到影响。它们没有士气池，且既不会变为 @状态[broken]，也不会变为 @状态[insane]。它们原本应拥有的任何士气都会改为计入其生命值池。

智力

智力是一项精神迅捷属性，反映思维速度与行动决断力。智力影响采取行动时的先攻、反射防御，以及专注池的大小。

高智力的角色对各种情势都有很强的适应能力。他们运用出色的问题解决与决策能力进行临机思考，并整合已学得的知识来指导果断行动。通过预判并智胜对手，他们能够在任何冲突中占据上风。

智力为 0 的生物缺乏专注或迅速决策的能力。它们没有专注，且无法执行任何需要专注的动作。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Damage Resistance allows a character in Crucible to shrug off or succumb to more damage than normal. Specific creature types may be vulnerable to certain types of damage, conversely some of the most terrifying adversaries are ones that can ignore significant portions of damage that they take.

Most creatures which are resistant to a certain damage type are vulnerable to some other damage type - if you encounter a creature which is overly effective at withstanding your blows - switch tactics!

Damage Types

The Crucible system uses the following 12 Damage Types, each of which has a corresponding Resistance or Vulnerability. Additionally, each damage type has an associated @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleConditio.JournalEntryPage.conditionsOvervi]{Condition} which can be caused as a consequence of that damage type, usually as a result of a Critical Hit.

Physical Damage Types

Related Conditions

Bludgeoning

@Condition[staggered]

Piercing

@Condition[bleeding]

Slashing

@Condition[bleeding]

Poison

@Condition[poisoned]

Elemental Damage Types

Related Conditions

Acid

@Condition[corroding]

Fire

@Condition[burning]

Cold

@Condition[freezing]

Electricity

@Condition[shocked]

Spiritual Damage Types

Related Conditions

Corruption

@Condition[decaying]

Psychic

@Condition[confused]

Radiant

@Condition[irradiated]

Void

@Condition[entropy]

Damage Resistance

When an Action deals damage, that damage may be reduced by an amount of Resistance that the target creature has. This amount of resistance may even reduce the damage caused by the Action to be zero!

Example: Damage Resistance

Suppose a mechanical automaton, a Brass Sentinel, has resistance of +5 to Slashing damage. If the Brass Sentinel receives an attack that deals 13 Slashing damage, the effective damage dealt is reduced to 8 Slashing Damage.

Damage Vulnerability

When a creature is vulnerable to a type of damage dealt, the amount of damage dealt is increased by the amount of the vulnerability. This increase in damage is limited by the base amount of damage dealt; maximum damage against a vulnerable target is two times the amount of damage dealt.

Example: Damage Vulnerability

Suppose a volatile Fire Elemental has vulnerability of -20 to Cold damage. If the elemental is dealt 7 Cold damage before vulnerability is applied, the total result will be 14 Cold damage.

Damage Immunity

In exceptional cases, a creature may be entirely Immune to a certain damage type. In this case, the creature never takes damage of that type no matter its magnitude.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
伤害抗性允许《Crucible》中的角色比平常更能抵御伤害，或更容易承受伤害。特定类型的生物可能会对某些伤害类型表现出易伤；反过来说，一些最可怕的对手则能够无视其所受到伤害中的很大一部分。

大多数对某种伤害类型具有抗性的生物，都会对其他某种伤害类型存在易伤——如果你遇到一种特别善于承受你攻击的生物，就换个战术！

伤害类型

Crucible 系统使用以下 12 种伤害类型，每一种都对应一种抗性或易伤。此外，每种伤害类型还对应一种相关的 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleConditio.JournalEntryPage.conditionsOvervi]{状态}，这种状态可能作为该伤害类型的后果而产生，通常是由于一次重击导致的。

物理伤害类型

相关状态

钝击

@状态[staggered]

穿刺

@状态[bleeding]

挥砍

@状态[bleeding]

毒素

@状态[poisoned]

元素伤害类型

相关状态

强酸

@状态[corroding]

火元素

@状态[burning]

寒冷

@状态[freezing]

电击

@状态[shocked]

灵性伤害类型

相关状态

腐化

@状态[decaying]

灵能

@状态[confused]

辉光

@状态[irradiated]

虚空

@状态[entropy]

伤害抗性

当一个动作造成伤害时，该伤害可能会被目标生物拥有的抗性数值所减少。这一抗性数值甚至可能将该动作造成的伤害降低至零！

示例：伤害抗性

假设一个机械自动体——黄铜哨兵——对挥砍伤害具有 +5 抗性。如果黄铜哨兵受到一次造成13 点挥砍伤害的攻击，则实际造成的伤害会降低为8 点挥砍伤害。

伤害易伤

当生物对所受的某种伤害类型具有易伤时，造成的伤害值会按该易伤数值增加。该伤害增幅受到原始伤害值的限制；对易伤目标造成的最大伤害为原始伤害值的两倍。

示例：伤害易伤

假设一个不稳定的火元素对寒冷伤害具有 -20 易伤。如果在应用易伤之前，该元素受到7 点寒冷伤害，则最终结果将为14 点寒冷伤害。

伤害免疫

在某些特殊情况下，生物可能对某种伤害类型完全免疫。在这种情况下，无论伤害数值有多高，该生物都不会受到此类型的伤害。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Skills represent the education or degree of professional training your character has received. These Skills might have been learned as part of their @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6.JournalEntryPage.uCwStnXHoUCV2TrK]{Background} or some other aspect of their life experience. Skills progress when a character selects a Training Talent. During @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{Character Creation}, some Training Talents are awarded during the selection of a Background.

More information on Training Talents can be found in @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.talents000000000]{Talents}.

Exploration Skills

Athletics

The Athletics skill represents the ability to undertake and surmount physical challenges. These could involve traversal of difficult terrain like climbing, running, or swimming, or could involve feats of strength, endurance, or flexibility.

Awareness

Awareness is a measure of your skill in translating sensory input into useful information. A character with high Awareness is able to notice and interpret details that others might miss, and is able to quickly identify and react to threats.

Stealth

Stealth covers the ability to hide effectively, to move without making a sound, to disguise oneself, and to otherwise use your environment to hide your presence. Those trained in Stealth focus on finding ways to remain unnoticed, whether sneaking in solitude through a dark alley at night, or blending in at a celebration at a crowded ballroom.

Wilderness

Those skilled in Wilderness learn to create shelter where there is none, identify which water is safe to drink and which is not, and locate sources of food in even the most inhospitable places, and to otherwise survive in harsh environments.

Knowledge Skills

Arcana

Whether the focus of the education is magical or religious in nature, Arcana encompasses the study of esoteric knowledge. Students of Arcana learn fundamental principles of metaphysics, study spiritual beings and deities, runic theory and ritual, the nature of chaos and order, and the history of how magical and spiritual forces impact societies and cultures.

Medicine

The study of Medicine is a practical one, with a focus on studying the mechanical, biological components that make up living creatures, the ailments that can afflict them, and the ways to best treat injury and illness alike.

Science

Science is concerned with physical phenomena and examining the world through the lens of logic, reason, mathematics, and the use of structured observation. A student of science learns to posit and confirm theories, analyze the construction of physical objects and machines, and apply mathematical thinking.

Society

The Society skill is most often used for the purposes of research or understanding into the nuanced aspects of a social situation. Those educated in the workings of Society study the factors which contribute to social structures. Knowledge of Society is used to establish historical or socio-political context, to identify the social rank of particular individuals, or to otherwise draw connections between a person or place and its most likely contributors.

Social Skills

Deception

Deception most commonly comes into play when a character is attempting to lie or mislead others, forge documents, or pierce the veil of lies others construct. Those who pursue an education in Deception are often politicians, diplomats, spies, thieves, or other professions for whom flexibility in the truth is a necessity.

Diplomacy

Diplomacy is rolled most often to persuade others to see things your way. A skill most commonly found in the politically savvy or influential orators, Diplomacy allows for the use of rhetoric and emotional appeals to inspire and convince others. Diplomats focus their efforts on the use of words, rather than deeds, to change opinions and inspire emotional reactions.

Intimidation

Intimidation is used to force others to do your bidding, whether through displays of aggression or threats of violence. Those trained in the art of intimidation are capable of using their words and actions to inspire fear in others, to demonstrate dominance or press others into subservience. Those who train their skill in intimidation need not necessarily be physically imposing in terms of stature, for words and deeds can be equally capable of inspiring fear.

Performance

Those who study Performance learn, above all else, how to use their talents to inspire and entertain others whether through music, dance, storytelling, or other forms of artistic expression.. Performers learn verse and music, use of pigment and light, poetry and story, dance and even physical feats to evoke emotional reactions in others.

Skill Checks

There are often situations that require a character to confirm their capabilities. At any time GM may call for a Skill Check— a simple roll to test whether you have sufficient skill to perform an action or recall some piece of information. Each skill is associated with two @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.abilityScores000]{Abilities}.

You can roll a skill check at any time from the skill tab of your character sheet, simply by clicking on the skill name.

Skill checks use the same equation for calculation that a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.KBDiQbnSfnRYG7mi.JournalEntryPage.WpBewuNfFJp1ZJRt#standard-check]{Standard Check} does. Like all Standard Checks, skill checks can result in a Critical Success if the total exceeds the DC by more than 6, or a Critical Failure if the total falls below the DC by more than 6. The GM may choose to apply additional consequences or benefits based on these critical outcomes.

A character's skill rank is determined by their degree of training, adding a bonus to checks made for that skill. Each skill has 4 ranks as well as an 'untrained' rank.

Bonus

Rank

Scale

-4

Untrained

You are decidedly as good at this skill as the average person who has absolutely no education or professional training related to it.

0

Novice

You have received training in the basic practices common across all parts of that skill.

+1

Journeyman

You've reached some degree of advanced training and know some of the less common principles of that particular skill.

+2

Adept

You have exceeded all the bounds of professional training. There is nothing more about your skills that you can learn from others. All that is left is to perfect your understanding.

+3

Master

You have mastered this skill. There is nothing more to learn about it.

Skill Check

=

3d8[Boons,Banes] + Average of Ability Bonuses (Round Up) + Skill Bonus + Enchantment Bonus

Example: Rolling a Skill Check

Albert, a seasoned naval captain, is faced with a dilemma. His ship is about to be imperiled by a storm, and his crew is looking to him to safely navigate out of the harbor. As a Master of the Wilderness skill, Albert taps into his extensive knowledge of seafaring. This will be a Difficult (DC 24) roll; Albert rolls his Skill check. Unluckily, Albert's dice total turn up 6, 4, and 7 for a total of 17 and a far cry from the needed 24. However, Albert's Toughness is quite high at 8, and his Wisdom is 6, so the composite Ability Bonus for a dual-scaling skill adds +4. Albert's Master rank in Wilderness adds a Skill bonus of +3, and he also happens to have a magical set of nautical charts which grant a +2 enchantment bonus, pushing the result of the roll to 26, a narrow success.

Passive Skill Checks

Crucible allows any skill check to be considered passive at the discretion of the gamemaster. In a case where a character's trained skill rank is sufficient to exceed the DC of a roll by adding 12 to it, the check is considered successful without a need to roll.

Group Skill Checks

Sometimes the GM may call for a group skill check when the entire party attempts a task together. The GM initiates the group check from the skill check dialog by selecting which actors should participate, setting the Difficulty Class, and optionally assigning shared Boons or Banes that apply to all participants. Each player is prompted to configure and roll their own check. The GM can skip or re-request rolls for individual participants, and can roll on behalf of actors whose owners are not online. Once all rolls are submitted, the GM finalizes the results, which are posted to the chat log.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
技能代表你的角色所接受的教育或专业训练程度。这些技能可能是在其 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6.JournalEntryPage.uCwStnXHoUCV2TrK]{背景} 中习得的，也可能来自其人生经历的其他方面。角色在选择一个训练天赋时，技能会得到成长。在 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{角色创建} 期间，某些训练天赋会在选择背景时获得。

有关训练天赋的更多信息，请参见 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.talents000000000]{天赋}。

探索技能

运动

运动技能代表应对并克服身体挑战的能力。这可能包括穿越如攀爬、奔跑或游泳之类的困难地形，也可能包括力量、耐力或柔韧性的壮举。

察觉

察觉衡量的是你将感官输入转化为有用信息的能力。拥有高察觉的角色能够注意并解读他人可能忽略的细节，也能够迅速识别并应对威胁。

潜行

潜行涵盖有效藏身、无声移动、伪装自己，以及以其他方式利用环境来隐藏自身存在的能力。受过潜行训练的人专注于寻找不被注意的方法，无论是在夜晚独自潜行穿过黑暗小巷，还是在拥挤舞厅的庆典中融入人群。

荒野

精通荒野的人会学习在无处可依时搭建庇护所，辨别哪些水可以安全饮用、哪些不行，在最恶劣的地方也能找到食物来源，并以其他方式在严酷环境中生存。

知识技能

奥术

无论教育重点在于魔法还是宗教，奥术都涵盖对秘奥知识的研究。学习奥术的人会掌握形而上学的基本原理，研究灵体与神祇、符文理论与仪式、混沌与秩序的本质，以及魔法与灵性力量如何影响社会与文化的历史。

医疗

医疗的研究是实践性的，重点在于研究构成活体生物的机械与生物材料组成部分、可能侵扰它们的病症，以及治疗伤害与疾病的最佳方法。

科学

科学关注物理现象，并通过逻辑、理性、数学以及系统化观察的视角来审视世界。科学的学习者会提出并验证理论，分析物体与机器的构造，并应用数学思维。

社交

社交技能最常用于研究或理解社交情境中的细微层面。受过社交运作教育的人会研究促成社会结构的各种因素。社交知识可用于建立历史或社会政治背景，识别特定个体的社会等级，或以其他方式找出一个人或地点与其最可能相关因素之间的联系。

社交技能

欺瞒

欺瞒最常见于角色试图说谎、误导他人、伪造文件，或揭穿他人编织的谎言时。追求欺瞒相关教育的人通常是政治家、外交官、间谍、盗贼，或其他那些必须灵活对待真相的职业。

外交

外交最常在你试图说服他人接受你的看法时进行掷骰。这项技能最常见于政治嗅觉敏锐者或有影响力的演说家，外交让人能够运用修辞与情感诉求去激励并说服他人。外交家专注于用言辞而非行动来改变观点并激起情绪反应。

威吓

威吓用于迫使他人听命于你，无论是通过展现攻击性还是暴力威胁。受过威吓艺术训练的人能够用言语和行动激发他人的恐惧，展示支配地位，或逼迫他人屈从。训练威吓技能的人不一定需要在体格上高大威猛，因为言语与行为同样能够激起恐惧。

表演

学习表演的人，首先学会的是如何通过音乐、舞蹈、讲故事或其他艺术表达形式，运用自己的天赋去激励并娱乐他人。表演者会学习诗句与乐曲、颜料与光的运用、诗歌与故事、舞蹈，甚至身体技艺，以引发他人的情绪反应。

技能检定

角色经常会遇到需要验证自身能力的情况。游戏主持人可以在任何时候要求进行一次技能检定——一次简单的掷骰，用来测试你是否拥有足够的技能去执行某个动作或回忆某条信息。每项技能都与两个 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.abilityScores000]{能力} 相关联。

你可以随时从角色卡的技能标签页进行技能检定，只需点击技能名称即可。

技能检定使用与 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.KBDiQbnSfnRYG7mi.JournalEntryPage.WpBewuNfFJp1ZJRt#standard-check]{标准检定} 相同的计算公式。与所有标准检定一样，如果总值超过DC 6点以上，技能检定可获得重大成功；如果总值低于DC 6点以上，则会是重大失败。游戏主持人可以根据这些重大结果决定施加额外后果或收益。

角色的技能等级由其训练程度决定，并为该技能的检定提供加值。每项技能有4个等级，外加一个“未受训”等级。

加值

等级

说明

-4

未受训

你在这项技能上的水平，基本就和完全没有受过任何相关教育或专业训练的普通人一样。

0

新手

你接受过该技能各个领域中通用基础方法的训练。

+1

熟练工

你已经达到一定程度的进阶训练，并了解这项特定技能中一些较不常见的原理。

+2

行家

你已经超越了专业训练的一切界限。关于你的技能，已没有什么还能从他人那里学到的了。剩下的只有完善你自己的理解。

+3

大师

你已精通这项技能。关于它已无更多可学。

技能检定

=

3d8[恩惠骰,祸骰] + Average of 能力 Bonuses (轮 Up) + 技能加值 + Enchantment 加值

示例：进行一次技能检定

阿尔伯特，一位经验丰富的海军队长，正面临一个难题。他的船即将遭遇风暴威胁，而船员们指望他安全驶离港口。作为荒野技能的大师，阿尔伯特调动了自己丰富的航海知识。这将是一次困难（DC 24）掷骰；阿尔伯特进行了他的技能检定。不幸的是，阿尔伯特掷出的骰子结果是6、4和7，总计17，距离所需的24相差甚远。然而，阿尔伯特的Toughness相当高，达到8，而他的感知为6，因此这个双重成长技能的综合能力加值为+4。阿尔伯特在荒野上的大师等级提供了+3技能加值，而他恰好还拥有一套魔法航海图，给予+2附魔加值，使最终结果提升到26，勉强成功。

被动技能检定

在《Crucible》中，任何技能检定都可以由游戏主持人酌情视为被动效果。在角色受训后的技能等级足以通过在其上加上12来超过一次掷骰的DC时，该检定视为成功，无需掷骰。

团队技能检定

有时，当整个队伍一起尝试某项任务时，游戏主持人可能会要求进行一次团队技能检定。游戏主持人会从技能检定对话框中发起团队检定，选择哪些角色应当参与，设定难度等级，并可选择性地分配适用于所有参与者的共享恩惠骰或祸骰。每位玩家都会收到提示，以配置并掷出自己的检定。游戏主持人可以跳过或重新要求个别参与者的掷骰，也可以代替其拥有者不在线的角色进行掷骰。当所有掷骰提交后，游戏主持人会敲定结果，并将其发布到聊天日志中。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Talents represent unique combinations of abilities a particular character may have, and provide a level of customization and progression beyond skill advancement. Talents allow characters to define their role more clearly as they advance, growing steadily in power. Newly created characters begin with a small number of Talent Points, gaining more points at each level.

Outside of the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{Character Creation} process, you can access the Talent Tree for a character at any time by opening the Talents tab and clicking the "Open Talent Tree" button.

Interaction with the talent tree is similar to interaction with Scenes in ordinary Foundry VTT usage. Pan the tree using right-click and drag, and use mouse-wheel to zoom in and out. Left clicking any Node will expand it to reveal the Talents it may contain.

Left-clicking a Talent purchases that talent if you have points available, while right-clicking it will remove that talent from your character.

You may reset your purchases on the Talent Tree at any time by clicking the Reset button at the bottom.

Tree Layout

Crucible's Talent Tree is divided into six sections, with each section representing a different @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.abilityScores000]{Ability} which affects scaling and other aspects of those talents.

The Talent Tree is composed of several subcomponents which help you plot growth and progression for your character.

Nodes

Each sextant of the Talent tree is composed of a number of Nodes which can contain one or more Talents. A Node which lie closer to the border between two sextants will often feature abilities which relate to the themes of both ability scores.

Starting Nodes occur at the inner-most ring, and contain talents that are often prerequisites for later talents in the tree. These starter talents are best thought of as the first steps in defining what makes your character different from another in terms of their specific set of special abilities.

Each Node has a categorical type which indicates general style of talents that it contains. The current node types are: Attack, Defense, Healing, Magic, Melee, Movement, Ranged, Skill, Spellcraft, and Utility. This type determines both the node's visual appearance on the tree as well as suggests the functionality of talents that it offers. Some nodes are also categorized as "Passive", meaning the talents offered at that node provide automatic benefits without requiring the usage of any specific action.

Talents

Talents are the smallest unit of the talent tree. Each talent grants your character-specific abilities or bonuses. Many Talents have requirements which must be met before they can be purchased, such as attaining a certain level of Ability bonus or degree of training in a Skill.

Training Talents

Training talents are specific types of talent nodes that grant advancements to Skills, or progress Weapon or Tradecraft training. Weapon or Tradecraft Training Talents authorize your character to use particular weapons or to craft particular types of schematics, Skill Training Talents award the following benefits:

Bonus

Rank

Scale

-4

Untrained

You are decidedly as good at this skill as the average person who has absolutely no education or professional training related to it.

0

Novice

You have received training in the basic practices common across all parts of that skill.

+1

Journeyman

You've reached some degree of advanced training and know some of the less common principles of that particular skill.

+2

Adept

You have exceeded all the bounds of professional training. There is nothing more about your skills that you can learn from others. All that is left is to perfect your understanding.

+3

Master

You have mastered this skill. There is nothing more to learn about it.

Signature Talents

Talent nodes at the outer edges of the Talent Tree contain Signature Talents, powerful bonuses that "Spellblade" or "Dread Lord" which offer iconic abilities. Signature Talents represent the culmination of the abilities required to select them, and are mirrored across two ability scores. Taking a Signature Talent forms a bridge to its paired ability score, allowing you to continue your path of progression into that sextant regardless of whether you have already purchased lower-tier Talents.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
天赋代表特定角色可能拥有的独特能力组合，并在技能晋升之外提供一定程度的自定义与进阶。随着角色不断晋升，天赋使其能够更清晰地定义自身定位，并稳步增强实力。新创建的角色起始时拥有少量天赋点，并会在每次升级时获得更多点数。

在 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{角色创建} 流程之外，你随时都可以通过打开天赋标签页并点击“Open 天赋树”按钮，访问角色的天赋树。

与天赋树的交互方式类似于在普通 Foundry VTT 使用中与场景的交互。按住鼠标右键拖动可平移天赋树，使用鼠标滚轮可缩放。左键点击任意节点会将其展开，以揭示其中可能包含的天赋。

左键点击某个天赋会在你有可用点数时购买该天赋，而右键点击则会将该天赋从你的角色上移除。

你可以随时点击底部的 Reset 按钮，重置你在天赋树上的购买内容。

树布局

Crucible 的天赋树分为六个区域，每个区域代表一种不同的 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.abilityScores000]{能力}，会影响这些天赋的成长和其他方面。

天赋树由若干子部分构成，帮助你为角色规划成长与进阶路线。

节点

天赋树的每个分区都由若干节点组成，而每个节点可以包含一个或多个天赋。靠近两个分区边界的节点通常会呈现同时关联两种属性值主题的能力。

起始节点位于最内侧的环上，包含的天赋通常是天赋树后续天赋的前置条件。最好将这些起始天赋视为塑造角色独特性的第一步，使其在特定特殊能力组合方面区别于其他角色。

每个节点都有一个类别类型，用于表明其所包含天赋的大致风格。当前的节点类型有：攻击、防御、治疗、魔法、近战、移动、远程、技能、施法和效用。该类型既决定节点在天赋树中的视觉外观，也提示其所提供天赋的功能。有些节点还会被归类为“被动”，意味着该节点提供的天赋会自动带来收益，而不需要使用任何特定动作。

天赋

天赋是天赋树中最小的单位。每个天赋都会赋予你的角色特定能力或加值。许多天赋都有必须满足后才能购买的要求，例如达到一定的属性加值，或在某项技能上具备一定程度的训练。

训练天赋

训练天赋是特殊类型的天赋节点，用于提升技能，或推进武器或手艺训练。武器或手艺训练天赋授权你的角色使用特定武器，或制作特定类型的图纸；技能训练天赋则会提供以下收益：

加值

等级

说明

-4

未受训

你在这项技能上的水平，基本就和一个对其完全没有受过教育或专业训练的普通人差不多。

0

新手

你已经接受过该技能各个分支中共通基础做法的训练。

+1

熟练工

你已达到一定程度的进阶训练，并了解这项特定技能中一些较不常见的原理。

+2

行家

你已超越专业训练的全部界限。关于你的这项技能，已经没有什么是你还能从他人那里学到的了。剩下的只有不断完善你自己的理解。

+3

大师

你已经精通这项技能。关于它已再无可学之处。

招牌天赋

位于天赋树外缘的天赋节点包含招牌天赋，也就是像“咒刃”或“恐惧领主”这类能够提供标志性能力的强力加值。招牌天赋代表了选择它们所需能力的顶点，并会跨两个属性值相互映照。获取一个招牌天赋会与其配对的属性值形成桥梁，使你无论是否已经购买较低阶的天赋，都可以继续沿着你的进阶路径进入对应的分区。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Knowledge Areas (or sometimes just called "Knowledges") are specific enhancements that reflect notable areas of a hero's understanding of some specialized training. While most knowledge areas come as a result of a @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.backgrounds00000]{Background} selected during @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{Character Creation}, it is possible to attain knowledge areas in other ways during character progression.

Knowledge areas are still being implemented and developed as a mechanical aspect of Crucible and may change over the course of the next several iterations.

While knowledge areas do not grant a specific mechanical bonus, they are often used in combination with skill checks:

  • Sometimes, a Knowledge will substitute for a Skill Check that would otherwise be required.

  • Sometimes, a Knowledge will provide certain Boons towards the attempted Skill Check.

  • Sometimes, a Knowledge may be a prerequisite condition for even attempting a Skill Check.

知识领域（有时也简称为“知识”）是一些特定强化，用于体现英雄在某些专业训练方面尤为突出的理解。虽然大多数知识领域来自于在 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6]{角色创建} 期间所选择的 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.backgrounds00000]{背景}，但角色在成长过程中也可能通过其他方式获得知识领域。

知识领域作为 Crucible 的一种机械层面内容，仍在实现与开发中，并且可能会在接下来的数次迭代中发生变化。

虽然知识领域不会提供特定的机械加值，但它们经常会与技能检定结合使用：

  • 有时，知识会为尝试进行的技能检定提供某些恩惠。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Conditions are temporary status effects which apply to a character. These conditions modify what actions the character can take, its resource pools, or the way that certain rules are applied to that character. This page separates Conditions into two categories; Statuses which describe the character's state of being and Damage-Over-Time which are detrimental or ameliorating effects which apply at the beginning of the character's Turn in Combat.

Damage Over Time

Some types of damage deal additional delayed damage. These conditions cause damage (or healing) that occurs at the start of a character's turn.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
状态是施加于角色的临时状态效果。这些状态会改变角色可以执行哪些动作、其资源池，或某些规则应用于该角色的方式。本页将状态分为两类：描述角色当前状态的状态，以及持续伤害——即在战斗中角色回合开始时生效的不利或改善性效果。

持续伤害

某些类型的伤害会造成额外的延迟伤害。这些状态会导致在角色回合开始时发生的伤害（或治疗）。

crucible.rules.json.en:
A creature that is Weakened is vulnerable to taking deadly wounds. Heroes become Weakened when they reach zero Health. Any further damage to Health taken while Weakened increases Wounds.

While a creature is Weakened, it suffers -2 to maximum Action and loses access to a free Movement action.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
处于虚弱状态的生物容易受到致命创伤。英雄在生命值降至零时会变得虚弱。处于虚弱状态时，任何进一步承受的生命值伤害都会增加创伤。

当生物处于虚弱状态时，其最大行动值受到 -2，并失去进行一次免费移动动作的权限。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Exhausted can no longer actively defend itself. It's Dodge and Reflex defenses are reduced by half.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于精疲力竭状态的生物无法再主动进行防御。其闪避和反射防御减半。

crucible.rules.json.en: Some attacks can leave an enemy temporarily vulnerable. When a creature is Exposed its base Armor defense suffers a -2 penalty.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 某些攻击会让敌人暂时变得脆弱。当一个生物处于暴露状态时，其基础护甲防御承受 -2 惩罚。

crucible.rules.json.en: When a creature is entirely unable to act, it is Incapacitated. When a target is Incapacitated, its Dodge, Block, and Parry defenses become zero and it no longer benefits from Ability Score bonuses to Fortitude, Willpower, or Reflex defense. It cannot contribute to Flanking or otherwise aid allies.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 当一个生物完全无法行动时，它处于失能状态。当一个目标处于失能状态时，其闪避、格挡和招架防御变为零，且不再从属性值对坚韧、意志力或反射防御的加值中受益。它不能提供夹击，也不能以其他方式协助盟友。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Hastened treats distance as halved for the purposes of determining the cost of the Move action. Additionally, a creature that is Hastened has +1 maximum Action available each turn.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于加速状态的生物在判定移动动作的消耗时，将距离视为减半。此外，处于加速状态的生物每个回合可用的最大动作数+1。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that has been knocked to the ground, or has voluntarily thrown itself to the ground is considered Prone. While Prone, melee attacks against the target benefit from +1 Boon while ranged attacks against the target suffer from +1 Bane. Additionally, any attacks made by a Prone creature suffer +1 Bane, and the creature cannot benefit from a free Move. Returning to your feet from a Prone position requires the use of a Movement action.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 被击倒在地，或主动扑倒在地的生物，视为倒地。处于倒地时，针对该目标的近战攻击获得 +1 恩惠，而针对该目标的远程攻击承受 +1 祸骰。此外，倒地生物进行的任何攻击都承受 +1 祸骰，且该生物无法从免费移动中受益。从倒地状态起身需要使用一个移动动作。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Asleep is treated as incapacitated. Any damage to Health or Wounds causes it to immediately awaken. The creature is immune to Morale damage while sleeping unless otherwise stated.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于睡眠状态的生物视为失能。对其生命值或创伤造成的任何伤害都会使其立即醒来。除非另有说明，否则该生物在睡眠期间免疫士气伤害。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Restrained is unable to perform any Action which involves Movement and suffers +2 Banes to attack rolls.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于受拘束状态的生物无法执行任何涉及移动的动作，且进行攻击检定时承受+2 祸骰。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Slowed treats distance as doubled for the purposes of determining the cost of the Move action. Additionally, a Slowed creature cannot benefit from a free Move.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于迟缓状态的生物在判定移动动作消耗时，将距离视为双倍。此外，处于迟缓状态的生物无法从免费移动中受益。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Bleeding creature suffers additional Piercing or Slashing damage, depending on the triggering damage type, to Health at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于流血状态的生物会在其后续每个回合开始时受到额外的穿刺或挥砍伤害（取决于触发的伤害类型），并失去生命值。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Burning creature suffers additional Fire damage to both Health and Morale at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于燃烧状态的生物会在其后续每个回合开始时，额外受到火焰伤害，并同时损失生命值和士气。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Confused creature suffers Psychic damage to Morale at the start of each turn, and is also treated as Disoriented.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于混乱状态的生物在每个回合开始时会受到心灵伤害，并扣减士气，且还视为处于迷失方向状态。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Corroding creature suffers additional Acid damage to Health at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于腐蚀状态的生物会在其后续每个回合开始时，受到额外的强酸伤害，并损失生命值。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Decaying creature suffers additional Corruption damage to Health at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于腐坏状态的生物在其后续每个回合开始时，都会受到额外的腐化伤害，并失去生命值。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Freezing creature suffers additional Cold damage to Health at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 一个处于冰冻状态的生物会在其后续各回合开始时，对其生命值承受额外的寒冷伤害。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Inspired will gradually recover Morale at the start of each of its turns. The amount of Morale recovered is defined by a corresponding value of the Inspired effect.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于鼓舞状态的生物会在其每个回合开始时逐渐恢复士气。恢复的士气数量由鼓舞效果的对应数值决定。

crucible.rules.json.en: An Irradiated creature suffers additional Radiant damage to both Health and Morale at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 一个辐照生物会在其后续回合开始时，对其生命值和士气额外受到光耀伤害。

crucible.rules.json.en: A creature that is Mending will gradually recover Health at the start of each of its turns. The amount of Health recovered is defined by a corresponding value of the Mending effect.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于修补状态的生物会在其每个回合开始时逐渐恢复生命值。恢复的生命值数量由修补效果的对应数值决定。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Poisoned creature suffers additional Poison damage to Health at the start of its subsequent turns.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于中毒状态的生物会在其后续每个回合开始时，额外受到毒素伤害并失去生命值。

crucible.rules.json.en: A Shocked creature suffers Electricity damage to Morale at the start of each turn.
crucible.rules.json.cn: 处于电击状态的生物在每个回合开始时，其士气受到电击伤害。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Crafting in Crucible is performed using a set of Tradeskills which, similar to adventuring @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.skills0000000000]{Skills}, are invested aspects of your character's identity obtained through @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.talents000000000]{Talent} progression and through the accumulation of knowledge in the form of @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.schematicDefinit]{Schematics}.

The crafting system is under active development. Rules described here represent the intended design, but some details may not yet be fully automated.

It is not required for any character to invest into mastery of a tradeskill, however it is generally recommended to select at least one tradeskill to pursue in order to enjoy a well-rounded experience playing Crucible, particularly if your game is a long-form campaign.

The information in this journal describes each of the tradeskills, how schematics are defined and obtained, and how the crafting process functions when using a schematic to turn input ingredients into produced items.

制作系统目前仍在积极开发中。此处描述的规则代表预期设计，但某些细节可能尚未完全自动化。

任何角色都不必一定在某项制作技艺上投入专精，但通常仍建议至少选择一项制作技艺进行发展，以获得更全面的 Crucible 游玩体验，尤其是在你的游戏是长期战役的情况下。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Alchemy is the scientific practice of combining ingredients such as botanicals and minerals in order to produce consumable medicines, poisons, and explosives through zymurgy, distillation, or homogenization.

An alchemist can combine commonly available ingredients to produce consumable potions such as@UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.healingTonic0000]{Healing Tonic} or @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.poisonVial000000]{Poison Vial}, as well as throwable weapons such as @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.KdlUUFhAnpv6YIHT]{Blast Flask}.

Talents

The following talents are available to represent Alchemical training:

@UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.alchemyNovice000]{Alchemy Novice}

@UUID[Compendium.crucible.talent.Item.alchemyJourneyma]{Alchemy Journeyman}
crucible.rules.json.cn:
炼金术是一门科学实践，通过发酵、蒸馏或均质化，将植物与矿物等材料结合起来，以制造可消耗的医疗物品、毒药和爆炸物。

炼金术士可以将常见易得的材料组合起来，制成可消耗的药剂，例如@UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.healingTonic0000]{治疗药剂}或 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.poisonVial000000]{毒药瓶}，以及可投掷的武器，例如 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.KdlUUFhAnpv6YIHT]{爆炸瓶}。

天赋

Ingredients can differ in terms of quality and enchantment tier, and each ingredient can have a variety of properties that contribute to the overall quality of the crafted output.

crucible.rules.json.en:
Weapons are a specific Item type which represents items that are wielded in a character's hands and used in combat. The Crucible system provides the basic rules for creating and classifying weapons, and also provides an array of pre-defined weapon types which are typically observed in a fantasy role-playing game. These weapons can be browsed in the Weapons Compendium pack.

Weapon Properties

Weapons all have the following attributes, in addition to those shared by all items:

Category

The category of a weapon establishes certain parameters about how that weapon may be used. How many hands does it require to wield? Is it a melee weapon or a ranged weapon? Does it require ammunition? Which ability scores modify its usage? And more. The possible weapon categories are listed in the table below.

Damage Type

Each weapon deals a specific damage type when it inflicts damage in combat.

Weapon Properties

附魔阶级
