伏击

这种武器易于隐藏，也能快速取出。在你的回合中，或作为一次反应的一部分，你可以免费拔出该武器。其紧凑尺寸会使其有效射程减少：近战武器减少1英尺，远程武器减少10英尺。

格挡

当该武器已装备且未破碎时，它为格挡防御提供+1。该武器的防御设计会使其基础伤害降低：单手武器降低1，双手武器降低2。

牵制

这种武器经过设计，使你更容易与多个敌人作战，使你的交战+1。该武器的防御设计会使其基础伤害降低：单手武器降低1，双手武器降低2。

超大

这种武器相对于其类别而言体型较大，若没有特殊训练，在战斗中会难以驾驭。该武器的基础伤害增加：单手武器+1，双手武器+2，但它较为迟缓，并使先攻掷骰获得+2祸骰。

招架

当该武器已装备且未破碎时，它为招架防御提供+1。该武器的防御平衡会使使用此武器进行打击时的暴击阈值+1，使暴击更难达成。

多用

这种通常为单手的武器也可以双手有效使用。当你装备该武器且副手没有任何物品时，其基础伤害增加+2，动作成本增加+1。

投掷

这种武器可以用于在最远20英尺的距离进行打击。当用于打击一个不在近战射程内的目标时，该武器会变为未装备，且必须先被取回后才能再次使用。

Armor are items which can be worn to provide @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.Defenses00000000]{Physical Defense} against attacks or environmental hazards. The Crucible system provides a framework and rules for creating and classifying Armor, and also provides an assortment of predefined Armor types which are typical to a fantasy role-playing setting. These Armors can be browsed in the Armor Compendium pack.

Armor Categories

The category of armor establishes certain parameters about how that armor is used. What is it's weight category? How much physical protection does it afford? How capable of nimble movement is someone while wearing it? Supported Armor categories are listed in a table below. The following table lists the categories of Armor supported in the Crucible game system.

The total Physical Defense contributed by the piece of Armor is equal to the sum of Armor and Dodge components.

Physical Defense

=

Base Armor + Bonus Armor + Base Dodge + Bonus Dodge

@UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.scaleMail0000000]{Scale Mail} is Medium Armor which offers 13 Armor Defense and 3 Base Dodge Defense. As Medium Armor, the effectiveness of Scale Mail will continue to improve if the wearer has more than 6 Dexterity, it's Scaling Threshold. When Jex, a nimble fighter with 8 Dexterity, dons Scale Mail armor they benefit from a total Physical Defense of 18 (13 Armor + 5 Dodge).

When Jex returns to the city from adventuring, they purchase a Fine Quality set of Scale Mail with a Minor Enchantment. Jex' total Physical Defense improves to 20 (14 Armor + 6 Dodge).

Wearing Heavy Armor does not permit a free Move action each turn as other armor types do unless the character has a specific Talent which negates this penalty.

Armor Defense

Each piece of Armor provides a certain amount of Base Armor defense, bounded by the range allowed by its category. This Armor defense contributes directly towards Physical Defense when the item is equipped. In addition to Base Armor, the piece of armor may offer Bonus Armor according to its Quality tier which is described below.

Dodge Defense

Each piece of Armor provides a baseline amount of Dodge defense. The amount of base dodge defense provided by the armor is defined according to a formula specific to its category.

Base Dodge (Light)

=

10 - (Base Armor / 2)

Base Dodge (Medium)

=

10 - ((Base Armor-1) / 2)

Base Dodge (Heavy)

=

10 - ((Base Armor-2) / 2)

Base Dodge (Natural)

=

10 - (Base Armor / 2)

In addition to Base Dodge defense, each piece of Armor can yield additional Bonus Dodge defense depending on the wearer's Dexterity ability score exceeds a certain Dodge Scaling Threshold. Bonus Dodge is also increased by the item's Enchantment Tier which is described below.

Bonus Dodge

=

Max(Dexterity - Scaling Threshold, 0) + Enchantment Bonus

Quality Tier

Quality of Armor describes its craftsmanship, materials, and condition. Quality tiers provide an additional bonus to Armor defense and increase item rarity. The quality tier of Armor is established at its time of initial creation and can never be increased after that point.

护甲类别

护甲的类别决定了该护甲如何使用的某些参数。它属于什么重量类别？它能提供多少物理保护？穿戴者在穿着它时还能多灵活地移动？支持的护甲类别列于下表。下表列出了 Crucible 游戏系统所支持的护甲类别。

@UUID[Compendium.crucible.equipment.Item.scaleMail0000000]{鳞甲} 是中型护甲，提供 13 护甲防御 和 3 基础闪避防御。作为中型护甲，如果穿戴者的敏捷高于其成长阈值 6 敏捷，鳞甲的效果会继续提升。当 Jex——一名拥有 8 敏捷 的灵巧战士——穿上鳞甲时，他们获得总计 18 点物理防御（13 护甲 + 5 闪避）。

当 Jex 冒险归来回到城市后，他们购买了一套带有次级附魔的精良品质鳞甲。Jex 的物理防御总值提升至 20（14 护甲 + 6 闪避）。

穿着重型护甲时，角色每回合不能像其他护甲类型那样获得一次免费的移动行动，除非该角色拥有某个可抵消此惩罚的特定天赋。

护甲防御

每件护甲都会提供一定数值的基础护甲防御，其数值范围受其类别限制。当物品已装备时，该护甲防御会直接计入物理防御。除基础护甲外，护甲还可能根据其下文所述的品质阶级提供加值护甲。

闪避防御

除基础闪避防御外，每件护甲还可在穿戴者的敏捷能力值超过某个闪避成长阈值时，提供额外的加值闪避防御。加值闪避也会受到物品附魔阶级的提升，详见下文。

Affixes are magical effects that can be applied to @UUID[.LYj7sghAMoQj9FFR]{Weapons}, @UUID[.JTsl6ENdxSDW765Q]{Armor}, or @UUID[.Accessories00000]{Accessories} to augment them with enchantments. A browsable compendium of available affixes is provided in the Crucible > Items > Affixes compendium pack.

Items discovered in the world may already contain affixes, or you can customize items by applying new affixes through crafting using the @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.glyphweaving0000]{Glyphweaving} and @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.enchanting000000]{Enchanting} tradeskills.

Prefix and Suffix

Every affix is categorized as either a Prefix or a Suffix. This categorization determines how the affix contributes to the item's enchantment budget and how it modifies the item's name.

Crafted items can (optionally) be automatically named based on their affixes. A Prefix affix contributes an adjective that is prepended to the item name (e.g., a Keen Longsword). A Suffix affix contributes a noun that is appended with "of" (e.g., a Longsword of Potency). An item with both might be named a Keen Longsword of Potency.

Affix Properties

Each affix has the following properties:

Affix Type

Specifies whether the affix is a Prefix or a Suffix.

Tier

The power level of the affix, ranging from 1 to 3. Higher tiers produce stronger effects but consume more of the item's enchantment budget. Many affixes scale their mechanical effect linearly with tier.

Item Types

Which equipment types the affix can be applied to. Some affixes work on any affixable item, while others are restricted to specific types such as weapons only or armor and accessories.

Adjective

The word used when composing the enchanted item name. For prefixes this is prepended as an adjective; for suffixes it is appended as a noun with "of".

Actions

Some affixes grant usable actions to the bearer. These actions appear on the item alongside any actions the item natively provides and can be activated during combat or exploration.

Enchantment Budget

The total affix capacity of an item is determined by its Quality tier. This capacity is split equally between prefixes and suffixes. Each affix's tier value counts against the budget for its category.

Quality

Total Capacity

Prefix Budget

Suffix Budget

Shoddy

0

0

Fine

Masterwork

An item cannot have duplicate affixes. You can mix and match affixes freely within the budget. For example, a Fine item could have one Tier 1 prefix and one Tier 1 suffix. A Masterwork item could have one Tier 3 prefix and three Tier 1 suffixes, or one Tier 2 prefix, one Tier 1 prefix, and a Tier 3 suffix, among many other combinations.

The item's Enchantment Tier is derived automatically from the total tier value of its affixes. Items with no affixes are considered Mundane.

Unique Items

Items designated as @UUID[.6QxbcLoOhUkXTbAj]{Unique} cannot be enchanted with affixes. These are one-of-a-kind artifacts with manually assigned enchantment tiers that exist outside the standard affix system.

词缀是可应用于@UUID[.LYj7sghAMoQj9FFR]{武器}、@UUID[.JTsl6ENdxSDW765Q]{护甲}或@UUID[.配件00000]{配件}的魔法效果，用于通过附魔强化它们。可用词缀的可浏览合集见于 Crucible > Items > Affixes compendium pack。

在世界中发现的物品可能已经带有词缀，或者你也可以通过制作，使用@UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.glyphweaving0000]{符文编织}和@UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.crucibleCrafting.JournalEntryPage.enchanting000000]{附魔}这两项制作技艺来为物品应用新的词缀，以进行自定义。

前缀与后缀

每个词缀都被归类为前缀或后缀之一。这个分类决定了该词缀如何计入物品的附魔预算，以及它如何修改物品名称。

制作出的物品可以（可选地）根据其词缀自动命名。前缀词缀提供一个置于物品名称前的形容词（例如，Keen长剑）。后缀词缀提供一个以“of”连接并附加在后的名词（例如，长剑 of Potency）。同时具有两者的物品可能会被命名为Keen长剑 of Potency。

词缀属性

每个词缀具有以下属性：

词缀类型

指定该词缀是前缀还是后缀。

阶级

词缀的强度等级，范围为1到3。更高阶级会产生更强的效果，但也会消耗更多物品的附魔预算。许多词缀的机制效果会随阶级线性提升。

物品类型

该词缀可以应用到哪些装备类型上。有些词缀适用于任何可附加词缀的物品，而另一些则仅限于特定类型，例如仅武器，或护甲与配件。

形容词

在组合附魔物品名称时使用的词语。对于前缀，它以前置形容词形式出现；对于后缀，它则作为带有“of”的名词附加在后。

动作

一些词缀会赋予持有者可用动作。这些动作会显示在物品上，与该物品原生提供的任何动作并列，并且可以在战斗或探索期间激活。

附魔预算

物品的总词缀容量由其品质阶级决定。该容量会在前缀和后缀之间平均分配。每个词缀的阶级数值都会计入其所属类别的预算。

一个物品不能拥有重复的词缀。你可以在预算范围内自由组合词缀。例如，一件精良物品可以拥有一个1阶前缀和一个1阶后缀。一件大师级物品则可以拥有一个3阶前缀和三个1阶后缀，或者一个2阶前缀、一个1阶前缀和一个3阶后缀，还有许多其他组合方式。

物品的附魔阶级会根据其所有词缀的总阶级值自动得出。没有词缀的物品被视为凡品。

crucible.rules.json.en:
This chapter of the rules guides Gamemasters and Players through the process of creating their characters and preparing for play.

Creating a Party

Begin setting up a game in Crucible by creating a Party which the player characters can all belong to by creating an Actor with the Group type. As players create their heroes, add them to the Party by dragging-and-dropping them onto the Party sheet.

Once you have created a Party, you should also configure this group as the "Primary Adventuring Party" under Game Settings ➤ Crucible ➤ Primary Adventuring Party. Taking this step allows a large number of mechanics to be automated which depend on knowing which group is the party of active Heroes.

Creating Heroes

Heroes are the characters in Crucible which are controlled and portrayed by players, also known as "player characters". All Heroes, even those at Level 1, are capable adventurers. They are smart, charismatic, athletic, and skillful - but not yet to a degree that is wondrous. As characters advance in level they attain tiers of power where their physical, mental, and social capabilities are truly legendary. Character advancement in Crucible is level-based. Increases in level grant additional Ability, Skill, and Talent points to spend which increase a character's power and capabilities. The maximum character level in Crucible is anticipated to be 18.

Character creation is an easy process which begins by creating a New Actor of the Hero type. Creating a character is a guided process with a unique interface that walks you through the process step-by-step. You may reset the character creation process at any time by clicking the "restart" button located at the top right of the character creation screen.

Starting Level

If organizing a gameplay experience that seeks to tell the origin story of heroes, starting your game at Level 1 is the recommended choice. If, however, you want to jump into an adventure with characters who are already established champions, beginning at a higher level may be more suitable.

If starting at a higher level than 1, we recommend each player prepare a set of short anecdotes which explain the skill and talent advancements that their character has unlocked prior to the start of the game. This process helps to solidify their character backstory through past events that explain their heroic capabilities.

Review the pages in this journal entry to understand the steps of character creation and the choices you will make during that process.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
本章规则将引导游戏主持人和玩家完成创建角色并为游戏做准备的过程。

创建队伍

在 Crucible 中开始设置游戏时，先创建一个所有玩家角色都能加入的队伍，方法是创建一个类型为 Group 的 Actor。玩家创建他们的英雄时，将他们拖放到队伍角色卡上，把他们加入队伍。

创建队伍后，你还应当在Game Settings ➤ Crucible ➤ Primary Adventuring 队伍中将该群组配置为“主要冒险队伍”。执行这一步后，大量依赖于识别哪个群组是当前活跃英雄队伍的机制都可以实现自动化。

创建英雄

英雄是 Crucible 中由玩家控制和扮演的角色，也称为“玩家角色”。所有英雄，即使是1级，也都是有能力的冒险者。他们聪明、有魅力、擅长运动且技巧娴熟——但还未达到令人惊叹的程度。随着角色等级提升，他们会达到不同的力量阶层，其身体、精神和社交能力将真正变得如传奇一般。Crucible 中的角色晋升基于等级。等级提升会给予额外的能力、技能和天赋点数可供分配，从而提高角色的力量与能力。Crucible 中角色的最高等级预计为18级。

角色创建是一个简单的过程，首先要创建一个类型为 Hero 的新 Actor。创建角色是一个带引导的流程，具有独特的界面，会一步一步带你完成整个过程。你可以随时点击角色创建界面右上角的“restart”按钮来重置角色创建流程。

起始等级

如果你想组织一场讲述英雄起源故事的游戏体验，那么从1级开始游戏是推荐选择。不过，如果你想直接进入一场冒险，并且角色已经是成名的冠军，那么从更高等级开始可能更合适。

如果从高于1级的等级开始，我们建议每位玩家准备几则简短轶事，用来说明他们的角色在游戏开始前解锁了哪些技能和天赋晋升。这一过程有助于通过过去发生的事件来巩固角色背景故事，并解释其英雄般的能力。

查阅本日志条目中的各页，以了解角色创建的步骤以及你将在该过程中做出的选择。

crucible.rules.json.en:
While character creation is technically finished once the "Complete" button has been pressed, there are a few details you may wish to add to your character.

In the User Configuration menu you can set your configure your newly created Hero as your Player Character, which will allow the game to automatically choose that character for certain aspects of automation. For example, you can press the C key to quickly open your character sheet!

Starting Equipment

Choosing starting equipment is an important part of beginning any adventure. We advise Gamemasters to work closely with their players to determine what basic equipment they feel is appropriate for each character by browsing the existing Equipment compendium (found on the compendium tab in the Items folder). Dragging items from this compendium onto your newly created Actor Sheet will assign the item to that Actor's Inventory.

A newly created character begins their journey with [[/award 25gp]] which is automatically added to their inventory. You may spend this initial budget on starting equipment. As you purchase initial equipment, deduct the full Scaled Price of each item from your initial gold allowance.

We anticipate that a guided experience to spending your starting gold budget on initial items may be added as a Character Creation step in the future!

It is important that when adding character equipment you mark anything that the character is wearing as equipped by clicking on the Equip button on the right hand side of the sheet next to the edit and delete buttons.

Gamemasters can create and use their own custom Items either through the sidebar tab (for items that will be used by many characters) or by clicking the + icon on the bottom right corner of any Actor's inventory tab for more unique, character-specific items.

Appearance and Details

With character creation finished, it's a good idea to choose a picture to represent your character by clicking on the icon of the hooded figure on the upper left corner of the actor sheet. In addition, on the Biography tab, you can fill in some important details such as Pronouns, Age, Height, Weight, and provide a physical description to accompany your hero.

Biographies

As a final piece of character creation, you might wish to provide a Public Biography that other players in your game will be able to see, containing some facts about your hero's reputation and history. Any details in the Private Biography section will only be shown to you and your gamemaster, making it a useful place to write your hero's complete backstory.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
虽然严格来说，在按下“Complete”按钮后，角色创建就已经完成了，但你可能还想为你的角色补充一些细节。

在User Configuration菜单中，你可以将你新创建的英雄设为你的Player 角色，这样游戏就能在某些自动化功能中自动选择该角色。例如，你可以按下C 键来快速打开你的角色卡！

起始装备

选择起始装备是开始任何冒险时都很重要的一部分。我们建议游戏主持人与玩家密切配合，通过浏览现有的装备 compendium（位于物品文件夹的 compendium 标签页中），来确定他们认为适合每个角色的基础装备。将该 compendium 中的物品拖到你新创建的角色卡上，就会将该物品分配到该角色的物品栏中。

新创建的角色会以 [[/award 25gp]] 开始他们的旅程，这会自动添加到其物品栏中。你可以将这笔初始预算用于购买起始装备。在购买初始装备时，从你的初始金币额度中扣除每件物品的完整Scaled Price。

我们预计，未来可能会加入一个引导式流程，帮助你将起始金币预算花费在初始物品上，作为角色创建的一个步骤！

需要注意的是，在添加角色装备时，你应通过点击角色卡右侧、位于编辑和删除按钮旁边的 Equip 按钮，将角色正在穿戴的物品标记为已装备。

游戏主持人也可以创建并使用他们自己的自定义物品：既可以通过侧边栏标签页创建（适用于许多角色都会使用的物品），也可以点击任意角色物品栏标签页右下角的 + 图标，为更独特、角色专属的物品进行创建。

外观与细节

角色创建完成后，最好通过点击角色卡左上角兜帽人像的图标，选择一张图片来代表你的角色。此外，在 Biography 标签页中，你可以填写一些重要细节，例如Pronouns、年代、Height、重量，并提供一段与你的英雄相配的外貌描述。

传记

作为角色创建的最后一部分，你可能希望提供一份Public Biography，供你游戏中的其他玩家查看，其中可以包含一些关于你的英雄声望和历史的事实。Private Biography部分中的任何细节都只会显示给你和你的游戏主持人，因此这里很适合用来撰写你英雄的完整背景故事。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Spellcraft is the particular art and theory of magic as implemented in the Crucible system. Proficiecy with spellcraft advances through Talents that are learned as part of character progression. The Crucible spellcraft system is designed to be dynamic and generative, allowing players who wish to focus their character on spellcasting to improvise and discover effective combinations and applications for their magical abilities.

Masterful Composition

Spellcraft allows characters to manifest magic by composing a spell using a @UUID[.p3hKRiZN3x0DEtyG]{Rune}, @UUID[.lhrYInsQ2f0YfhTu]{Gesture}, and optionally an @UUID[.ELOcfx6LPZMh74y8]{Inflection}.

  • Runes represent the base magical essence (such as Spirit or Flame), metaphysical concepts that combine to form the laws of reality.

  • Gestures represent the forming of the rune into a spell, using physical motion as a somatic component which shape (such as Create or Arrow) a Rune's power, causing it to act in a specific way.

  • Inflections represent a further change or modification (such as Quicken or Pull), and use vocalization to alter how a spell is formed.

As your character learns Talents which provide Spellcraft components, these components will appear on the Grimoire tab of your character sheet and become usable through the Cast a Spell action. The process of learning components and discovering new spell combinations is intended to provide a rewarding experience of magical experimentation and narrative development for characters which invest into Spellcraft.

It is useful to think of the rules and structure of the Spellcraft system linguistically. If you think of a spell as a sentence, each spell must have a Rune (noun) and a Gesture (verb), and may optionally include an Inflection (adjective/adverb) that modifies either.

Spells which attack an opponent follow the rules of @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c.JournalEntryPage.lZfPVvBSsCEqlte4]{Attack Rolls}, with changes to the Ability Bonus and Base Damage of the attack depending on the combination of Rune and Gesture used.

Example: Zarajah the Pyromancer

Zarajah is an ambitious Level 6 sorcerer who strives to master the arts of elemental magic. Zarajah knows the runes for Flame, Kinesis, and Lightning as well as gestures for Touch (automatically learned), Influence, and Arrow. Additionally, Zarajah has also learned the Quicken inflection. Using these components, Zarajah has access to 18 different combinations which form Spells.

Zarajah's favorite spell is Quickened Arrow of Flame which allows her to hurl a projectile of arcane fire at a single target up to 10 spaces distant at the cost of 1 Action and 2 Focus points. The Flame rune targets Reflex defense and deals Fire Damage to Health. Arrow and Flame both scale using Intellect, so the effectiveness of this spell scales using only Intellect as a single ability score.

When Zarajah casts a Quickened Arrow of Flame towards a swooping Manticore, she rolls a 28 on her spell attack roll, beating the Manticore's Reflex defense of 21. This 7 Overflow Damage is increased by the 10 Base Damage of the Arrow gesture, resulting in a total of 17 Fire Damage dealt to the foe.

Since this attack is also a Critical Hit, the Manticore bursts into flame due to Zarajah's Pyromancer talent which inflicts the Burning condition causing additional damage-over-time.

The Cost of Magic

Every magic spell has a cost- whether used within a combat situation or for out-of-combat benefits. Generally, this cost is paid in the form of @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.Resources0000000#capacity-for-action]{Focus Points}, though in some situations the cost may use other resources or have other requirements.

As you construct your spells, the cost of the spell in Action Points and Focus Points may change based on your choice of @UUID[.p3hKRiZN3x0DEtyG]{Rune}, @UUID[.lhrYInsQ2f0YfhTu]{Gesture} and @UUID[.ELOcfx6LPZMh74y8]{Inflection}.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
施法是《Crucible》系统中对魔法进行运用的特定技艺与理论。对施法的熟练度会通过作为角色进阶一部分所习得的天赋而提升。Crucible 的施法系统被设计为动态且具有生成性的，使那些希望让自己的角色专注于施法的玩家，能够即兴发挥，并为其魔法能力发现有效的组合与应用。

精妙构图

施法允许角色通过组合一个 @UUID[.p3hKRiZN3x0DEtyG]{符文}、@UUID[.lhrYInsQ2f0YfhTu]{手势}，以及可选的一个 @UUID[.ELOcfx6LPZMh74y8]{屈折} 来显现魔法，形成法术。

  • 符文代表基础的魔法本质（例如灵魂或火焰），它们是相互结合以构成现实律法的形而上概念。

  • 手势代表将符文塑造成法术的过程，使用身体动作作为姿势成分，为符文的力量赋予形态（例如创造或箭头），使其以特定方式发挥作用。

  • 屈折代表进一步的变化或修饰（例如 Quicken 或 Pull），并通过发声来改变法术的形成方式。

随着你的角色习得提供施法构件的天赋，这些构件会出现在你角色卡的魔典分页中，并可通过施放法术行动来使用。学习构件并发现新的法术组合这一过程，旨在为那些投入施法的角色提供一种富有回报的魔法实验与叙事发展的体验。

从语言学角度来理解施法系统的规则与结构会很有帮助。如果你把一个法术看作一个句子，那么每个法术都必须有一个符文（名词）和一个手势（动词），并且可以选择包含一个屈折（形容词/副词）来修饰二者之一。

用于攻击对手的法术遵循 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c.JournalEntryPage.lZfPVvBSsCEqlte4]{攻击检定} 的规则，但攻击的能力加值和基础伤害会根据所使用的符文与手势组合而变化。

示例：炎术师扎拉贾

扎拉贾是一名雄心勃勃的6级术士，致力于精通元素魔法的技艺。扎拉贾知晓 火焰、念动力 和 闪电 符文，以及 触碰（自动习得）、影响 和 箭头 手势。此外，扎拉贾还习得了 Quicken 屈折。凭借这些构件，扎拉贾可以使用 18 种不同的组合法术。

扎拉贾最喜欢的法术是 Quickened 箭头 of 火焰，这使她能够以1动作和2专注点为代价，向至多 10 格外的单一目标投掷一道奥术火焰投射物。火焰符文以反射防御为目标，并对生命值造成火焰伤害。箭头和火焰都以智力进行成长，因此这个法术的效果只会随着单一属性值智力而提升。

当扎拉贾向一只俯冲的蝎狮施放 Quickened 箭头 of 火焰 时，她的法术攻击检定掷出了28，超过了蝎狮21点的反射防御。这7点溢出伤害再加上箭头手势的10点基础伤害，最终对敌人造成总计17点火焰伤害。

由于这次攻击同时也是一次暴击，蝎狮因扎拉贾的炎术师天赋而浑身燃起火焰，该天赋会施加燃烧状态，从而造成额外的持续伤害。

魔法的代价

每个魔法法术都有代价——无论是在战斗中使用，还是为了获得战斗外收益而使用。通常，这一代价以 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.characterMechani.JournalEntryPage.资源0000000#capacity-for-action]{专注点} 的形式支付，不过在某些情况下，这一代价也可能使用其他资源或有其他要求。

在你构造法术时，法术在动作点和专注点上的消耗，可能会根据你对 @UUID[.p3hKRiZN3x0DEtyG]{符文}、@UUID[.lhrYInsQ2f0YfhTu]{手势} 和 @UUID[.ELOcfx6LPZMh74y8]{屈折} 的选择而发生变化。

crucible.rules.json.en:
Adversaries in Crucible are the non-player characters which populate and inhabit the world. Despite the name, not all adversaries are antagonistic in nature, we simply use the term "Adversary" to refer to non-player actors in the system.

Adversaries share most mechanical concepts in common with @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6.JournalEntryPage.DjePpoV2oJenlyTf]{Overview} (player characters) including Ability Scores, Resources, Defenses, Skills, Resistances, and Talents, but adversaries progress somewhat differently than player characters.

Threat Level describes the degree of mechanical challenge posed by a certain Adversary and is defined by the product of Level and Threat Category. An adversaries attributes and difficulty scale with higher level and higher Threat Category.

Threat Level

=

Level × Threat Multiplier

Threat Categories

Each Threat Category contributes a multiplier to the effective Threat Level of the Adversary and also determines the number of @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c.JournalEntryPage.2U2k8WcnB1gbPLfd]{Action Points} that the Adversary has in combat. The Threat Categories in the Crucible system are:

Threat CategoryThreat MultiplierAction PointsDescription
Minion× 0.52Weaker than average foes at a given level, minions are less dangerous and more easily dispatched - but may be numerous in quantity.

Normal

× 13The standard level of difficulty and challenge for a certain level.
Elite× 1.54Stronger than average foes at a given level, elites are more dangerous and more difficult to dispatch. Elites are more rarely encountered.
Boss× 25Especially dangerous enemies which represent the ultimate degree of challenge at a certain level. Most encounters do not contain a boss.

Attribute Scaling

Where Protagonists feature an Ancestry and Background, instead Adversaries use the concepts of @UUID[.qSeJNy28eK9axO7C]{Taxonomy} and @UUID[.O8IesdQo8SQpIKbo]{Archetype}, both of which define how the attributes of the Adversary progress as it increases in Threat Level.

Adversary Talents

Adversaries may be assigned additional Talents in addition to those automatically provided by their Archetype.

Eventually there may be some rules limiting the number and tier of Talents that an Adversary may have, but for the time being it is acceptable for Adversaries to have any talents that the Gamemaster wishes to give them in addition to the Talents automatically provided by their Archetype.

Defeating Adversaries

Adversaries do not have Wounds or Madness pools like Protagonist characters, instead their ability to withstand harm is determined entirely by Health and Morale.

When an Adversary Health pool reaches zero it becomes @Condition[dead] or, if preferred by the Gamemaster for narrative reasons, @Condition[incapacitated], and takes no further action during the encounter.

When Adversary Morale reaches zero it becomes @Condition[broken]. A Broken Adversary will attempt to flee the battlefield unless they lack instincts of self-preservation or the possibility of escape seems impossible - in which case they will continue to fight to the death.
crucible.rules.json.cn:
对手在 Crucible 中是构成并栖居于世界中的非玩家角色。尽管名称如此，并非所有对手在本质上都是敌对的；我们只是使用“对手”一词来指代系统中的非玩家行动者。

对手与 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.gszlBVQ5fGh3y0I6.JournalEntryPage.DjePpoV2oJenlyTf]{概览}（玩家角色）共享大多数机械概念，包括属性值、资源、防御、技能、抗性和天赋，但对手的成长方式与玩家角色有所不同。

威胁等级描述某个对手所带来的机制挑战程度，由等级与威胁类别的乘积定义。对手的属性和难度会随着更高的等级和更高的威胁类别而成长。

威胁等级

=

等级 × 威胁乘数

威胁类别

每个威胁类别都会为对手的有效威胁等级提供一个乘数，同时也决定该对手在战斗中拥有的 @UUID[Compendium.crucible.rules.JournalEntry.QhZgmBrdLAGwYy5c.JournalEntryPage.2U2k8WcnB1gbPLfd]{动作点} 数量。Crucible 系统中的威胁类别如下：

威胁类别威胁乘数动作点描述
喽啰× 0.52在某一等级下比平均敌人更弱，喽啰危险性较低，也更容易被解决——但数量可能很多。

普通

× 13某一等级下标准的难度与挑战水平。
精英× 1.54在某一等级下比平均敌人更强，精英更加危险，也更难被解决。精英出现得更为少见。
Boss× 25特别危险的敌人，代表某一等级下最高程度的挑战。大多数遭遇中都不包含 Boss。

属性成长

主角角色具有血统和背景，而对手则使用 @UUID[.qSeJNy28eK9axO7C]{分类法} 与 @UUID[.O8IesdQo8SQpIKbo]{原型} 这两个概念，它们都定义了对手的属性如何随着其威胁等级提升而成长。

对手天赋

除了其原型自动提供的天赋之外，对手还可以被赋予额外的天赋。

未来可能会有一些规则限制对手可拥有的天赋数量和阶级，但目前而言，除了其原型自动提供的天赋之外，对手拥有游戏主持人希望赋予他们的任何天赋都是可以接受的。

击败对手

对手不像主角角色那样拥有创伤或疯狂池；相反，他们承受伤害的能力完全由生命值和士气决定。

当对手的生命值池降至零时，它会变为 @状态[dead]；或者如果游戏主持人出于叙事原因愿意，也可以变为 @状态[incapacitated]，并且在此次遭遇中不再采取任何行动。

当对手的士气降至零时，它会变为 @状态[broken]。一个破碎的对手会尝试逃离战场，除非其缺乏自我保存的本能，或者逃脱的可能性看起来不存在——在这种情况下，它将继续战斗至死。

crucible.spell.json.en:
You bind the weapon currently equipped in your main-hand as your Bound Armament.

While bound, you may conjure the weapon into a free hand without any resource cost. You can conjure the weapon across any distance including if it has been Disarmed.
crucible.spell.json.cn:
你将当前主手已装备的武器绑定为你的束缚武装。

在绑定期间，你可以不消耗任何资源，将该武器召唤到一只空闲的手中。无论距离多远，你都可以召唤这把武器，即使它已被缴械。

crucible.spell.json.en:
You create a pillar of magical light centered upon your current position which creates a cylinder of light creating 30 feet of bright light and an additional 30 feet of dim light. The pillar remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

This magical light counteracts magical darkness and destroys any source of magical darkness whose origin is contained within its area.

Enemies within the area when the light is first created must resist an attack against their Fortitude or be @Condition[blinded] for one round.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a light source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.
crucible.spell.json.cn:
你以当前位置为中心创造一根魔法光柱，形成一个光照圆柱，提供30英尺的明亮光照，以及额外30英尺的微光。该光柱会在原地持续6轮，直到被驱散为止。

这道魔法光照会对抗魔法黑暗，并摧毁任何起源位于其区域内的魔法黑暗源头。

光照首次生成时，区域内的敌人必须抵抗一次针对其坚韧的攻击，否则会陷入@状态[blinded]状态，持续一轮。

WIP：该法术目前尚不会自动创建光源，暂时必须手动完成。最终这将通过 Foundry VTT 第14版中用于模板放置的新框架实现自动化。

crucible.spell.json.en:
You create a sphere of magical darkness around your current position with 20 foot radius which remains in place for 6 rounds or until dispelled.

Within the area of this darkness all non-magical light sources are quenched and creatures are treated as @Condition[blinded].

The area of this sphere is constrained by solid walls. Creatures outside this area cannot see into it and the effective area of light sources outside this area ends at its perimeter.

WIP: This spell does not yet automatically create a darkness source, which must be done manually for now. Eventually this will be automated using a new Foundry VTT version 14 framework for template placement.
crucible.spell.json.cn:
你在当前位置周围创造一个半径20英尺的魔法黑暗球体，它会保持在原地持续6轮，直到被驱散为止。

在这片黑暗区域内，所有非魔法光源都会熄灭，且生物视为处于@状态[blinded]状态。

该球体的区域会受到实体墙壁的限制。该区域外的生物无法看入其中，而该区域外的光源其有效照明范围会止于其边界。

WIP：此法术目前尚不会自动创建一个黑暗源，暂时必须手动完成。未来将使用 Foundry VTT 第14版中用于模板放置的新框架实现自动化。

crucible.spell.json.en: You become @Condition[invisible] and cannot be detected using sight-based perception. You cannot be directly targeted by any action. This spell must be Maintained in order to remain in effect.
crucible.spell.json.cn: 你获得@状态[invisible]，且无法通过基于视觉的察觉被发现。你不能成为任何动作的直接目标。此法术必须被维持才能持续生效。

crucible.spell.json.en: You restore a creature which has recently become @Condition[dead] back to life, reducing its Wounds by your Wisdom score. If successful, the revived creature is @Condition[disoriented] and @Condition[staggered] for 10 minutes.
crucible.spell.json.cn: 你使一个最近刚刚 @状态[dead] 的生物恢复生命，并将其创伤减少你的感知值。若成功，复活的生物将陷入 @状态[disoriented] 和 @状态[staggered] 状态，持续10分钟。

crucible.spell.json.en: A rudimentary example of the complex art of penetrating the minds of others, Telecognition skims thoughts from the surface of a subject's mind like leaves from the surface of a pond. Though it may not be disruptive, it is unsubtle— just as the pond ripples when its surface is touched, so too does the mind.
crucible.spell.json.cn: 这是渗透他人心智这一复杂技艺的一个粗浅示例，遥感认知会像从池塘地表撇去树叶一样，从目标心智的表层掠取思绪。虽然它未必会造成扰乱，但却并不隐蔽——正如触碰池塘地表时会泛起涟漪，心智也同样如此。

crucible.spell.json.en:
You reach into the mind of a Humanoid or Giant creature, attempting to penetrate their Willpower defense to understand their thoughts and motives. The target of this spell is aware of the intrusion, even if they cannot perceive you.

If successful, the Gamemaster (in the case of an Adversary target) or Player (in the case of a Hero target) must describe to you in 3 words or less what idea or sentiment is at the forefront of their thoughts in the current moment.

Upon a Critical Success, this description may use up to 10 words to convey deeper understanding.
crucible.spell.json.cn:
你将意识探入一个人型生物或巨人生物的心智，试图突破其意志防御，以理解他们的想法与动机。该法术的目标会察觉到这种入侵，即使他们无法感知到你。

若成功，游戏主持人（当目标为对手时）或玩家（当目标为英雄时）必须用不超过3个词向你描述此刻其思绪最前端的想法或情绪。

在大成功时，该描述最多可使用10个词，以传达更深层的理解。

crucible.summons.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.
crucible.summons.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}可以穿过直径窄至 1 英寸的空间，且其跨步不会受到任何惩罚。它免疫@状态[受缚]状态。

crucible.summons.json.en: The @ref[actor.name]{creature} may move through a space as narrow as 1 inch in diameter without any penalty to its Stride. It is immune to the @Condition[restrained] condition.
crucible.summons.json.cn: 该@ref[actor.name]{生物}可以穿过直径窄至 1 英寸的空间，而其跨步不会受到任何减值。它免疫 @状态[受缚] 状况。

crucible.talent.json.en: You rapidly bolster the Morale of an ally within 4 feet by applying vapours. Perform a Medicine check against the target's Madness Threshold. Successful checks restore Morale.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你通过施加蒸汽，迅速振奋4英尺内一名盟友的士气。进行一次医疗检定，对抗目标的疯狂阈值。成功的检定会恢复士气。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Arcana skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在奥术技能中获得熟练工等级，提供+1 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You anticipate dodging an attack, intercepting it to intentionally Parry the strike.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你预判到将要闪避一次攻击，并将其截下，故意招架这次打击。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You specialize in bringing death the the unwary. Any Strike or Spell attack against an Unaware target becomes Deadly.

An Unaware creature hit by your attack may not alert its allies until its own turn in Combat.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你专精于为毫无防备者带来死亡。对未察觉目标进行的任何打击或法术攻击都会变为致命。

被你攻击命中的未察觉生物，在战斗中直到其自身的回合前，都无法提醒其盟友。

crucible.talent.json.en: You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a Knowledge Test about your target. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the target is Vulnerable. Your minimum Initiative during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the Initiative of your marked target.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你花费1分钟研究一个生物。进行一次关于你目标的知识检定。若成功，你会得知目标对哪些伤害类型处于易伤状态。在战斗的第一轮中，你的最低先攻值变为比你已标记目标的先攻值高1。

You spend 1 minute studying a creature. Perform a 知识检定 about your 目标. If successful, you learn all damage types against which the 目标 is Vulnerable. Your minimum 先攻 during the first round of Combat becomes one greater than the 先攻 of your marked 目标.

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Athletics skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在运动技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You have received training in basic athletics. You gain the Novice rank in the Athletics skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know whether a surface can support your weight or not, how to find handholds while climbing, and how to distribute your weight for buoyancy when swimming. You know how to run for distance, and how to pace yourself to avoid exhaustion.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你已接受基础运动训练。你获得运动技能的新手等级，且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。

你知道地表是否能够支撑你的重量，也知道在攀爬时如何寻找可抓握处，以及在游泳时如何分配重量以获得浮力。你知道如何进行长跑，以及如何调整节奏以避免力竭。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Awareness skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在察觉技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
When an enemy uses an attack that fails to affect you or any ally, you construct a cutting jest or pantomime which makes a fool of their feeble effort.

You make an Performance skill attack against the target's Fortitude, dealing Psychic damage to Morale upon a success. Furthermore, upon a success, the target suffers 1 Bane to all rolls until the start of their next turn.

The target must be able to see and understand you to be affected by this ability.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
当一名敌人使用一次未能影响你或任何盟友的攻击时，你会即兴编出一段尖刻的嘲讽或滑稽的模仿，将他们无力的尝试变成笑柄。

你对目标的坚韧进行一次表演技能攻击，成功时对其士气造成灵能伤害。此外，若成功，目标在其下个回合开始前的所有掷骰都承受 1 祸骰。

目标必须能够看见并理解你，才会受到此能力影响。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Your body has endured so many injuries that it has learned how to mend itself with remarkable efficiency. When you perform the Rest action, you recover additional Wounds equal to half your Toughness score (rounded down).

Playtest Notes

This talent is not yet automated. Apply the additional wounds recovery manually when resting.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你的身体已经承受了太多伤害，因此学会了如何以惊人的效率自行愈合。当你执行休息动作时，你额外恢复等于你坚韧属性值一半（向下取整）的创伤。

试玩测试说明

此天赋尚未实现自动化。休息时请手动应用额外的创伤恢复。

crucible.talent.json.en: Make an Athletics skill Attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Fortitude defense. On a success you may move up to your Stride directly through the enemy's space. Your enemy is knocked Prone and may not make any attack of opportunity against you. On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 对一个相邻敌人进行一次运动技能攻击，由目标的坚韧防御进行对抗。若成功，你可以移动最多至你的跨步，并直接穿过敌人的空间。你的敌人会被击至倒地，且不能对你进行任何借机攻击。若失败，你的移动会被阻挡，并且你仍停留在当前位置。

crucible.talent.json.en: You are drilled in performing sequences of melee attacks with rhythmic precision. When you Strike multiple times in sequence using a one-handed melee weapon you gain a stacking +1 Boon for each successive attack.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你经过严格训练，能够以富有节奏的精准度连续进行一系列近战攻击。当你使用单手近战武器连续多次进行打击时，每次后续攻击都会获得可叠加的+1 恩惠。

crucible.talent.json.en: You find calmness and focus in conserving your effort in battle. When you end your Turn with un-spent Action you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你会在战斗中节省精力时找到平静与专注。当你在回合结束时仍有未消耗的动作，你获得+1 专注。

crucible.talent.json.en: When you defend against a melee attack with a Parry, you may react and expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike which benefits from the Exposed condition.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 当你以招架对抗一次近战攻击进行防御时，你可以作出反应并消耗专注，以较低代价进行一次打击反击，并从暴露状态中获益。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You form arcane energy into a countervailing spellcraft, targeting a spellcaster you can see within 30 feet.

Designate a Rune and Gesture which you know to attempt to counter the spell. Choosing a Rune which is opposed to one used in the spell grants +2 Boons to your attempt. Selecting the identical Gesture as the one being cast also adds +2 Boons to your attempt.

Perform a harmless Spell Attack against your target's Willpower defense. If your roll exceeds their defense, the spell is countered and its magic is nullified, producing no effects.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将奥术能量塑形成一道对抗性的施法，目标为你在30英尺内可见的一名施法者。

指定一个你知晓的符文和手势，以尝试反制该法术。若你选择的符文与该法术所用的某个符文相对，则你的此次尝试获得+2恩惠。若你选择的手势与正在施放的手势完全相同，你的此次尝试也获得+2恩惠。

对目标的意志防御进行一次无害的法术攻击。若你的掷骰结果超过其防御，则该法术被反制，其魔法被消除，不产生任何效果。

crucible.talent.json.en: When you defend against a melee attack with a Block you may expend Focus to retaliate with a reduced-cost Strike using your mainhand weapon.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 当你以格挡来防御一次近战攻击时，你可以消耗专注，使用你的主手武器进行一次减耗的打击作为反击。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Adept rank in the Diplomacy skill, providing a +2 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在外交技能上获得行家等级，获得+2 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Diplomacy skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在外交技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You make a Strike against a the Reflex defense of a single target. The technique is Difficult to perform and deals reduced damage. If successful, the target's mainhand weapon is Dropped.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你对单个目标的反射防御进行一次打击。此技巧施展起来困难，且造成的伤害降低。若成功，目标的主手武器将脱手。

crucible.talent.json.en: You make a Deception based Skill Attack against the Willpower defense of a target within 30 feet which can see or hear you. On a success, the target loses 1 Focus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你对30英尺内一个能看见或听见你的目标发动一次基于欺瞒的技能加值攻击，对抗其意志防御。若成功，目标失去1点专注。

crucible.talent.json.en: Immediately after you perform a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you make a reduced-cost fullow-up Strike with your offhand weapon.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 在你用主手武器进行一次基础打击后，立即用副手武器进行一次减耗的后续打击。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Earth. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[corroding] condition on Critical Hits.

The Corroding effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Wisdom score as Acid damage to Health each Round.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织大地符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[corroding] 状态。

该腐蚀效果持续3 轮，并且每轮会造成等同于你感知属性值的酸液伤害，作用于生命值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You feint with your mainhand weapon, making a Deception attack against the target's Reflex defense. You immediately make a Strike with your offhand weapon.

If your Deception was successful, you gain +2 Boons to your Strike and it deals an additional +6 Damage.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你用主手武器佯攻，对目标的反射防御进行一次欺瞒攻击。你立即用副手武器进行一次打击。

如果你的欺瞒成功，你的打击获得+2 恩惠，并额外造成+6 伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: You loose a Empowered ranged strike using a Projectile weapon which deals Fire damage upon impact.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你使用一把投射武器进行一次强化远程打击，并在命中时造成火焰伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: Move forward between 3 feet and 6 feet in a straight line to kick an enemy with an empowered Strike.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 移动向前 3 至 6 英尺，沿直线前进，并以一次强化打击踢向一名敌人。

crucible.talent.json.en: Anticipation leads to decisive action. When you have the highest Initiative score for a Round of combat, you gain +1 Focus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 预判带来果断行动。当你在战斗的一轮中拥有最高的先攻值时，你获得+1 专注。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You concentrate the arcane power of a Rune to create a maintained field of energy that washes over allies and enemies near to you.

The Aura gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 20 feet radius centered on the spellcaster. The center of this Aura moves with the spellcaster.

Depending on the Rune used, the Aura deals damage or provides healing to any creature which begins its turn inside the Aura. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast, has a base cost of 5 Action and 1 Focus, and must be Maintained costing an additional 1 Focus every subsequent round.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Emanation templates which are linked to the Token and move when the Token moves are a feature coming in Foundry VTT version 14. Automation of the Aura gesture will occur once Crucible depends on Foundry VTT version 14.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将符文的奥术力量集中起来，创造出一个需要维持的能量场，冲刷你附近的盟友与敌人。

灵气手势会随存在而增强，产生一个以施法者为中心、半径20英尺的扩散区域。该灵气的中心会随着施法者移动。

根据所使用的符文不同，该灵气会对任何在其内开始自己回合的生物造成伤害或提供治疗。此手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和1专注，并且必须维持，此后每个后续轮次都要额外消耗1专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时习得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

与Token关联并会在Token移动时一同移动的扩散区域模板，是 Foundry VTT 第14版即将推出的功能。一旦 Crucible 依赖 Foundry VTT 第14版，就会实现灵气手势的自动化。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You hurl the arcane power of a Rune into an intense explosion of energy at a nearby point you can see.

The Blast gesture scales with Intellect and produces a blast with 6 feet radius centered on a point within 60 feet of the spellcaster. The blast deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量投向你视线内附近的一点，在那里引发一场强烈的能量爆破。

爆破手势随智力而缩放，并在施法者60英尺内选定的一点为中心产生一个半径6英尺的爆破区域。该爆破会对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。此手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You focus the arcane power of a Rune into a narrow cone that projects outwards from your location.

The Cone gesture scales with Intellect and produces a 60 degree cone with a 30 foot radius originating from the spellcaster. The Cone deals 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量聚焦成一道狭窄的锥形区域，自你所在的位置向外投射。

锥形手势会随智力而变化，生成一个以施法者为起点、半径30英尺、60度的锥形区域。该锥形会对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。此手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时习得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You coalesce arcane power into a superior form, manifesting a Visitor which appears within 30 feet and joins Combat at Initiative 1. Your Visitor is a Minion equal to your own Level.

The Conjure gesture scales with Wisdom and the Visitor survives for 12 Rounds. You may only have one active Visitor. Casting another spell using the Conjure gesture replaces your previous Visitor. This gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.

Not all Runes have a Visitor actor defined yet. Runes that do not yet have a defined Conjuration will — for now — manifest a Flame Visitor.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将奥术力量凝聚为一种更高等的形态，显现出一个访客；它会出现在30英尺内，并以先攻 1加入战斗。你的访客是一个与你自身等级相同的仆从。

召唤手势按感知进行成长，且该访客可存续12轮。你同时只能拥有一个处于激活状态的访客。使用召唤手势再次施放其他法术时，会替换你先前的访客。该手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试，暂时“提前”开放。

并非所有符文都已定义访客角色。对于尚未定义召唤物的符文，当前将会显现一个火焰访客。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You attune your mind to the arcane power of a Rune to sense nearby sources of energy.

The Sense gesture scales with Presence and produces an emanation with 30 feet radius and position that remains centered upon the spellcaster. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus. It may optionally be Maintained at the additional cost of 1 Focus every subsequent round.

This spell allows the caster to detect the presence of spellcraft using the same Rune as the one incorporated in this spell. The sense will also momentarily detect the presence of creatures according to their type.

  • Control: Fiends

  • Death: Undead

  • Earth: Oozes and Earth Elementals

  • Flame: Dragons and Fire Elementals

  • Frost: Giants and Frost Elementals

  • Illumination: Celestials

  • Illusion: Fey

  • Kinesis: Monstrosities

  • Life: Plants and Beasts

  • Lightning: Constructs and Storm Elementals

  • Oblivion: Outsiders

  • Soul: Humanoids

Playtest Notes

There is no automation for the sense that is temporarily granted by this spell, but such automation can be provided in the future via a Detection Mode which temporarily reveals creatures of the appropriate type to the spellcaster while the spell is maintained.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将心神与一种符文的奥术力量调谐，以感知附近的能量源。

感知手势会随灵识成长，产生一个半径 30 尺、位置始终以施法者为中心的扩散区域。此手势施放时需要1 只手，基础消耗为3 动作和1 专注。你也可以选择维持它，但此后每个后续轮次都需额外消耗1 专注。

此法术允许施法者侦测与本法术所融入的同一符文相关的施法存在。该感知也会短暂侦测到生物的存在，具体取决于其类型。

  • 控制：邪魔

  • 死亡：不死生物

  • 大地：软泥怪和土元素

  • 火焰：巨龙和火元素

  • 霜冻：巨人和冰霜元素

  • 照明：天界生物

  • 幻象：妖精

  • 念动力：怪物

  • 生命：植物和野兽

  • 闪电：构装体和风暴元素

  • 湮灭：外来者

  • 灵魂：人型生物

试玩测试说明

目前尚无针对该法术临时赋予的感知的自动化支持，但未来可通过一种侦测模式提供此类自动化：当法术被维持时，它会暂时向施法者揭示相应类型的生物。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You channel the arcane power of a Rune into a rushing wave of energy that surges forward from your current position.

The Surge gesture scales with Wisdom and produces a line that is 10 feet wide and 15 feet long originating from the spellcaster, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将一个符文的奥术力量引导为一股奔涌的能量波，从你当前位置向前激荡而出。

涌动手势会随感知成长，产生一条以施法者为起点、10英尺宽、15英尺长的直线，对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。该手势需要2只手施放，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前位于一个第4阶节点。它最终将只能在更高等级时习得（可能需要6级）。当前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You shape the essence of a Rune into a sweeping or splintered arc to strike multiple targets in close proximity.

The Fan gesture scales using Intellect and targets a 120 degree arc with 6 foot radius. It deals 6 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture requires 1 Hand to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将一个符文的精华塑造成一道横扫或碎裂的弧形，以打击近距离内的多个目标。

扇形手势基于智力进行成长，目标区域为一个半径 6 英尺、120 度的弧形。它对未能抵抗该法术的目标造成6 基础伤害。这个手势施放时需要1 只手，基础消耗为3 动作和1 专注。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Expel the arcane power of a Rune in a radius that travels outward with you at its center.

The Pulse gesture scales using Presence and produces an emanation with 10 foot radius, dealing 8 Base Damage to targets which fail to Resist the spell. The gesture requires 2 Hands to cast and has a base cost of 5 Action and 2 Focus.

Playtest Notes

This talent is currently placed at a Tier 4 node. It will eventually only be attainable at a higher level (probably Level 6 required). It is currently available "early" for testing.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
将符文中的奥术力量释放出来，以你为中心向外扩散成一片区域。

脉冲手势按Presence进行缩放，产生一个半径10英尺的散发区域，对未能抗拒该法术的目标造成8基础伤害。该手势施放需要双手，基础消耗为5动作和2专注。

试玩测试说明

该天赋目前放置在一个第4阶节点上。它最终将只能在更高等级时获得（可能需要6级）。目前为了测试而“提前”开放。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You infuse runic power into a movement, crossing physical and spatial boundaries.

The Step gesture scales with Dexterity and allows you to move up to 20 feet in a straight line with width equal to your Size. It deals 2 Base Damage to targets along that line which fail to Resist the spell. This gesture does not require any free hands to cast and has a base cost of 3 Action and 1 Focus.

Playtest Notes

The movement aspect of this talent is not yet automated and must be manually performed as a consequence of the spell.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你将符文之力灌注于一次移动之中，穿越物理与空间的边界。

踏步手势会随敏捷而变化，并允许你沿直线移动最多20英尺，宽度等于你的体型。它会对该直线上的未能抵抗此法术的目标造成2 基础伤害。施放此手势不需要任何空闲的手，基础消耗为3 动作和1 专注。

试玩测试说明

此天赋的移动部分尚未自动化，必须作为该法术效果的结果手动执行。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Make an unarmed Strike against the Fortitude defense of an adjacent enemy. If your Initiative is superior to that of your target, you gain +1 Boon to this attack.

The attack is Difficult and only deals Weakened damage, but if successful it inflicts the @Condition[staggered] for one round.

This action always uses an Unarmed weapon, even if your weapon slots are otherwise occupied.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
对相邻敌人的坚韧防御进行一次徒手打击。如果你的先攻高于你的目标，则此次攻击获得+1 恩惠骰。

此次攻击是困难的，且只造成虚弱伤害，但如果成功，则会使其陷入 @状态[staggered]，持续一轮。

此行动始终使用徒手武器，即使你的武器槽位已被其他武器占用也是如此。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Soul. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[inspired] condition on Critical Hits.

The Inspired effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as additional Restoration to Morale.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织灵魂符文。使用该符文的法术在暴击时会造成 @状态[inspired] 状态。

鼓舞效果持续1 轮，并额外对士气施加等同于你Presence数值的恢复。

crucible.talent.json.en:
As a Reaction when an adjacent ally is hit or glanced by a single-target attack that targeted their Physical Defense, you may Interpose to become the target of that attack instead.

The attack is negated and the attack is re-evaluated against your own Physical Defense using the same dice rolls from the original attack. The consequences of the attack are resolved according to this new result with you as its target.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
作为一种反应，当一名邻近盟友被一次以其物理防御为目标的单体攻击命中或擦伤时，你可以进行拦护，改为由你成为该次攻击的目标。

该次攻击对原目标无效，并使用原始攻击相同的掷骰结果，改为对你的物理防御重新判定。此次攻击的后果将根据这一新的结果结算，而你为其目标。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Adept rank in the Intimidation skill, providing a +2 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在威吓技能上获得行家等级，获得+2技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Intimidation skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在威吓技能中获得熟练工等级，并获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Master rank in the Intimidation skill, providing a +3 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在威吓技能上获得大师等级，获得+3 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You understand the fundamentals of how threats and coercion can achieve desired outcomes. You gain the Novice rank in the Intimidation skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know how to use simple displays of violence or overt threats to get others to follow your lead, but you aren't very subtle.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你理解威胁与胁迫如何达成预期结果的基本原理。你获得威吓技能的新手等级，且不再被视为该技能未受训。

你知道如何运用简单的暴力展示或公开威胁来让他人听从你的指挥，但你并不怎么高明。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Kinesis. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[bleeding] condition on Critical Hits.

The Bleeding effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence ability score as additional Piercing damage to Health.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你对编织念动力符文极为娴熟。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加@状态[bleeding]状态。

流血效果会持续1 轮，并将你的Presence属性值作为额外的Piercing伤害施加到生命值上。

crucible.talent.json.en: Your prodigious hardiness conveys a supernatural capability to recover from wounds quickly. At the start of your turn if you are not Weakened you gain +1 Health.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你惊人的坚韧赋予了你一种超自然的能力，使你能够从创伤中迅速恢复。在你的回合开始时，若你未处于虚弱状态，则获得+1 生命值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You dart forward nimbly, making a strike with sudden and unexpected swiftness to perform a Strike with a weapon which scales using Dexterity against a single target, with an increased range of +2 feet.

The attack is Difficult, but you do not move from your current position nor does this attack provoke Disengagement.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你敏捷地向前猛冲，以突然而出其不意的迅捷发动一次打击，使用一把以敏捷进行成长的武器对单个目标进行一次打击，且射程增加+2 feet。

此次攻击为困难，但你不会从当前位置移动，且此次攻击不会引发脱离接战。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illumination. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[irradiated] condition on Critical Hits.

The Irradiated effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Presence score as Radiant damage to both Health and Morale.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织照明符文。使用此符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[irradiated] 状态。

辐照效果会持续1 轮，并对生命值和士气造成等同于你的Presence数值的Radiant伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of crossbows, firearms, and other mechanical weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Mechanical category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在使用弩、火器及其他机械武器方面受过熟练训练。你获得熟练工训练等级，以及在机械类别武器上的+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You are familiar in the design and usage of crossbows, firearms, and other similar armaments. You are Trained with weapons in the Mechanical category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你熟悉弩、火器及其他类似武器的设计与使用。你对机械类别中的武器拥有受训熟练等级。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You have a basic education in anatomy, physiology, and medicine. You gain the Novice rank in the Medicine skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You’ve learned the basics of treating common wounds and illnesses, and keep a running list of known alchemical and herbal compounds that can be used for treating particular illnesses. With a little time studying an injured, diseased, or otherwise ill individual you can perform a basic diagnosis and treat accordingly.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你接受过基础的解剖学、生理学和医疗教育。你获得医疗技能的新手等级，且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。

你已经学会了治疗常见创伤和疾病的基础知识，并持续记录已知的炼金与草药化合物清单，这些化合物可用于治疗特定疾病。只要花一点时间研究一名受伤、染病或以其他方式患病的个体，你就能进行基础诊断并据此治疗。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Life. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[mending] condition on Critical Hits.

The Mending effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom score as additional Restoration to Health.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织生命符文。使用此符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[mending] 状态。

修补效果持续 1 轮，并将你的 感知 数值作为额外的 恢复 施加到 生命值 上。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Illusion. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[confused] on Critical Hits.

The Confused effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Psychic damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[disoriented] condition.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织幻象符文。使用该符文的法术在暴击时会造成 @状态[confused]。

混乱效果持续1 轮，对士气造成相当于你智力属性一半的灵能伤害，并施加 @状态[disoriented] 状态。

crucible.talent.json.en: You have a fluent familiarity with the use of natural bodily weapons. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Natural category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你对天生武器的使用已相当熟练。你获得熟练工训练等级，以及使用天生类别中的武器时获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Death. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[decaying] condition on Critical Hits.

The Decaying effect lasts for 3 Rounds and deals your Intellect score as Corruption damage to Health each Round.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你非常擅长编织死亡符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[decaying] 状态。

腐坏效果持续3 轮，并且每轮对生命值造成等同于你的智力属性值的腐化伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: You sieze any opportunity you can to capitalize on an enemy who turns their back on you. You may make a Disengagement Attack even if you are otherwise Fully Engaged, but you do so without the 2 Boons that would ordinarily apply to such an attack.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你会抓住任何机会，对背对你的敌人趁机下手。即使你处于完全接战状态，你仍可进行一次脱离攻击，但你进行此次攻击时，不获得通常适用于此类攻击的2个恩惠。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Adept rank in the Performance skill, providing a +2 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在表演技能上获得行家等级，获得+2 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Performance skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在表演技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You have learned the basic practices of art and entertainment. You gain the Novice rank in the Performance skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You know a few common dances, have a collection of well-known tales, and you could probably sing or play a few popular songs. You may be trained in an instrument or two, and your capability with a brush or pen is reasonable enough that you could probably create a passable work of art.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你已经学会了艺术与娱乐的基本实践。你在表演技能上获得新手等级，并且在该技能上不再被视为未受训。

你会一些常见的舞蹈，收集了一些广为人知的故事，而且你大概还能唱几首流行歌曲或演奏几首流行曲目。你或许受过一两种乐器的训练，而你使用画笔或笔的能力也相当不错，大概足以创作出一件还算过得去的艺术作品。

crucible.talent.json.en: You Strike from distance. The attack is Difficult, however if your target is it it becomes Restrained until the end of their next Turn.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你从远处打击。此次攻击为困难，但如果你的目标是它，它会陷入受缚，直到其下个回合结束。

crucible.talent.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of projectile weaponry. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Projectile category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你接受过投射武器装备使用方面的熟练教育。你获得熟练工训练等级，并在投射类别的武器上获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Flame. Spells which use this Rune cause @Condition[burning] on Critical Hits.

The Burning effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Intellect score as Fire damage to both Health and Morale.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织火焰符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[burning]。

燃烧效果持续1 轮，并对生命值和士气各造成等同于你的智力属性值的火元素伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: You emit a courageous bellow that inspires allies within 12 feet of you to remain stalwart in the face of peril. All allies within range immediately recover your Presence score in Morale and become @Condition[resolute] for 3 Rounds.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你发出一声勇敢的怒吼，激励12英尺内的盟友在险境面前保持坚定。范围内的所有盟友立即恢复等同于你的Presence数值的士气，并成为 @状态[resolute]，持续3轮。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Frost. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[freezing] condition on Critical Hits.

The Freezing effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Wisdom score as Frost damage to Health, and applies the @Condition[slowed] condition.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织霜冻符文。使用此符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[freezing] 状态。

冰冻效果持续1 轮，对生命值造成你感知属性值一半的霜冻伤害，并施加 @状态[slowed] 状态。

crucible.talent.json.en:
The orderly force of discipline and permanence. The Control rune governs thought, reason, and persistence.

The Control rune scales using Wisdom, targets Willpower, and deals Psychic damage to Morale. It is opposed by the chaotic rune of Kinesis.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
纪律与恒久的有序力量。控制符文支配思维、理性与坚持。

控制符文以感知进行成长，目标为意志力，并对士气造成灵能伤害。它所对立的是混沌的念动力符文。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Kinesis allows you to exert local control over gravitational forces to perform basic telekinetic manipulations, producing one of the following effects:

  • Pull an unsecured object within 15 feet and with weight no greater than 1 towards you and catch it. An object that is equipped or possessed by a creature is never treated as unsecured unless that creature is willing to release it.

  • Flick an object that you hold with weight no greater than 1 towards a target up to 30 feet away. The object flies unerringly in a straight line towards that target at a moderate speed. Any creature along the object's path can react to catch it as long as they have a free hand with which to do so.

  • Suspend in midair an object or willing creature that you touch with weight less than or equal to 10 times your Presence, altering its position up to 20 feet in any direction from its original location. You can maintain this suspension indefinitely as long as you take no further Action and are not @Condition[incapacitated].

Propel may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch unless otherwise specified. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你对念动力符文的掌控使你能够对局部重力施加控制，以执行基础的心灵遥控操纵，产生以下效果之一：

  • 将15英尺内一个未固定且重量不大于1的物体拉向你，并接住它。由生物已装备或持有的物体，除非该生物愿意放手，否则绝不视为未固定。

  • 将一个你手持且重量不大于1的物体弹向一个最远30英尺外的目标。该物体会以适中的速度沿直线准确无误地飞向该目标。物体路径上的任何生物都可以作出反应接住它，只要他们有一只空着的手来这么做。

  • 使一个你接触到的物体或自愿生物悬浮在半空中，其重量小于或等于你Presence的10倍，并将其位置从原本所在处朝任意方向改变最多20英尺。只要你不再执行进一步的动作，且未处于@状态[incapacitated]，你就可以无限期维持这种悬浮状态。

除非另有说明，推进只能影响你能够以身体接触到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人裁定。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Life allows you to stimulate biological growth and nourish physical health, producing one of the following effects:

  • Cultivate 1 cubic foot of existing plants or fungus to rapidly grow to a healthy, blossoming, or harvestable state.

  • Identify a negative physical condition that is affecting a creature such as @Condition[diseased], @Condition[poisoned], @Condition[bleeding], or @Condition[weakened].

  • Verify whether a portion of food or drink is free of contamination from bacteria, parasites, or poison.

Bloom may only affect a creature or object you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你对生命符文的命令使你能够刺激生物材料生长并滋养生命，从而产生以下效果之一：

  • 培育1立方英尺的现有植物或真菌，使其快速生长至健康、绽放或可收获的状态。

  • 鉴定术一个正在影响生物的负面生理状态，例如 @状态[diseased]、@状态[poisoned]、@状态[bleeding] 或 @Condondition[weakened]。

  • 确认一份食物或饮料是否未受到细菌、寄生虫或毒物的污染。

绽放只能影响你能够以身体接触到的生物或物体。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Your command of the Rune of Soul allows you to facilitate basic forms of spiritual influence, producing one of the following effects:

  • Enable yourself or another willing person to revisit a core memory of a moment from their past up to one minute in duration as if it happened recently.

  • Identify a negative spiritual condition that is affecting a person such as @Condition[broken], @Condition[frightened], @Condition[confused], or @Condition[insane].

  • Create a momentary spiritual connection with another willing creature that allows them to recognize an idea which can be expressed as a single word.

Uses of Evoke may only affect yourself or another creature which you can physically touch. You may attempt other uses similar those above, the effectiveness of which is decided by the Gamemaster.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你对灵魂符文的掌控使你能够促成基础形式的精神影响，产生以下效果之一：

  • 使你自己或另一位自愿者重温其过去某一时刻的核心记忆，持续时间最长为一分钟，仿佛那是最近发生的一样。

  • 鉴定影响某人的一种负面精神状态，例如 @状态[broken]、@状态[frightened]、@状态[confused] 或 @状态[insane]。

  • 与另一位自愿的生物建立短暂的精神连接，使其能够领会一个可以用单个词语表达的想法。

引发的用途只能影响你自己或另一名你能够以身体接触到的生物。你也可以尝试其他与上述类似的用途，其效果由游戏主持人决定。

crucible.talent.json.en: After defeating an enemy, you may move up to your Stride and attack another foe within melee range.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 击败一名敌人后，你可以移动至多等同于你的步幅，并攻击另一名处于近战范围内的敌人。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Science skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在科学技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You have a fluent education in the use of shields in combat. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Shield category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你熟练掌握了在战斗中使用盾牌的技巧。你获得熟练工训练等级，并在盾牌武器类别上获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You are practiced at fighting with shield, using it to slam into and imbalance your foes. You are Trained with weapons in the Shield category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你擅长持盾作战，能用它猛击并打乱敌人的平衡。你对盾牌类别中的武器达到受训熟练。

crucible.talent.json.en: Following a basic Strike with your mainhand weapon, you Strike with your shield, causing the @Condition[staggered] condition for one Round.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 在用你的主手武器进行一次基础打击后，你以你的盾牌打击，并使目标陷入 @状态[staggered] 状态，持续一轮。

crucible.talent.json.en: A defensive technique in which you drive forward, slamming and pushing foes out of your path. You charge up to 20 feet in a straight line and perform an offhand shield Strike against each successive foe along your path.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 一种防御技巧，你向前猛冲，以撞击与推挤将敌人从你的路径上逼开。你以直线冲锋最多20英尺，并对路径上每个接连遭遇的敌人各进行一次副手盾牌打击。

crucible.talent.json.en:
As a Reaction to an action that targets you before it is confirmed, you may expend Heroism to instantly move up to your Stride. The interrupted action is nullified without being confirmed or applying any effects.

This movement does not provoke any Disengagement.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
作为对一个以你为目标、且在其被确认前的动作所作出的反应，你可以消耗英雄气概，立即移动至多等同于你的步幅。被打断的动作会被无效化，既不会被确认，也不会施加任何效果。

此次移动不会引发任何脱离接战。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Adept rank in the Society skill, providing a +2 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在社交技能中获得行家等级，提供+2 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Society skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在社交技能上获得熟练工等级，获得+1 技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You have learned the fundamental building blocks of Society, the mores, beliefs, history and politics which directly inform the growth of culture. You gain the Novice rank in the Society skill and are no longer considered Untrained in that skill.

You understand that history and politics contribute prominently to the way decisions are made at the highest and lowest levels of society, and how tradition frequently informs subgroups of society to place them in opposition to one another.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你已经学交了构成社交的基本要素，即那些直接影响文化发展的习俗、信念、历史与政治。你在社会技能上获得新手等级，并且不再被视为在该技能上未受训。

你明白，历史与政治在社会最高层与最底层的决策方式中都起着显著作用，而传统也常常影响社会中的各个子群体，使其彼此对立。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are an arcane warrior who can weave together Strike and Spell relying on both martial and arcane techniques in battle. The physical strikes of your weaponry partially substitute for the somatic gestures of traditional spellcraft.

While wielding a Melee weapon as your mainhand weapon, spells you cast using Gesture: Strike benefit from your weapon's damage bonus.

Immediately after performing a Strike with a melee weapon, you may cast a spell with its Action cost reduced by 1.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你是一名奥术战士，能够在战斗中结合打击与法术，同时依靠武艺与奥术技巧。你武器装备的实体打击部分替代了传统施法中的躯体手势。

当你以一把近战武器作为主手武器进行持用时，你使用手势：打击施放的法术可获得该武器的伤害加值。

在你以一把近战武器执行一次打击后，你可以立即施放一个其动作消耗减少 1 的法术。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Lightning. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[shocked] condition on Critical Hits.

The Shocked effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Intellect score as Lightning damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[staggered] condition.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织闪电符文。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加 @状态[shocked] 状态。

电击效果会持续 1 轮，对士气造成相当于你智力数值一半的闪电伤害，并施加 @状态[staggered] 状态。

crucible.talent.json.en: You understand the arcane usage of talismans, orbs, foci, or other similar implements to channel magic or empower spellcraft. You are Trained with weapons in the Talisman categories.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你了解如何运用护符、法珠、法器或其他类似器具来引导魔法或强化施法中的奥术用法。你对护符类别武器拥有受训熟练度。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You use your equipped Talisman to attempt to regain some Focus. You perform a Harmless Strike against your own Rallying threshold.

On a success you recover +1 Focus if using a one-handed Talisman and +2 Focus if using a two-handed Talisman. On a critical success the amount of Focus recovered increases by an additional +1.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你使用你已装备的护符，尝试恢复一些专注。你对自己的振奋阈值进行一次无害的打击。

成功时，若使用的是单手护符，则你恢复 +1 专注；若使用的是双手持用护符，则你恢复 +2 专注。若大成功，则恢复的专注量额外增加 +1。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Control. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[dominated] condition on Critical Hits.

The Dominated effect lasts for 1 Round and deals your Wisdom ability score as additional Psychic damage to Morale.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你极其擅长编织控制符文。使用此符文的法术在暴击时会施加 @状态[dominated] 状态。

Dominated 效果持续 1 轮，并将你的感知属性值作为额外的灵能伤害施加到士气上。

crucible.talent.json.en:
Make a Athletics skill Attack against an adjacent enemy contested by your target's Reflex defense.

On a success you may move up to twice your Stride, including the ability to pass through your target enemy's space, without provoking any Disengagement reactions.

On a failure your movement is blocked and your remain in your current position.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
对相邻敌人进行一次运动技能攻击，与目标的反射防御进行对抗。

成功时，你可以移动至多两倍你的跨步，且可以穿过目标敌人的空间，且不会触发任何脱离接战反应。

失败时，你的移动被阻挡，并停留在当前位置。

crucible.talent.json.en: You have a fluent education in hand-to-hand combat and other martial arts. You gain the Journeyman training rank and a +1 Skill Bonus with weapons in the Unarmed category.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在徒手战斗和其他武术方面接受过熟练的训练。你获得熟练工训练等级，并在徒手武器类别中获得+1技能加值。

crucible.talent.json.en: You attempt to physically restrain or subdue an opponent. Perform a Athletics skill attack against an adjacent target. If successful, both you and your target are @Condition[restrained] for 1 Round.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你尝试以肢体动作限制或压制一名对手。对一个邻近目标进行一次运动技能攻击。若成功，你和你的目标都陷入 @状态[受缚] ，持续 1 轮。

crucible.talent.json.en:
You are highly skilled in weaving the Rune of Oblivion. Spells which use this Rune cause the @Condition[entropy] condition on Critical Hits.

The Entropy effect lasts for 1 Round, deals half your Presence score as Void damage to Morale, and applies the @Condition[frightened] condition.
crucible.talent.json.cn:
你在编织湮灭符文方面技艺高超。使用该符文的法术在造成暴击时会施加@状态[entropy]状态。

熵蚀效果持续1 轮，造成相当于你存在属性一半的虚空士气伤害，并施加@状态[frightened]状态。

crucible.talent.json.en: You identify moments of opportunity to strike at an enemy's weak points. When attacking a target that is @Condition[unaware], @Condition[flanked], or @Condition[exposed] using a weapon which scales with Dexterity, you gain +2 damage to any Strike.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你能识别出攻击敌人弱点的时机。使用随敏捷成长的武器攻击处于@状态[unaware]、@状态[flanked]或@状态[exposed]状态的目标时，你的任何打击都获得 +2 伤害。

crucible.talent.json.en: You gain the Journeyman rank in the Wilderness skill, providing a +1 Skill Bonus.
crucible.talent.json.cn: 你在荒野技能中获得熟练工等级，获得+1技能加值。
